전투는 참가자, 전장, 목표, 보급, 합법 퇴로와 증원 조건을 확정한 닫: A battle begins as a closed session in which the participants, battlefield, objectives, supplies, legal fallback routes, and reinforcement conditions are fixed. The result is determined by each individual soldier's attack rolls, and the battle ends by producing a single immutable `ResultId`. Pre-engagement unit orders are distinguished from individual rolls. The camera is a free 3D command view, and there is no pause in battle.
개인 판정과 두 진행 방식: Individual Rolls and the Two Modes of Play
전투 판정은 기존 4판 개인 능력·기술·공격 3d6·능동 방어·DR·피해: Battle resolution takes the existing 4th-edition individual attributes, skills, 3d6 attack rolls, active defense, DR, damage types, and injury standards as its starting point, and a Seoul: Warring States original formula is designed alongside them (owner confirmed). This includes redesigning individual hit, defense, damage, and injury; situational modifiers for command, morale, fatigue, supply, terrain, formation, and scale; and unit-aggregate resolution. This does not mean that the calculation coefficients and numbers are finalized. The player decides the composition, equipment, commanders, and whether to engage before engagement, and new unit orders are locked during melee engagement. Auto and manual battles use the same resolution contract and result ledger.
조우가 전투로 이어지면 자동 전투와 수동 전투 가운데 하나를 고른다. 자: When an encounter leads to battle, one of auto battle or manual battle is chosen. Auto battle computes the result without a battlefield, while manual battle is played out on a 3D battlefield. Both modes use the same resolution rules.
분대마다 사기를 보여 준다. 부상, 아군의 사망·기절·도주와 지휘관에게: Morale is shown for each squad. Injuries, allies dying, being knocked unconscious, or fleeing, and anything that happens to the commander trigger a willpower-based fear check. Those who fail the check flee, and the commander's leadership check and the individual's mood modify the check. The size of the modifiers is not set in this document.
부상·출혈·감염, 기절한 사람의 포획, 항복과 도주는 인물 신병 결과로: Injury, bleeding, and infection, the capture of knocked-out characters, and surrender and flight carry over to the campaign as character custody outcomes. No new probability or capacity numbers are created.
직접 조작하는 대상은 개별 영웅이 아니라 선택한 부대다. 수동 전투의 지: What the player directly controls is the selected unit, not an individual hero. The command scope of manual battle is limited to the following.
전투 전에 분대의 배치와 진형을 정한다. 진형 이름과 효과 수치는 이 문: Before battle, the squad's placement and formation are set. Formation names and effect values are not set in this document.
Select one unit that has not yet engaged, or several units to be given orders together.
Choose one of move, attack target, fire, or ambush.
Preview the route and target shown on the battlefield beforehand.
확인하면 새 지시가 교전 전인 그 부대의 현재 지시를 교체한다. 취소하면: On confirmation, the new order replaces the current order of that not-yet-engaged unit. On cancellation, the existing order is left as it is.
근접 교전에 들어간 부대는 그 교전이 끝날 때까지 새 명령을 받지 않는다: A unit that has entered melee engagement receives no new orders until that engagement ends.
Retreat is not a squad order but an order given to the battle as a whole.
확정한 지시만 수락된 명령 기록에 들어간다. 여러 지시를 쌓는 큐, 웨이: Only confirmed orders enter the accepted-order record. Queues that stack multiple orders, waypoint chains, order editing, slow-down/speed-up, and direct hero actions are outside the target scope.
선택하지 않은 상태에서는 부대 명령을 확정할 수 없다. 미리보기와 확정: A unit order cannot be confirmed while nothing is selected. Validity is checked against the same battle context at both preview and confirmation, but the preview itself does not change state.
이름 있는 영웅과 병졸 분대는 별도 전장 행위자다. 영웅은 병졸 인원에: Named heroes and rank-and-file squads are separate battlefield actors. Heroes are not counted in the rank-and-file headcount. Unit capacity varies with the commander's personal attributes, nation level, and settlement level, and there is no common cap (Decision 15). The input definitions and formula are undecided. No fixed cap is placed on the total number of squads, number of heroes, or army size either.
영웅도 지휘 명령의 대상이 될 수 있지만 직접 액션 콤보를 조작하지 않는: Heroes can also be targets of command orders, but the player does not directly control action combos. Hero state and the rank-and-file squad's headcount, morale, and formation are recorded separately, and the results likewise do not merge a hero's individual life or death, injury, or detention with rank-and-file squad losses into a single number.
전투 카메라는 3D 자유 지휘 시점이다. 플레이어는 전장을 팬·오빗·줌으: The battle camera is a free 3D command view. The player surveys the battlefield by panning, orbiting, and zooming. No specific angle, field of view, or numeric value is newly set. The top-down battlefield diagram is a documentation blueprint explaining positions and interactions, not an actual in-game render screen.
전투에는 일시정지·재개와 감속·배속이 없다. 전투 세션은 시작부터 종료까: There is no pause/resume or slow-down/speed-up in battle. A battle session flows in real time from start to end. The shared campaign world, world time, and other parties' battles and movement also continue to flow regardless of this battle.
부대 선택, 명령 미리보기, 확인과 취소는 교전 전인 부대에 대해 전투가: Unit selection, order preview, confirmation, and cancellation are done for units that have not yet engaged, while the battle is running. A confirmed order is assigned a deterministic acceptance order and applied in that order at the next simulation step. An order confirmed later for the same unit replaces the previously confirmed current order, and no separate order queue is created. A canceled preview does not enter the acceptance order and the existing order is kept.
Ends by achieving the objective or by a determination of incapacity to fight.
The facts of victory or defeat and losses are recorded in the result.
플레이어가 전투 전체에 철수를 지시하고 확인한다. 철수 중에도 지휘가 유: The player orders and confirms a withdrawal for the entire battle. Command is maintained even during the withdrawal.
`LegalFallback`을 통과한 경로가 있어야 한다. 실패하면 명령: There must be a route that has passed `LegalFallback`. If it fails, an ordered withdrawal is not established.
Loses control through the collapse of cohesion and breaks away.
합법 경로를 고르는 명령 철수와 구분하며, 패주에 따른 손실 사실을 남긴: Distinguished from an ordered withdrawal, which chooses a legal route; the facts of losses from the rout are recorded.
One side offers to surrender and the other accepts.
퇴로 봉쇄나 `LegalFallback` 실패만으로 항복 선택을 없애지: The option to surrender is not removed merely because the retreat is blocked or `LegalFallback` has failed.
포획은 종료 상태가 아니라 전투 뒤 인물별 신병 처리에서 생기는 구금 결: Capture is not an end state but a detention outcome that arises in per-character custody handling after the battle. Those who surrendered, routed, were wounded, or survived are not all automatically turned into prisoners. Whether capture occurs and the custody handling are attached to the relevant character ID and recorded in the result.
각 전투는 위 종료 상태 가운데 하나와 전투 사실을 담은 불변 결과를 한: Each battle issues only once an immutable result containing one of the above end states and the battle facts. The campaign settles the same `ResultId` exactly once.
기둥과 상점, 짧은 교전 거리, 좁은 전열: Pillars and shops, short engagement distances, a narrow front line
층 전환, 여러 입구, 측면 노출과 증원 경로: Level changes, multiple entrances, flank exposure, and reinforcement routes
Blocked connections are not erased; their cause, risk level, and recovery conditions are preserved.
In an encounter, choose negotiation, trade, work, stealth, avoidance, or combat.
Combat is just one of those options, not the default.
RCAMPAIGN-07 결정적 충돌만 전술로 넘긴다: RCAMPAIGN-07 Only decisive clashes go to tactics
Decisive clashes are resolved through closed, individually adjudicated combat.
Minor friction is not dragged into tactical combat.
RCAMPAIGN-08 결과는 거점과 노선까지 반영한다: RCAMPAIGN-08 Results reach strongholds and routes
전투든 비전투 조우든 부상과 시간과 물자와 관계와 평판과 거점과 노선 상: Whether combat or non-combat encounter, injuries, time, supplies, relationships, reputation, strongholds, and route status are applied exactly once via a `ResultId` or cause ID.
반영 뒤 같은 경로를 계속 가거나 다음 행선지와 원정 결말을 고를 수 있: After applying, the party can keep going along the same route or choose the next destination and the expedition's ending; the world is not left unchanged with only a combat win or loss remaining.
RCAMPAIGN-09 규모는 인물과 사건으로만 커진다: RCAMPAIGN-09 Scale grows only through people and events
Early on, it deals with party survival and the problems of a single station.
신뢰와 직능을 얻은 뒤에는 작업반이나 상단을 이끌고 이후에는 여러 역의: After earning trust and specialized skills, you lead a work crew or caravan, and later you intervene in the pacts of multiple stations and the policies of line factions.
Even as the scale grows, choices are conveyed through named characters and concrete events.
RCAMPAIGN-10 시간 사다리는 행동→시간→하루→한주다: RCAMPAIGN-10 The time ladder is action → time → day → week
행동은 이동 목적지 지시·대화·작업·공격 같은 결정이다. 이동은 지시한: An action is a decision such as giving a movement destination order, conversing, working, or attacking. Movement proceeds along the ordered route while world time flows, and there is no strategy turn that resolves it one tile at a time.
시간은 이동과 피로와 식량과 지역 일정을 먹고 하루는 역 생산과 소비와: Time consumes movement, fatigue, food, and regional schedules, and a day aggregates station production and consumption, external party movement, and route safety.
A week runs diplomacy, population tallies, legitimacy, and faction objectives.
RCAMPAIGN-11 정밀도는 거리로 가른다: RCAMPAIGN-11 Precision is divided by distance
The area around the player is calculated in detail.
멀리 있는 세계는 집계 단위로 처리하며 세계 전체를 같은 정밀도로 계속: The distant world is handled in aggregate units, and the entire world is not continuously calculated at the same precision.
RCAMPAIGN-12 진행은 영토 숫자가 아니다: RCAMPAIGN-12 Progress is not a territory number
진행은 거점의 안정화와 전문화와 연결 투사력과 플레이어가 세운 질서의 정: Progress is measured by a stronghold's stabilization, specialization, connection projection power, and the legitimacy of the order the player has established.
Occupied tiles are not converted into victory points.
RCAMPAIGN-13 연결 `K_i`는 경로 신뢰도의 최댓값을 자른다: RCAMPAIGN-13 Connectivity `K_i` clamps the maximum path reliability
Relief, trade, and reinforcement feasibility are read only from this value.
RCAMPAIGN-14 부족은 수요 0에서 나누지 않는다: RCAMPAIGN-14 Shortage is not divided at zero demand
아니면 `1 - clamp(가용량 / 수요, 0, 1)`이며 범위는 0~: Otherwise it is `1 - clamp(gayongnyang / suyo, 0, 1)`, and the range remains 0 to 1.
RCAMPAIGN-15 긴장도 `E'`는 한 식에 모은다: RCAMPAIGN-15 Tension `E'` is gathered into one formula
`E' = clamp(E + 시간압력 + 확장충격 + 부족 + 고립 +: It is `E' = clamp(E + siganamnyeok + hwakjangchunggyeok + bujok + gorip + gwahwakjang - hoebok, 0, 100)`.
Starting tension is 20, and the default expansion shock for a newly occupied stronghold is 5.
RCAMPAIGN-16 위기확률은 0.10과 0.75 사이에 가둔다: RCAMPAIGN-16 Crisis probability is confined between 0.10 and 0.75
The base crisis probability is 10% and the maximum is 75%.
`pyeonggyunbujok` and `pyeonggyungorip` are averages weighted by the base (geojeom) weights, and the lower bound of the denominator is 0.25.
일반 거점 가중치는 1.0이고 환승은 1.5이며 과확장 척도 자체는 바꾸: The standard stronghold weight is 1.0 and a transfer station's is 1.5, and the overextension scale itself is not changed.
RCAMPAIGN-18 회복은 그 주 해결에만 붙는다: RCAMPAIGN-18 Recovery applies only to that week's resolution
Resolution quality is 0 to 1, and if the crisis is not resolved that week, recovery is 0.
RCAMPAIGN-19 위기 종류와 대상은 원장에 남긴다: RCAMPAIGN-19 Crisis type and target are recorded in the ledger
Crisis type and target are determined by the campaign seed, the week number, and a dedicated random number stream.
A crisis is not finalized until the cause weights are recorded in the ledger.

Shortage and contamination are `1 + 4*pyeonggyunbujok` (pyeonggyunbujok = average shortage).

개인/집계의 실행 채널·공격 사건·대상별 실제 손실·소모·부상·이탈·포획: Merges the individual/aggregate execution channels, attack events, and actual losses, consumption, injuries, desertions, and captures per target.

작위 권리·혼인 주장·전쟁 명분: Title Rights, Marriage Claims, and Casus Belli
실효 지배와 법적 인준을 분리한다. 점령·양도 사건은 현장 통제를 바꾸지: Effective control and legal ratification are separated. Occupation and cession events change on-the-ground control, but civilian cooperation, administration, stabilization, integration, and ratification are separate stages. The ledger of title holdings, rights, obligations, and superior contracts is independent of the ledger of effective control, and unrecovered fiefs, disputes, and occupiers are displayed together. A transfer of rights at the end of a war does not mean that civilian cooperation and facility recovery are complete.
혼인은 국가별 정치·재산·계승 제도를 적용한다. 당사자 동의·인준과 효과: Marriage applies each state's political, property, and succession institutions. The consent and ratification of the parties and the attribution of effects are recorded in the event ledger. Marriage-claim paths are divided into using the spouse's existing claim, inheritance of a claim by children, and fabrication of a claim separate from succession rights. Marriage alone does not automatically grant a new claim or territory. Upon death, imprisonment, or loss of office, contracts are checked by alliance, property, ratification, and succession effects and sorted into maintained, terminated, or re-ratified; they are not terminated all at once.
작위령의 주장을 근거로 권리 회복을 요구할 수 있고 주장은 시간이 걸리는: Rights restoration can be demanded on the basis of a claim under a title decree, and a claim can be built through a fabrication that takes time. The fabrication is carried out by an authorized records, notarial, or genealogy officer acting on the orders of a ruler or office holder. Accessible records, genealogy, ratification routes, duration, cost, and risk of exposure are checked. Evidence gathering/drafting, claim construction, and recognition/rejection of validity are separated, and completing a fabrication is not treated as possession. A direct fabrication path by an office-less principal is not adopted.
Attributed to the designated successor eligibility while the current holder is alive.
Each state's eligibility of children, succession outside bloodline, and the link between office succession and title succession must be connected.
정당한 계승·권리 회복의 근거이며, 보유자가 사망하면 자녀에게 미관철 주: It is the basis for legitimate succession and rights restoration, and a path is provided for it to be inherited by children as an unenforced claim when the holder dies.
Each state's ratification, marriage, and succession exceptions, and the eligibility for succession to personal rights, are specified separately.
별도 상속하지 않으며 주장 전쟁이 백지 강화로 끝나면 관철된 주장 상태로: It is not inherited separately, and if a claim war ends in a white peace, it changes to the enforced claim status.
Claim extinction/loss of eligibility and the conditions voiding an ongoing war are checked for each casus belli.
모든 전쟁에는 명분이 필요하다. 선전포고 전에 행위자 권한·상대·대상 작: Every war requires a casus belli. Before a declaration of war, fix the actor's authority, the opponent, the target title/territory, the beneficiary, casus belli eligibility, cost, war goals, and the effects of victory, white peace, surrender, and void termination. If a claim is enforced on behalf of another person, check the new holder and the superior contract, and do not automatically assign all territory to the attacker. Occupation outside the goals does not expand the scope of the casus belli's transfer of rights. The detailed casus belli list, state-specific cost requirements, and superior contracts are still undecided.
공격·방어 점수는 -100~+100의 반대 값이다. 전투·점령·핵심 포로: Attack and defense scores are opposite values from -100 to +100. They change through battles, occupation, key prisoners, and control of casus belli goals.

동일 입력에 다른 결과를 내지 말 것: Do not produce different results from the same input.

Its basis is the immutable combat context, accepted squad commands, deterministic checkpoints, and the distribution, lineage, and signature rules of ADR-008 (2026-09-22). A corrupted save is rejected with a clear error and is not silently repaired. This does not mean implementation is complete.

Random values are separated by purpose, such as combat, encounters, and world events, so that the processing order of one system does not shake the results of another.
Every state change records the following.
변경 주체와 대상: Actor and target of the change
변경 전후 요약 해시: Summary hash before and after the change
이 원장을 통해 “왜 노선이 봉쇄되었는가”, “왜 물가가 올랐는가”, “: Through this ledger, we can explain "why a route was blockaded," "why prices rose," and "why a character left a faction." Things done to a character, such as interviews, trades, and succession endorsements, remain only as micro-lines in the succession, the name roster, and the world ledger, and become world events here when their sum exceeds a threshold. The random numbers that pick given names and surnames use only the character stream.
저장 파일에는 판본이 붙은 세계 상태, 명령·사건의 위치, 콘텐츠 판본과: A save file contains the versioned world state, the position within commands and events, the content version, and the confirmed checkpoint of any battle in progress. A checkpoint includes the immutable combat context, a command record with a deterministic acceptance order, and settlement receipts. It is first written to a temporary file, and after the checksum is verified, it replaces the original.
Unsupported versions, truncated files, and incorrect checksums are never silently read. A clear error is returned and the previous backup is preserved.
멀티플레이와 전용 서버의 호스트 씨앗은 완전히 검증된 원자 체크포인트뿐입: The only host seeds for multiplayer and dedicated servers are fully verified atomic checkpoints. Every verified checkpoint contains all of the following.
빌드·스키마·콘텐츠·프로토콜 판본: Build, schema, content, and protocol versions
계보 ID와 부모 체크포인트 해시: Lineage ID and parent checkpoint hash
참가자 바인딩(월드 참가자 공개키와 `personId` 점유): Participant bindings (world participant public keys and `personId` occupancy)
모든 참가자는 현재 월드·원장 위치를 검증하고 자신의 아카이브·바인딩을: Every participant receives a signed checkpoint receipt and projection metadata so they can verify the current world and ledger position and preserve their own archive and bindings. A complete, hostable world snapshot is distributed or exported only when the checkpoint's immutable fork policy allows it. Participants who are prohibited from forking are not given state complete enough to seed a server, but they continue to be provided with their own archive and character records. Hosting of an authoritative server is not started from a partially verified, corrupted, or signature-failed file.
Executables and runtime are kept separate from persistent world, settings, checkpoint, and backup data. Each active lineage has exactly one writer.
받은 체크포인트를 호스트하면 항상 영구 독립 분기를 엽니다. 새 계보 I: Hosting a received checkpoint always opens a permanent, independent fork. It gets a new lineage ID and key, and forks are never merged automatically. Participants receive the public key for verification but not the parent lineage's signing secret. Only the holder of the original lineage key can continue that same lineage.
잃은 계보 비밀은 암호화된 복구 백업에서만 되돌립니다. 백업이 없으면 부: A lost lineage secret can be restored only from an encrypted recovery backup. Without a backup, the parent lineage is read-only and progress is possible only through forks.
공개 전용 서버 운영자가 분기 허용·금지를 고릅니다. 그 정책은 각 체크: The operator of a public-only server chooses whether to allow or forbid forks. That policy is signed into each checkpoint and cannot change within that checkpoint. A policy change applies only to later checkpoints. Only fork-allowed checkpoints include and export a complete, hostable world snapshot.
서명 클라이언트·로컬 DRM 증명이 검증되지 않은 클라이언트는 로컬 저장: A client whose signing client or local DRM attestation is unverified can read local saves and play single-player, but cannot sign checkpoints.
반입은 임시 위치에 쓰고 서명·해시·판본·계보 부모 해시를 확인한 뒤에만: An import writes to a temporary location and replaces the active checkpoint only after verifying the signature, hash, version, and parent lineage hash. The original is never overwritten before verification.
비정상 종료 다음 시작은 서명·해시가 통과한 가장 최신 완전 체크포인트를: After an abnormal shutdown, the next start automatically loads the most recent complete checkpoint that passes signature and hash checks, and clearly reports any conflicts and lost intervals. A normal shutdown blocks new joins, saves, checkpoints, finishes distribution and confirmation, and then exits.
세션 자격은 휘발성이지만 월드·인물 바인딩은 체크포인트에 남습니다. 로컬: Session credentials are volatile, but world and character bindings persist in checkpoints. If a local character archive is lost, it can be rebuilt from records signed by the host after verifying the recovery secret and confirming the person. There is no automatic in-game identity proof.
전투 컨텍스트 발행 전: Before the combat context is issued
전투 상태와 수락된 명령 기록이 함께 확정된 체크포인트: A checkpoint in which the combat state and the accepted command log are committed together
중간 저장을 읽을 때 캠페인을 다시 조회하지 않고 저장된 불변 컨텍스트와: When loading a mid-battle save, the campaign is not queried again; the saved immutable context and the accepted combat command log are restored. After restoration, confirmed replacement orders must be applied at the next simulation step in the same acceptance order as before the save. Saving creates no turns or new time intervals in real-time combat. The same checkpoint and command log must produce the same result and checksum.
이 문서는 현재 제품 목표의 전략-전투 왕복 계약이다. 구현 완료가 아니: This document is the strategy-combat round-trip contract for the current product goal. It does not mean implementation is complete. Combat has no pause (owner decision, 2026-09-24), and the shared campaign and other parties continue regardless of combat. Only the squad in combat receives no new strategy orders until its result is settled. Combat arises from encounters in the world, and participants are fixed from the actual encounter location and the participant ledger. Only a battle in which the main body actually participates can open the battlefield viewport, and the settlement screen stays closed in the meantime. A battle in which the main body does not participate is resolved and settled automatically under the same individual adjudication rules, and the strategy map shows only its status and result. Remote command authority is not the right to enter a remote battlefield viewport.
전략 세계 상태를 전술 전투에 넘기고, 한 번의 결과만 캠페인에 반영하는: Operates the round trip that hands the strategic world state to tactical combat and reflects a single result back into the campaign.
캠페인의 `WorldState`만 영속 상태를 소유합니다. 전투는 캠페인: Only the campaign's `WorldState` owns persistent state. Combat does not modify the campaign directly.
전투를 시작할 때 넘기는 정보: Information Handed Over at Combat Start
전투를 시작할 때 실제 조우 위치·참가자와 본체 참여 여부를 검사하고 다: At combat start, the actual encounter location, participants, and main-body participation are checked, and the following information is fixed and handed over as one bundle.
전투, 캠페인, 위치와 참가자 ID: Combat, campaign, location, and participant IDs
독립 원정 분대 ID, 영웅 지휘관·배속 영웅, 병졸 분대 구성과 전략: Independent expedition squad ID, hero commander and attached heroes, rank-and-file squad composition, and strategic stance
부상, 사기, 장비, 물자와 파티 구성: Injuries, morale, equipment, supplies, and party composition
전장 원형, 지형, 위험과 목표: Battlefield archetype, terrain, hazards, and objectives
합법적인 퇴로와 증원 조건: Legal retreat routes and reinforcement conditions
세계 시간, 전투 시드, 규칙과 콘텐츠 버전: World time, combat seed, rules, and content version
전투가 시작된 뒤에는 바깥 세계의 상태를 다시 가져오지 않습니다. 전투: Once combat has started, the state of the outside world is not fetched again. The combat Core uses only the fixed context and accepted unit orders. An order contains the selected unit and one of move, attack, facing, formation, halt, or withdraw. A confirmed new order replaces that unit's current order, and a canceled preview changes neither the log nor the state. There are no command queues or waypoints.
전투 카메라는 소유자가 확정한 3D 자유 지휘 시점입니다. 팬·오빗·줌만: The combat camera is the owner-confirmed 3D free command view. Only pan, orbit, and zoom are specified; no angle or field-of-view values are invented. Combat has no pause, slow-down, or fast-forward, and it does not affect the campaign world or other parties. Orders confirmed for a squad before engagement have a deterministic acceptance order and are applied at the next simulation step. A later order for the same unit replaces the earlier one, and a squad engaged in melee does not accept new orders.
전투가 끝나면 일반 승리·패배, 명령 철수, 사기 패주, 수락된 항복 가: When combat ends, the following are returned as the confirmed result: the applicable end state (ordinary victory or defeat, ordered withdrawal, morale rout, or accepted surrender), the elapsed time, whether each character lived or died, new injuries, equipment expended, spoils, and changes to the party's retreat route and stronghold control. Capture is not an end state but a detention outcome attached to a character ID, and neither surrender nor rout automatically means imprisonment.
`ResultId`는 결과를 구별하는 고유 값입니다. 이미 처리한 결과가: `ResultId` is a unique value that distinguishes a result. If a result that has already been processed comes in again, only the receipt created earlier is returned. If a different result arrives for the same combat, the state is left unchanged and a recovery error is raised.
정산 순서는 인물 운명, 물자, 파티 위치, 시간, 거점·노선 통제, 관: The settlement order is character fates, supplies, party location, time, stronghold and route control, then relationship and reputation events. All invariants must pass in the pre-application validation step before everything is applied at once. A combat reset returns only the current combat session to its starting state before settlement; it is not a means of reverting campaign state or results that have already been applied.
정산은 귀환 명령이 아닙니다. 결과를 반영하고 확인한 뒤 원정을 계속하거: Settlement is not a return order. After the result is applied and confirmed, the expedition can continue, or its next ending can be chosen from return, settlement, conquest, wandering, or trade.
마지막 플레이어 이탈과 충돌 체크포인트: Last Player Departure and Conflict Checkpoints
제품 멀티플레이에서 세계 시간은 플레이어가 한 명 이상 연결되어 있을 때: In product multiplayer, world time advances only while at least one player is connected (ADR-008). This section applies that contract to combat. It does not mean implementation is complete.
마지막 플레이어가 전투 중에 나가면 서버는 불변 전투 컨텍스트, 수락된: When the last player leaves during combat, the server immediately writes the immutable combat context, the accepted commands, and the current combat state into a checkpoint and halts the world and combat simulation. It neither settles automatically nor rolls back the combat. The campaign leaves that combat's `ResultId` uncreated.
인원이 0이 된 뒤의 재개는 검증된 체크포인트에서 시작한다. 저장된 불변: Resuming after the player count reaches 0 starts from a verified checkpoint. The saved immutable context and accepted command log are restored, and the campaign is not queried again.

\"명시적으로 등록되고 권한이 부여된 관할 법만 가문 행위를 처리; 실제: "Only explicitly registered and authorized jurisdictional laws handle house actions; the actual jurisdictional law content and path eligibility are undetermined."
\"실제 관할 법이 그 경로를 허용할 때만 당사자 직접 동의 사용; 포괄: "Use direct consent of the parties only when the actual jurisdictional law permits that path; this is not a blanket eligibility exemption."
\"이름 붙은 양부·양자의 유효 동의 필요; 실제 나이·자격 규칙은 별개: "Valid consent from the named adoptive father and adoptee is required; the actual age and eligibility rules are separate."
\"모든 현재 소유자가 자산별로 따로 서명; 혼인만으로 소유 변경 없음;: "Every current owner signs separately for each asset; marriage alone does not change ownership; shares, remainders, and creditor priority are undetermined."
\"등록 유언만 수혜자를 제안; 실제 법적 자격과 승인된 배정은 별도 요: "Only a registered will may propose beneficiaries; actual legal eligibility and approved allocation are separate requirements."
\"명시적으로 승인된 전체 자산 배정만 사용; 미확정 지분과 잔여는 새: "Use only explicitly approved whole-asset allocations; unconfirmed shares and remainders are preserved without new ratios."
\"식별된 개인 채무는 기록된 채무자·유산 검토에 잔류; 상속인 자동 책: "Identified personal debts remain with the recorded debtor and under estate review; there is no automatic heir liability and no reassignment of institutional or office debts."
\"유효 배정은 법적 명의만 이전; 담보·예약·보관자·위치·경로를 물리: "A valid allocation transfers legal title only; collateral, reservations, custodians, locations, and routes are preserved without physical movement."
\"제안은 명시적으로 비구속; 수락이 재검사를 통과한 뒤에만 예약; 경쟁: "An offer is explicitly non-binding; it is reserved only after acceptance passes re-inspection; competing acceptances cannot reserve the same asset simultaneously."
\"물류 위치·경로 관측은 D13의 사실 위치와 표시 지식을 분리한다.\: "Logistics location and route observations separate D13's factual location from displayed knowledge."
\"실제 임금·배급 이행은 자산/채무 원장에 결속하되 지급률은 작성 승인: "Actual wage and ration fulfillment is bound to the asset/debt ledger, but payment rates are withheld until authoring approval."
\"생산 단계 회수는 자산 총량을 바꾸는 외부 사건이며 D13이 회수율을: "Production-stage recovery is an external event that changes total asset quantities, and D13 does not set the recovery rate."
\"조약의 법적 효력과 배상 실물 인계는 별도 상태다.\": "A treaty's legal effect and the physical handover of reparations are separate states."
\"개인 유산의 법과 공석 금고 관리자 권한은 실제 국가별 입력이 필요하: "The law governing personal estates and the authority of a vacant vault administrator require actual per-state input."
\"조작권 복귀와 구금은 소유권·상속을 자동 변경하지 않는다.\": "Restoration of control and detention do not automatically change ownership or inheritance."
\"도메인 목록에 D13이 없으나 consequences의 재산 관리·채: "D13 is not in the domain list, but consequences for property management, debts, obligations, and dissolution are directly consumed."
\"자산 가격과 행동 비용·수락 조건 및 스냅샷을 분리한다.\": "Separate asset prices from action costs, acceptance conditions, and snapshots."

A base of 10 means a practitioner proficient in that field, and the final value after applying all traits, items, and statuses never exceeds 100. Opening effects with a narrative basis may allow a final value above 20. Action proficiency is 0–99.9, separate from competence, and is not counted twice with Skill. Traits affect performance, actions, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. The body records the damage level and functional state of the left arm, right arm, left leg, right leg, head, and torso, along with separate disease progression, and combat and plague use the same body record. The resolution formula, effect composition, proficiency growth formula, individual effect magnitudes, trait list, and damage and function vocabulary are undecided. The GURPS CP, ST/DX/IQ/HT, HP/FP, and cost tables below, along with the 2026-10-08 opposed d10, 0–12 Skill, trait categories, and validation cases, apply only to explicitly past or research editions and are not required inputs, formulas, or implementation evidence for the new profile. The twelve ids are architecture nodes that distinguish the states and records of different owners. They are not global progression stages that pass through characters, houses, places, and screens in turn. Characters and squads carry out their own actions in the same world time, and when the conditions of a command or event are met, only the relevant targets change state. Events also occur in living spaces, and selecting a map or panel does not stop the actions of unrelated targets. The arrow in each row means a legal state change of that target or a link between records. Life, the strategic map, and combat are screens that differ in the space and information they display, and they do not own world progression. This table is a design contract for the product goals; the implementation status is confirmed in separate verification records. The table's GDD citations are fixed-tree line numbers at `bedb366d6eb1d884bce39f4dd3cf3ab9890b0403`, and the worldbuilding citations are fixed-tree line numbers in a separate repository at `84040eb7124f4e6e779b42e7e3c091f71bbdbac8`.

도착을 먼저 검증하고 마감시각 이하인지 비교한다. 최종 가용 재고에는 수: Verifies arrival first, then compares it against the deadline to check that it is at or before it. Final available stock separately requires recipient confirmation and applicable rights and storage checks.
A report updates only the observer's knowledge, which carries a source, an observation time, and a reference time.
진행 중 전투의 실제 도착 참가를 반영하고 모든 검사를 통과한 결과·개정: Reflects actual arrivals joining a battle in progress, and records a result or revision that passes all checks exactly once.
D07 관계·신뢰·충성·명령 평가 작동 계약과 공식 시트: D07 Relationships, Trust, Loyalty, and Order Evaluation: Operating Contract and Official Sheet
방향이 있는 신뢰, 개인의 인지와 기억, 충성 상태, 명령 준수와 사후: Separate directed trust, an individual's perception and memory, loyalty state, order compliance, and after-the-fact performance. Past decisions are not rewritten using facts that were not observed, and per-effect values, decay, duration, and real-world person and institution inputs are deferred.
Verify the permanent identity and the rule/snapshot revisions, and reject duplicate results first.
세계 사실과 관찰자의 인지, 권한, 실행 가능성, 행동, 관측 성과를 분: Separate world facts from the observer's perception, authority, feasibility, actions, and observed outcomes.
Only an observer who directly observed the event or received a report updates the corresponding perception record.
If there is no approved effect function, do not change trust or loyalty values.
명령 준수와 성과를 따로 분류하고 불가능한 명령을 고의 불복종으로 바꾸지: Classify order compliance and performance separately, and do not turn an impossible order into deliberate disobedience.
Preserve the successor's existing relationships and do not copy the predecessor's personal trust.
Apply the attributed outcome together with the settlement identifier, and preserve relationship facts and contracts.
D08 가문·친족·혼인·양자 작동 계약과 공식 시트: D08 Operating Contract and Official Sheet for Houses, Kinship, Marriage, and Adoption
Records the governing law, the parties' consent, ratification, the establishment of the marriage, and its individual effects separately. Marriage alone does not transfer claims, territory, offices, or property, and adoption requires both the parties' consent and an approved procedure.
Verifies the identities of the act, outcome, participants, and governing law, along with the rules and amendments.
등록되고 권한이 있는 관할 법만 적용하며 미확인 관할을 임의로 선택하지: Applies only registered and authorized governing laws, and does not arbitrarily select an unconfirmed jurisdiction.
동의와 인준을 별도 기록하고 관할 판정 없이 혼인 성립을 확정하지 않는다: Records consent and ratification separately, and does not finalize the establishment of a marriage without a jurisdiction ruling.
An established marriage by itself does not create a new claim or a territorial transfer.
On death, detention, or loss of office, assesses the effects on alliances, property, ratification, and succession separately.
공동재산은 현재 소유자 전원의 서명을 확인하되 소유권 반영은 별도 원장에: For jointly held property, verifies the signatures of all current owners, but leaves the reflection of ownership to a separate ledger.
If there is no adoption procedure, preserves the consent record and leaves the matter pending.
Does not treat a synthetic person recognized as having personhood as transferable property.
결과와 개정을 원자적으로 기록하며 미확인 상태를 거절·허용으로 바꾸지 않: Records outcomes and amendments atomically, and does not convert an unconfirmed state into a rejection or approval.

A vacancy does not delete the institution, treasury, debt, or lineage, and the procedure values and numerical legitimacy of the actual 16 states are withheld.
Cross-check the permanent IDs and editions of the state, institution, office, and procedure.
Loss of an office vacates only the target office and preserves the institution, treasury, and other offices.
If there is no approved, complete procedure input for the relevant state and office, no appointment is made.
Filter candidates by the stated eligibility and by the examination unit and criteria.
Cross-check valid electors against votes, and apply only the registered quorum and tie rules.
임명권자와 필요한 인준권자를 확인한 뒤 직위·범주형 정통성을 함께 반영한: After confirming the appointing authority and the required confirming authority, reflect the office and categorical legitimacy together.
Acting authority permits only registered persons and action scopes, and does not convert into ownership of the office.
Loading restores the previous result and does not rerun the election.

Confirms the revocation clause, violation, and ratification, and limits delegation to the authority actually held.
Passes the peerage and rights preservation checks, then applies the legal change once.
Physical handover and illegal seizure are adjudicated separately from legal holding.

D12 후계·사망·본체 전환 작동 계약과 공식 시트: D12 Succession, Death, and Main-Body Transfer: Operating Contract and Official Sheet
본체 조작권, 직위, 작위·명분, 재산과 계약 효과를 독립적으로 판정한다: Control of the main body, office, title and legitimacy, property, and contract effects are each adjudicated independently. Death and permanent detention are separate events, and release alone does not return a character to their original body. Structural validation of legitimacy, squads, death-sensitive clauses, organizations, relationship effects, and common units is still pending.
Validates the format, event identity, and overall revision, and distinguishes resubmissions that yield identical results.
확인된 사실과 같은 경계의 사망 집합을 읽고 사망자의 새 개인 행동을 중: Reads the confirmed facts and the death set at the same boundary, and halts the deceased's new personal actions.
Preserves offices, titles, property, and contracts as a snapshot, then selects the main body independently.
적격 지정자 또는 등록된 순서를 따르되 순서 미확인은 선택 보류, 확인된: Follows the eligible designee or the registered order. An unconfirmed order defers the selection, while a confirmed empty list ends the path.
직위는 국가별 적격·인준 결과를, 재산은 유효한 개별 처분을 읽으며 물리: Offices read each state's eligibility and ratification results, and property reads valid individual dispositions; physical handover is not inferred.
미완 명령·전쟁 약속은 항목별 재검사하고 소비 자원·완료 진척을 보존한다: Unfinished orders and war commitments are rechecked item by item, preserving consumed resources and completed progress.
복귀는 현재 조작 인물의 요청과 원래 몸의 적법 상태·신원·위치를 확인한: Return is handled as a single transfer that checks the currently controlled character's request and the original body's lawful status, identity, and location.
결과와 사건 영수증을 함께 반영한다. 미검증 구조를 실행 완료로 표시하지: Reflects the result and the event receipt together. Unverified structures are not marked as execution complete.
D13 자산·유산·운송 작동 계약과 공식 시트: D13 Asset, Inheritance, and Transport Operating Contract and Official Sheet
소유권, 보관자, 위치, 사용권, 예약과 담보를 따로 기록한다. 유산의: Ownership, custodian, location, usage rights, reservations, and collateral are recorded separately. A legal transfer of title for an inheritance does not substitute for physical arrival or receipt, and personal debts are not automatically assigned to heirs.
개인·기관·공동 자산과 인격체를 구분하고 자산별 권리·수량·위치를 읽는다: Distinguish individual, institutional, and joint assets from legal persons, and read the rights, quantity, and location of each asset.
Verify death and the eligibility of the governing jurisdiction's law, will, and allocation, while preserving any undetermined inheritance.
전체 자산의 명의만 이전하고 분할은 같은 단위와 물질 식별자의 보존을 검: Transfer only the title of the entire asset; for a split, check that the same units and material identifiers are preserved.
제안만으로 예약하지 않고 실제 수락 시점의 권한·가격·예약 충돌을 검사한: Do not reserve based on a proposal alone; check authority, price, and reservation conflicts at the moment of actual acceptance.
실제 도착과 수령 확인을 기록하고 같은 소비 경계의 포함 여부를 판정한다: Record actual arrival and receipt confirmation, and determine whether the same consumption boundary is included.
Preserve completed handovers and consumption, and re-check only the debts remaining under each contract.

실제 도착에 따른 전투 참가와 현재 지휘권을 구분한다. 개인 결과는 같은: Distinguish combat participation, based on actual arrival, from current command authority. Individual results are tallied in the same loss ledger, and unit totals do not create a second instance of damage. The Lite reference arithmetic is not an adoption of Seoul's real-time intervals or values.
Read the current identity, authority, arrival, observation, and engagement states.
전투가 진행 중인 실제 도착만 참가시키고 참가를 지휘권으로 바꾸지 않는다: Admit only actual arrivals while combat is in progress, and do not convert participation into command authority.
확정된 유효 명령만 현재 명령을 교체하며 미래 명령 대기열을 만들지 않는: Only confirmed valid orders replace the current order, and no queue of future orders is created.
Distinguish the reference calculations for resolution, defense, and damage from Seoul's undecided intervals and modifiers.
개인별 행동·대상 결과를 한 번 반영하고 부대 손실은 그 결과를 합산한다: Apply each individual's action and target results once, and unit losses are the sum of those results.
Record compliance and performance evaluation as separate event bases.

**동명이인 검색.** 전: 서로 다른 영구 ID의 두 사람이 같은 표시: **Homonym Search.** Before: Two people with different permanent IDs use the same display name. Action: The player finds candidates through a name search, reviews the distinguishing information, and selects one ID. After: Only that ID's records are referenced, and neither commands to another person nor treating the first name match as identity occurs. There is no need to prohibit name search.
**Lesson Interruption.** Before: A character has accumulated real education progress and consumed supplies. Action: The teacher dies before the next lesson, and the conditions for conducting it are rechecked. After: Completed progress and consumption remain, and the dead teacher does not continue to conduct lessons. Releasing or suspending future tool reservations is a policy alternative, not an alternative that erases past progress.
**분대장의 독자 행동.** 전: 본체 분대장이 상위 지휘관의 명령을 즉: **Squad Leader's Independent Action.** Before: The main-body squad leader receives a superior commander's order immediately. Action: The squad leader looks at actual feasibility and carries out the order in part or acts independently. After: Compliance and actual results are recorded separately, and the issuing commander remembers those results. A good result is not turned into compliance, and disobedience alone does not produce a fixed penalty.
**기준시각 뒤 증원.** 전: 전투가 진행되고 증원 부대가 정산 기준시: **Reinforcements After the Reference Time.** Before: A battle is in progress, and a reinforcing unit actually arrives after the settlement reference time. Action: The arrival is confirmed. After: The unit is not counted in the earlier reference-time tally, but participation in the ongoing battle is allowed. Exclusion from the earlier tally is not turned into a permanent movement state or a refusal of participation.
**유효 명분과 지정 수혜자.** 전: 공격자 갑이 수혜자 을의 주장을: **Valid Casus Belli and Designated Beneficiary.** Before: Attacker A supports the claim of beneficiary B, and B's consent, support contract, claim, target title, and eligibility to exercise are all valid. Action: A reaches W=100, and the casus belli and B's eligibility are rechecked at conclusion. After: The right designated in the casus belli transfers to B, and A's occupation alone does not make it A's personal right. Third-party rights outside the target are preserved, and on-site control, operator cooperation, and actual handover are checked separately.
**점수 종결 전에 무효가 된 명분.** 전: 개전 때 유효했던 명분이: **Casus Belli Invalidated Before Score Conclusion.** Before: A casus belli that was valid at the declaration of war is invalid at the conclusion check, and the attacking side's score is 100. Action: The conditions for invalidating the casus belli are checked first. After: No right is newly granted through a victory effect, and the return and residual rules for that casus belli apply. Costs for prisoners, ceasefire, and cancellation follow the casus belli policy and are not automatically replaced by the claim effects of a white peace enforcement.

The past action experience table, the announcement halving teacher and knowledge experience, and the usage-increase values in the historical data are different channels and cannot produce the current growth rate. The effective skill ×2 and ticket ×1.5 in cultural combat are non-equivalent mechanisms in different units. Per-action eligibility is not merged into a single universal lord eligibility. Seoul records the actual actions, education, and states under the same contract but does not transplant the source game's constants, probabilities, or roles as they are.
아래 선택지는 확정된 행동 규칙이 아니다. 플레이어에게 필요한 쓰임, 지: The options below are not finalized action rules. They compare the use players need, the intended outcome, the remaining gap, and the consequences of each choice. No option changes any boundary that has already been finalized.
**GP-01 개막 배치.** 쓰임은 생존 후보 선택 뒤 실제 시작 위치: **GP-01 Opening Placement.** The use is to determine the actual starting location after a surviving candidate is selected. The ideal is to keep all surviving candidates while preventing unfounded placement; the gaps are the starting constraints of age and detention and the handling of location conflicts. A keeps candidate eligibility and leaves only the conflicting location unresolved, deferring the starting placement. B shows the scenario's explicit substitute placement together with the basis for the original location. A avoids a wrong location but delays the start, while B raises the likelihood of starting but requires a basis for the substitute. For age and detention, the options remaining are one that does not exclude the candidate and one that keeps selection eligibility while only notifying of the actual starting constraints. Neither option selects a dead candidate or excludes a surviving candidate because of affiliation or position.
**GP-10 지식 접근.** 쓰임은 교사 상실 뒤 수업 재개와 시설 이: **GP-10 Knowledge Access.** The use is resuming lessons and using facilities after losing a teacher. The ideal is preserving actual access, progress, and consumption; the gaps are future reservations, access to records, and requirements by repair and crafting. A releases future reservations when the teacher is lost so that other learners can use the facility. B keeps valid reservations and suspends lessons to preserve the slot for resumption, but facility occupancy becomes longer. Which is possible, a teacher-centered path or a record- and tool-centered path, is undecided per skill and is not forced across all skills. Neither option erases past progress or consumption or automatically generates teachers or skills.
**GP-11 평가 정보.** 쓰임은 발신 지휘관의 후속 신임·배속 판단: **GP-11 Evaluation Information.** The use is the issuing commander's later judgments of trust and assignment. The ideal is separating compliance from performance and reflecting actual observation; the gaps are the display of incomplete evidence and re-evaluation after it is supplemented. A leaves only the insufficient items unresolved and shows the observed items. B shows the result provisionally and finalizes the evaluation after the evidence is supplemented. A provides a quick partial explanation and B a consistent full explanation, but finalization is delayed. Neither option imposes a fixed disobedience penalty, changes the issuer, or counts the same result twice. The numerical function is undecided.
**T68-D01-ISSUANCE 행동 이력과 시트.** 쓰임은 능력 기: **T68-D01-ISSUANCE Action History and Sheet.** The use is to understand the origin of ability records. The ideal is to distinguish, for each person, the actual action basis and the finalized versus undecided scope of the sheet; the gaps are the histories and values of additional characters. A shows that character's basis and undecided items on the individual sheet. B shows shared events together while marking each person's results separately. A makes the individual's scope clear but repeats common events, while B makes it easy to compare event context but can be confused with others' results. The two options are only alternatives for displaying information and not a choice of policy for issuing additional values, and participation in an event alone does not grant the same abilities to everyone.
**T68-PF-01 가치 축.** 쓰임은 인물의 욕구와 선택 근거를 이: **T68-PF-01 Value Axes.** The use is to understand a character's desires and the basis of their choices. The ideal is an explanation of values distinct from CP; the gaps are undecided values and narrative–quantity mismatches. A marks undecided values as unknown. B shows together the descriptions that have a basis and the undecided axes, distinguishing them. A reduces misunderstanding but offers less explanation, while B adds context for choices but requires distinguishing numbers from descriptions. Neither option uses undecided values as finalized behavior coefficients.
**T68-PF-03 인물 배경.** 쓰임은 출생 공동체·언어·생업·장비: **T68-PF-03 Character Background.** The use is to understand birth community, language, livelihood, and access to equipment. The ideal is to distinguish fact, inference, and unknown; the gap is the basis for each individual's background. A marks unconfirmed fields as unknown. B shows facts with a basis and inferences separately. A avoids false certainty, and B conveys more background, but inferences must not mix with facts. Neither option grants paid skills, CP, or equipment ownership on the basis of language markers or occupation alone.
**T68-PF-05 후보 정보.** 쓰임은 인물을 탐색하면서 선택 가능: **T68-PF-05 Candidate Information.** The use is, while exploring characters, to distinguish selectable targets from candidates that are still undecided. The ideal is a clear display of permanent ID, identity, and scope of use; the gap is the mismatch in identity, biography, and rights per candidate. A places undecided candidates in a separate list and does not link them to action targets. B links only finalized candidates to the selection list and leaves the rest as undecided information. A makes it easy to compare all candidates but has no action linkage, and B makes it easy to find usable targets but must be distinguished from the full list. The two options are ways of displaying candidates and do not grant registration, abilities, or rights because someone is on the roster.
**T68-PF-07 개인화와 생성.** 쓰임은 노동 집계에서 개인을 추: **T68-PF-07 Personalization and Generation.** The use is to track individuals within labor aggregates. The ideal is preserving population and labor along with actual training evidence; the gaps are newly generated triggers, age, candidates, and occupation-derived martial skills and values. A deals only with personalizing characters in existing aggregates. B treats the inflow of future new characters as a separate path while distinguishing the basis for inflow from the personalization of existing characters. A preserves clearly, and B can handle population changes in the world but additionally needs a generation policy. Neither option increases population through personalization or grants proficiency or unit eligibility through a generation marker alone. Generation rates and ability values are undecided.
11. 수치와 종결의 남은 간극: 11. Remaining Gaps in Values and Conclusion
능력·기술·파생치·TL·언어·전투·성장 함수와 추가 개인 시트 수치는 미: Ability, skill, derived-value, TL, language, combat, and growth functions and the values on additional individual sheets are undecided. 생활 행동은 인물의 실제 상태, 물자, 장소, 일정과 상대의 의사에 부딪: Daily-life actions are requests that run up against a character's actual condition, supplies, location, schedule, and the other party's will. This document separates the action boundaries that are settled from the design alternatives not yet chosen. The arithmetic for health, fatigue, mood, and rations, and the rules for carrying out treatment, are undecided.
플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 캠페인에 참여한다. NPC도 같은 행동 계약을: The player takes part in the campaign as a single main-body character. NPCs use the same action contract, and each action checks that actor's own actual condition. The main body is never duplicated or replaced with another character's state.
플레이어와 수행 가능한 NPC가 선택하는 생활 행동은 배급 신청, 물·식: The daily-life actions that the player and capable NPCs can choose are applying for rations, buying water and food, requesting lodging or treatment, resting, and attending an appointment. These are separate requests, so making a treatment request does not mean rations were received or rest was taken. A ration window checks eligibility and actual supplies, a seller checks supplies and trading authority, and a lodging or treatment provider checks location, skill, resources, and consent. Whether a request can be made differs from whether the service succeeds. Which provider accepts whose request, and the concrete rules for treatment methods and consent procedures, have not yet been chosen.
구금 주체의 계약은 허용된 면담·편지·교섭의 범위를 제한한다. 구금된 인: The contract of the detaining party limits the scope of permitted interviews, letters, and negotiations. A detained character cannot carry out free movement or field work on the grounds of needs or appointments. Roles in treatment, care, and command are confirmed through the current character and actual authority. Role samples from past state names, capitals, or succession methods are not used as the authority of a current treatment provider or the world ledger.
요청에는 행위자, 대상, 행동 종류, 권한 근거, 대상 원장 판본, 장소: A request needs an actor, a target, an action type, a basis of authority, the target ledger version, a location and contact route, conditions, resources, and a causing event. A target can be searched by name, but a name match alone does not establish that it is the same character. The permanent identifier resolves identity.
검사 순서는 대상 존재와 판본 → 생존·구금 등 수행 가능성 → 권한 →: The check order is: target existence and version → feasibility, such as being alive or detained → authority → actual location and delivery → resources and exclusive reservations → the other party's will and institutional procedure. If an action is impossible because of safety, physiology, or detention, needs and schedule cannot override that impossibility. A new total order among safety, physiology, and detention is not set. Injury is not a list that blanket-prohibits every action but a state that changes the conditions for performing each action. The amount of that change is undecided.
욕구와 일정이 충돌할 때 승인된 처분 이름은 보류·거절·교섭이다. 누가: When needs and schedule conflict, the approved dispositions are named Defer, Refuse, and Negotiate. Who chooses among them and under what conditions, as well as the acceptance probability and the re-evaluation order, are undecided. High trust cannot create a healer, water, or a place that does not exist, nor can it substitute for command authority, property rights, passage rights, or consent that are absent.
3. 행동 전·행동·행동 후: 3. Before the Action, the Action, and After the Action
행동 전에는 실제 행위자 상태, 요청 대상과 판본, 장소·전달, 자원과: Before the action, the actor's actual state, the request target and version, location and delivery, resources and reservations, and authority and consent are checked. The request is kept separate from the execution result. Only performance and consumption that actually took place during the action are recorded in the ledger that owns them. Merely recording a request does not improve health or mood or issue supplies. While treatment types and effect sizes are undecided, no success figures or recovery formulas are attached.
승인 뒤 실행 전에 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절 등이 생기면 예약된 작업을: If death, dismissal, occupation, loss of contact, or the like occurs after approval but before execution, the reserved work is checked again. In-world cancellation or death is not replaced with a rejection code from the record validator. Progress already completed and supplies already consumed are preserved, and the remaining resources are released under the relevant contract. D02 does not take over ownership of death, succession, release from detention, or property settlement.
수행 불가능, 권한 부재, 미도착, 물자 부족, 예약 충돌, 동의 부재는: Infeasibility, lack of authority, non-arrival, shortage of supplies, reservation conflict, and absence of consent are each failure reasons at their respective check stages. A failed request is not turned into successful treatment, nor retried under another person's identity. Re-sending the same causing event does not produce a new result, and a completed result is not applied again. This does not mean it is permanently forbidden to file the same daily-life request again with a new cause.
불러오기는 일관된 저장 경계의 현재 단계와 예약을 복원한다. 종료·불러오: Loading restores the current stage and reservations at a consistent save boundary. Quitting and loading are not in-world death or departure. A version mismatch or a corrupted save is an explicit error, and there is no silent renumbering, mixing of rules, or substitution with a new campaign. A failed request or an unchosen disposition likewise does not erase or change the main body or the permanent identifier.
실행 판단은 행위자의 실제 상태를 읽지만, 그것이 플레이어에게 모든 NP: Execution judgments read the actor's actual state, but that does not mean every NPC's private health and needs are revealed to the player. Information that a request was observed differs from information that treatment was actually carried out. The target name is for searching, and homonyms and name changes are still distinguished by the permanent identifier. Provider authority, available locations, supplies that have actually arrived, and consent are each confirmed separately, and neither trust nor historical rosters can substitute for them. The specific scope of information disclosure and the update interval remain as undecided alternatives.
생활 상태는 전투 수행 가능성의 입력이 될 수 있으나 지휘권을 만들어 주: Daily-life state can be an input to combat feasibility, but it does not create command authority. The combat commander's main body commands all attached squads within the registered command scope. A main-body squad leader receives system orders immediately but may choose to follow, partially carry out, or act independently. Impossible performance is distinguished from arbitrary disobedience, and compliance from results, and these are left as an assessment of the commander character. No fixed trust penalty is set. No pause, speed control, or order queue is added to combat. Any unit that actually arrives is eligible to join as reinforcement, and daily-life state does not newly create restrictions based on the initial roster, origin, or rank. A war's valid casus belli, goal limits, ±100 forced termination, and separate negotiation are the boundaries of D16, and D02 does not convert health or mood into war score. At termination, demands are not applied on score alone; the casus belli and the current eligibility of the explicitly named beneficiary are rechecked first. If the casus belli's basis has disappeared, the invalidation rules for that casus belli are checked, so ±100 does not make an invalid casus belli valid. If A wins to restore the claim of an eligible character B, the beneficiary of the right is the B named in the casus belli, and A does not receive all the occupied territory. D02's treatment and ration requests do not carry out this transfer of rights on its behalf.
소유와 D02의 역할: Ownership and the Role of D02
D01 신원과 D12 사망·후계·본체 전환. D02는 실제 행위자를 참조: D01 owns identity, and D12 owns death, succession, and main-body transition. D02 references the actual actor.
건강·욕구·기분·부상 조건: Health, Needs, Mood, and Injury Conditions
Design subject of D02. Figures, recovery, mood changes, and the amount of change in injury conditions are undecided.
D03. D02 checks the available time and valid orders.
D04. The points of contact are ration applications and the effect of health on labor; the specific quantities are undecided.
D05; actual movement and arrival belong to D06. D02 reads only what is actually available.
D07. It passes on observed performance but does not create a trust-change formula.
D10 및 관련 소유 계약. 권리 보유 가능성과 지금 이 행동의 유효 권: D10 and the related ownership contracts. The possibility of holding a right is distinguished from the authority actually valid for this action now.
D12·D13의 법적 구금/본체 경계, D16 전쟁 포로 장부. 영구 구: The legal detention/main-body boundary of D12 and D13, and the war prisoner ledger of D16. Permanent detention is not death. D02 reads the permitted scope.
D15·D16. 생활 조건의 수행 가능성을 전달하며 지휘·증원·전쟁 종결: D15 and D16. It conveys the feasibility of living conditions and does not redefine command, reinforcement, or war termination.
소비 마감 이하에 검증된 도착분은 그 마감에 포함한다. 같은 시각이면 도: Verified arrivals at or before the consumption cutoff are included in that cutoff. If the times are the same, reservation, production, and consumption follow after arrival verification. Supplies that arrive after a cutoff are excluded only from that cutoff, and even after they actually arrive they do not remain permanently in transit. The details of the cutoff interval, split cargo, and total order have not yet been decided.
예 1: 다친 인물의 치료 요청: Example 1: An Injured Character's Treatment Request
전: 숙소에서 쉬기로 한 일정이 남아 있으나 다친 몸이 현재 장소에서 치: Before: A schedule to rest at the lodging remains, but the injured body does not meet the conditions to receive treatment at the current location. There is also no healer, space, or water. Action: The character files a treatment request. Judgment: Safety, physiology, and the actual location and resources are checked. The rest schedule, thirst, and high trust cannot create treatment conditions that do not exist. After: The request does not become treatment, and the injured state and the schedule remain as they were. Who chooses among Defer, Refuse, and Negotiate is undecided, so this example does not choose a disposition. It also does not assume whether the character is detained.
예 2: 구금 중 약속 참석: Example 2: Attending an Appointment While Detained
전: 약속 장소는 자유 이동을 요구하지만 해당 인물의 구금 계약은 그 이: Before: The appointment location requires free movement, but the character's detention contract does not allow that movement. Action: The character requests to attend the appointment. Judgment: The permitted scope of detention takes precedence over needs and schedule. After: Attendance is not carried out. Permitted interviews, letters, and negotiations are each separate requests and are not automatic substitute actions. Even if a disposition has not yet been chosen, the character, main body, and permanent identifier are retained.
예 3: 치료 요청 기록의 재전송: Example 3: Re-sending a Treatment Request Record
전: 인물의 치료 요청이 관찰되었지만 치료 시행은 확인되지 않았다. 행동: Before: A character's treatment request was observed, but the carrying out of treatment was not confirmed. Action: The request record for the same causing event is delivered again. Judgment: It is checked whether the result has already been completed. After: No new result or additional consumption arises from the same cause. The mere existence of a record does not raise health or select a medication or procedure. Another person's record with the same name has a different permanent identifier, so it is not merged into the same request.
예 4: 승인 뒤 중단과 늦은 도착: Example 4: Interruption After Approval and Late Arrival
전: 생활 서비스 작업에 이미 완료한 진척과 소비한 물자가 있고 남은 예: Before: A daily-life service job has progress already completed and supplies already consumed, with a reservation remaining. The supply cargo actually arrives after this consumption cutoff. Action: During execution, an in-world cancellation occurs or the actor dies. Judgment: The remaining performance is checked again and passed on to the ownership contracts for reservation, death, and settlement. After: Completed progress and consumption are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released under the contract. The cargo that arrived late is not retroactively included in the past cutoff, but the fact of its arrival remains and becomes subject to later availability checks. No new recovery rate, refund rate, or consumption cycle is assumed.
8. 두 원작의 현재 검증 근거와 서울 적용 경계: 8. Current Verification Basis from the Two Source Games and the Boundary of Application to Seoul
**Crusader Kings III, 1.20.0.3 / build 2: **Crusader Kings III, 1.20.0.3 / build 25652598:** In the material re-evaluating D02's 13 source occurrences and 97 citations, we distinguish 10 document claims, 2 unresolved native mechanisms (C01 mortality, C12 disabled harm.2051), and 1 finite non-equivalent counterpart (C11). C01 is read according to the define, not the check interval in the comment. The serious illness treatment C05 removes the trait directly and applies a cooldown and immunity, which distinguishes it from the recovery path of ordinary treatment. C11's EP3 condition of stored amount ≤ 0.6 of the maximum and its 10-year dehydration stage are conditions of the source game, not Seoul's water stock or daily consumption. Age-related expenses and incapacity flags, callback and lower-bound delays, the selected coping chain, and treatment weights are read only within the limits stated in the material. The other party's weight is not treated unconditionally as an acceptance probability. The branch, active DLC, and mods are unconfirmed. In Seoul it is used as comparative material for separating treatment request, execution, and recovery, and the source game's figures are not adopted.
D01은 인물의 영구 신원과 능력·기술·특성 기록을 다룬다. 플레이어는: D01 covers a character's permanent identity and the records of their abilities, skills, and traits. The player acts as one primary character per campaign. NPCs are other characters who use the same action contracts for movement, labor, education, politics, and combat. Being the primary character does not grant anyone else's body or authority. The primary character, squad leader, combat commander, rights holder, and institutional officer are distinct roles, and one character may hold several of them. States and institutions own the procedures for offices, rights, and property, and a character sheet does not manufacture success for an institutional procedure that has not been filled in.
능력, 숙련, 특성, 일시적 상황 보정, 직위, 작위, 점유, 실효 통제: Abilities, proficiencies, traits, temporary situational modifiers, offices, titles of nobility, possession, effective control, and military command are kept distinct. Holding a public office does not turn an institution's treasury into personal property or assign every troop to the holder. The Sumun State monarch's election by contract council, the Central Technology Preservation Institute director's selection by examination, and the Register Church session moderator's confirmation of elders are procedures defined in the setting, not ability-score formulas.
개막에는 살아 있는 개막 인물 전체 가운데 한 사람을 본체로 고른다. 소: At the opening, one person is chosen as the primary character from among all living opening characters. Candidates are not excluded for having or lacking an affiliation or office. Dead characters are not candidates for the opening primary character. Selection eligibility is kept separate from the basis for the actual starting location. The handling policy for age and detention restrictions and for location conflicts is unapproved. The concrete method for recording and registering the primary character link is also undecided. These gaps do not invalidate the primary character selection itself or the meaning of the permanent ID.
진행 중 플레이어는 본체의 행동과 유효한 지휘 권한을 통해 관여한다. N: During play, the player engages through the primary character's actions and valid command authority. Being able to see an NPC or search for their name is not enough to force that NPC to act. For each action, the following are checked: survival, detention, and actual capability to perform it; authority; location or transmission; resources and reservations; the other party's will; and institutional procedure. High trust does not make a physically impossible action possible. Existing designated genders are kept, and unspecified values remain undetermined until set in each state's own setup.
3. 신원과 독자에게 보이는 정보: 3. Identity and Information Visible to the Reader
이름은 검색·탐색에 쓰고, 같은 이름의 후보가 있으면 구분 정보를 보고: Names are used for search and browsing, and when candidates share the same name, the reader checks the distinguishing information and selects the character with the corresponding permanent ID. Final identity is determined by the stable character ID, not by the name string. Renaming or having a namesake is not a reason to reissue an ID. Character and event IDs are permanent. Only identities that have already been approved are treated as registered identities, and identity verification alone does not issue a new character or any rights.
현재 세계의 생존·장소·소속·권한은 해당 세계 원장과 적용 판본을 읽는다: The current world's survival, location, affiliation, and authority are read from that world's ledger and the applicable version. A past approved register is the basis for confirming historical identity in that version and is not the authority on current world state. The historical record of a dead person can be found, but finding that record does not amount to resurrection, permission to act, or selection as the primary character. Record version conflicts and incompatible saves are reported explicitly and are not covered over by automatic renumbering, migration, or mixing of rules.
플레이어에게는 대상, 현재 알려진 상태와 그 근거 시점, 수행 자격, 권: The player must be shown the target, the currently known state and the point in time on which it is based, eligibility to perform the action, the scope of authority, and the reason for refusal or pending status, each kept distinct. This information requirement is not a rule that discloses every private state of other characters. D01 does not newly establish a worldwide information-disclosure policy. Use of names and portraits is limited to the recorded project scope and does not add any right to reuse them in external derivative works.
전: 행위자와 대상 ID, 행동 종류, 권한 근거, 원장 판본, 장소·연: Before: Confirm the actor and target IDs, the action type, the basis of authority, the ledger version, the location and contact route, conditions, resources, and the causing event. The order of checks is: target existence and version → capability such as survival and detention → authority → actual location and transmission → resources and exclusive reservations → the other party's will and institutional procedure. Identity verification is the basis for identity within this sequence and does not substitute for the remaining checks.
실행: 유효한 조건에서 실제 행동을 수행한다. 기술별 교육은 실제 진척을: Execution: Carry out the actual action under valid conditions. Skill-specific education requires real progress, and whether a teacher, records, tools, a location, and a learner are needed is declared item by item. The same required conditions are not imposed on every skill, and a skill is not unlocked merely by holding a document. Identifying an individual from an aggregate population is not the creation of a new person, and the same person is not double-booked for two tasks at the same time.
후: 실제 완료 결과와 진척, 소비, 사건·결과의 동일성을 기록한다. 동: After: Record the actual completion result and progress, consumption, and the identity of the event and its outcome. Resending the same event does not recreate the result. New abilities, skills, and derived values have not yet been finalized. Having a history of actual actions alone does not grant undetermined values.

9.1 전쟁·협상 명령의 소비 경계: 9.1 Consumption Boundary of War and Negotiation Commands
전쟁 생성 요청은 먼저 등록 명분의 유효성을 검사하며, 유효한 명분이 없: A war creation request first checks the validity of the registered casus belli. If there is no valid casus belli, it is rejected before reaching the forced-termination point or negotiation calculation. If an in-progress casus belli has already become invalid because its basis changed, the invalidity conditions are checked before the ±100 forced termination, so the score never creates a right that has no basis (sp1.b121). A person without an office may hold a casus belli, but that alone grants no authority to declare war, no troops, and no command authority (sp1.b118). War score ranges from -100 to 100, and the opponent's score has the opposite sign. At ±100, a forced termination limited to the target scope of the casus belli version takes effect first, any pending negotiation proposal is discarded, and no further damage or asset demands pile up while waiting for a response (sp1.b119, b121, b127–b128). Below an absolute value of 100, item-by-item negotiation, which is a Seoul-specific extension, can be proposed. Unregistered price items block signing and settlement, and only validly registered items can be negotiated. Even though the evaluation structure subtracts the total offered price from the total demanded price, `V ≤ W` is not automatic acceptance. The price and acceptance coefficients are undecided, and signing authority, the parties' authority to dispose of assets, actual feasibility of performance, and whether the same asset is demanded twice are checked separately. The sale of people, forced marriage, and non-consensual reassignment cannot be negotiation items. After an agreement, the transfer of assets, persons, and units must go through actual delivery and movement, and is not completed instantly by the command record alone (sp1.b124–b128). D03 only consumes this result and does not create prices, distribution, or disposal authority.
주장 지원 전쟁을 요청할 때는 승인하는 수장과 권리를 받을 수혜자를 구분: When requesting a claimant-support war, distinguish between the chief who approves it and the beneficiary who will receive the rights. The beneficiary found by name is fixed to a stable person identifier and pinned to the casus belli, and that person's consent, affiliation/support contract, claim validity, target title, and institutional eligibility to exercise it are checked. The victory right transfers to that beneficiary and is not personally held by the attacker in their place. For example, even if a hypothetical claimant, Kim Harin, asks a chief for support, Kim Harin's eligibility and designation as beneficiary must be confirmed, and the chief does not take Kim Harin's rights merely because the chief won. The actual rank of the title the beneficiary gains and the superior relationship are rechecked through the higher-level contract, and equal or higher rights are not automatically converted into a lower vassal relationship (sp1.b118, b119, sp1.reference.beneficiary).
아래 사례는 승인된 규칙을 적용한 가상 상황이다. 플레이어가 고르는 행위: The examples below are hypothetical situations that apply approved rules. They show the actions the player chooses, the checks, and the actual results, and they are neither proof of execution nor a confirmed cast.
10.1 전투 신호 — 하달에서 기록까지: 10.1 Combat Signal — From Issuance to Record
**Before**: The player's only avatar is a squad leader, and the superior commander is an NPC. The avatar's squad is within that commander's registered assignment scope, and there is no in-progress order record.
**요청**: NPC 지휘관이 전장 안의 후방 이동을 하달한다. 플레이어: **Request**: The NPC commander issues an order for a rearward movement within the battlefield. As the avatar squad leader, the player chooses partial execution.
**사건**: 신호는 전령·무전을 거치지 않고 즉시 닿는다. 수신에 세계: **Event**: The signal arrives instantly without passing through a messenger or radio. The reception leaves the world time, order identifier, sending commander, target squad, purpose, permitted scope, and version. Because the target is within the registered assignment scope, the action of this order is permitted. The squad leader carries out a movement that avoids the danger zone through partial execution. The order does not lock input, the battle does not stop, and the signal is not queued.
**후**: 고른 선택과 그 뒤의 실제 수행이 현재 상태로 남고, 평가자: **After**: The choice made and the actual execution that follows remain as the current state, and the evaluator remembers the sender and the result identifier. An evaluation with the same result identifier is not applied twice. The squad's rearward movement is a movement within the battlefield, not a withdrawal from the whole battle or a departure from participation. If the avatar is instead the superior commander, it can give direct orders to all assigned squads even if a separate NPC squad leader exists (sp1.b111). Movement time and the amount of evaluation change are not set by this example.
10.2 전략 원격 명령 — 전달·수신·수락의 구분: 10.2 Strategic Remote Orders — Distinguishing Delivery, Reception, and Acceptance
**전**: 보낸 이는 받는 이에게 이미 맡긴 지휘 범위가 있고 그 위임: **Before**: The sender has already entrusted a command scope to the recipient, and that delegation is valid. The recipient is in a different place.
**Request**: The sender announces a movement within that scope remotely.
**사건**: 전령, 무전, 연락망 중 그때 열려 있는 실제 경로를 따라: **Event**: The order moves along whichever actual route is open at that time among messenger, radio, and communication network. The recipient receives it, has no incapacity from safety, physiological, or detention causes, and accepts it if it fits their needs and schedule. If there is a conflict, it remains as one of hold, refusal, or negotiation.
**후**: 수락한 명령만 실행으로 넘어간다(상태열 `수신 → 수락 →: **After**: Only an accepted order moves on to execution (status column `susin → surak → yeyak → silhaeng`, i.e. received → accepted → scheduled → executed). Delivery, receipt itself, and acceptance are separate stages, so the mere fact that an order was delivered does not start its performance. Travel time, transmission cost, and acceptance probability have not been decided.
10.3 실패 — 경로 부재와 수신 전 권한 소멸: 10.3 Failure — Absence of a Route and Loss of Authority Before Reception
**Before**: The delegation was valid at the time of sending. Failure can occur in two branches.
**갈래 A(경로 없음)**: 쓸 수 있는 전령·무전·연락망이 없다. 실: **Branch A (no route)**: There is no usable messenger, radio, or communication network. Since there is no actual contact route, there is no reception, and neither the receipt of the order nor the execution result of that order occurs. The recipient's independent life and movement continue.
**갈래 B(권한 소멸)**: 명령이 닿기 전에 위임이 만료·회수되었거나: **Branch B (authority lost)**: Before the order arrives, the delegation has expired or been revoked, or the sender has lost that scope. The arriving order has its authority rechecked and is not executed. Materials already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed, and only the remaining reservations are released according to the contract.
