6. 정본 산문의 표본 시나리오 — 국경을 넘는 동의·인준: 6. Sample Scenario from the Canonical Prose — Cross-Border Consent and Ratification
This scenario is a verbatim transcription of canonical prose b27–b31 (【Approved】).
**전**: 두 사람이 살아 있고 서로 다른 나라에 속한다. 각 나라의: **Before**: Two people are alive and belong to different states. Each state has its own marriage regime. Which regime applies to this pair is unknown. Each has their own claims, property, and positions. Starting from the circumstance in which the marriage is not yet established is an **assumption** of this step, not a conclusion drawn from not knowing the regime.

The claim and territory restrictions attached only to an established marriage apply only after establishment is confirmed. Next, if one person loses their position while still alive, only that position's signing, command, and operation stop, and the loss of position does not determine the marriage's establishment or effects.

When someone dies, the survivors' family and romantic relationships and mourning events remain. Relationship modifiers are not decided here.

However, this is not a rebellion that necessarily happens every day. 작위와 직위 이력, 권리 분쟁, 약속의 이행과 위반, 포로와 부상과 사망: The following are stored: peerage and office history, rights disputes, the fulfillment and breach of promises, captivity, injury, and death, marriage and kinship, education progress, disclosed evidence, property and debts, truce and war outcomes, witnessing and memory, and current trust. Later actions read these facts again. Loading a save and switching bodies do not reset these records.
6.6 영구 저장은 영원한 고정이 아니다: 6.6 Permanent Storage Is Not Permanent Fixation
영구 저장은 모든 감정이 영원히 고정된다는 뜻이 아니다. 회복, 화해,: Permanent storage does not mean every emotion is fixed forever. Effects with recovery, reconciliation, changes in mourning, or an expiry period are stored together with their rules and end times. The forgetting and decay function is pending confirmation. 6.7 관계 사건의 원천과 기록: 6.7 Sources and Records of Relationship Events
함께 시간 보내기, 치료·구조, 계약 이행/위반, 선물·거래, 공개 지지: The sources of relationship events are spending time together, treatment and rescue, contract fulfillment or breach, gifts and trade, public support and insults, exposure, detention and release, and marriage, adoption, and death. For each event, the actor, target, harm/benefit, witness/report, secrecy scope, and basis are recorded. Modifiers use confirmed rules, and if undecided, no arbitrary number is entered.
직위가 비면 그 직위의 서명, 지휘, 운영만 멈춘다. 산 사람의 개인 생: When an office becomes vacant, only that office's signing, command, and operation stop. The personal life and movement of living people and separately valid contracts are judged under each party's own capacity. A vacancy does not cause property to be transferred, a successor to be determined, or a deputy to be appointed. Succession, body, office, and property are different outcomes.
평가 입력은 명령의 목적, 수신 시점, 수행 가능성, 분대 상태, 본체의: The evaluation inputs are the order's purpose, time of receipt, feasibility, squad state, the main body's actual actions, contribution to the objective, losses, civilian harm, and changes/cancellations by a higher order. The evaluation result is attributed to the commanding character and becomes the basis for the memory of that squad's body and for later assignment and trust decisions. The relationship-change function, numbers, and promotion/discipline conditions are undecided, and no fixed trust penalty is automatically applied for disobedience.
The following are preserved even amid failure and interruption.
같은 결과 식별자는 한 번만 적용한다. 다시 도착한 평가는 두 번째 변화: The same result identifier is applied only once. An evaluation that arrives again does not produce a second change.

승인과 실행 사이에 사망, 해임, 점령, 연락 두절이 생기면 예약된 일을: If death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the scheduled work is checked again. Supplies already spent and progress already made are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released according to the contract.
동시에 걸린 권리 변경은 하나의 원장 판본에서 판단하고, 정해진 수락 순: Rights changes filed at the same time are judged against a single ledger version, and conflicts are resolved by a set order of acceptance.
지휘관이 바뀌면 기존 명령과 평가는 원래 발신자와 이력을 유지한 채 남고: When the commander changes, existing orders and evaluations remain with their original sender and history intact, and are checked again under the new commander's authority.
신뢰가 바뀌어도 계약, 빚, 맹세, 혼인, 직위, 재산은 그대로다. 직위: Even when trust changes, contracts, debts, oaths, marriages, offices, and property remain as they are. 현재 정보는 관측과 보고로 얻고, 그 시각과 함께 저장한다. 같은 정보를: Current information is obtained through observation and reports, and is stored together with its time. The same information is not produced repeatedly as a fixed resource reward.
같은 시작값과 같은 선택 기록으로 다시 돌리면 같은 세계 상태와 같은 사: Replaying with the same starting values and the same choice record must yield the same world state and the same event record. The randomness of combat, encounters, the world, and characters are separate streams. The random numbers that pick names use only the character stream. The processing order of one stream does not change the results of another stream. Relationship judgments do not disturb the results of other streams.
이름은 검색에 쓰고, 동명이인·이름 변경 뒤에도 같은 인물인지 확정하는: Names are used for search, and the permanent character identifier is used to confirm whether it is the same character despite homonyms or name changes. **모르면 바뀌지 않는다.** 평가 주체가 관측·보고로 사건을 알게 된: **What is not known does not change.** The evaluating subject updates its own trust and memory only at the moment it learns of an event through observation or reports. There is no mechanism by which the world instantly knows of a hidden betrayal. Direct harm and public reputation are distinguished, and no fixed personality or betrayal probability is assigned to a state.
**관계는 판단 입력이지 권한이 아니다.** 관계는 면담 수락, 위험 업: **A relationship is a decision input, not authority.** A relationship is a decision input for accepting an interview, accepting risky duties, supporting a successor, accepting a teacher, testifying, and for targets of protection, concealment, defection, and conspiracy. High trust does not create command authority, property rights, consent, or right of passage that do not exist.
**관계가 변해도 계약은 스스로 끝나지 않는다.** 관계가 변해도 기존: **A contract does not end by itself when a relationship changes.** Even when a relationship changes, an existing contract changes only through its termination clauses and action events. That a friend has become an enemy does not automatically void all trades and unit assignments at that moment. For a contract to end, it needs that contract's own termination conditions and a later action.
**사망이 지우지 않는 것.** 사망 시 생존자의 가족/연인 관계와 애도: **What death does not erase.** When someone dies, the survivors' family/romantic relationships and mourning events remain. Only the deceased's personal trust is not copied to the successor.
이 영역은 아는 사람의 기억과 신뢰, 군주에 대한 충성, 그리고 명령 하: This domain covers the memory and trust of people one knows, loyalty to the ruler, and the record of compliance and performance for a single order. The following are not decided here.

This document only states that a squad leader who receives a combat directive may follow it, follow only part of it, or act independently, and that when needs and schedules collide, the result is left as deferral, refusal, or negotiation.
**관측 시각(D06).** 정보를 언제 관측하고 보고하는지는 D06의: **Observation Time (D06).** When information is observed and reported belongs to D06. **후계·몸의 전환(계승 도메인).** 후계와 몸의 전환 절차와 새 몸이: **Succession and Body Transfer (Succession Domain).** The procedures for succession and body transfer, and who the new body is, belong to that domain. What this document decides is that the deceased's personal trust is not copied to the successor.
**전투 신호와 전투 계산(전투 도메인).** 개인 공격, 방어, 피해,: **Combat Signals and Combat Calculation (Combat Domain).** Individual attacks, defense, damage, injury, and the allocation of losses belong to the combat domain. This document covers only the receipt of signals, the separation of compliance and performance, and the ban on applying the same result twice. Until the calculation of individual combat power, health, fatigue, and derived values is decided, evaluation results do not newly allocate injuries or losses.
**난수 흐름 분리(저장·재현 도메인).** 흐름 분리 자체는 저장과 재: **Random Stream Separation (Save and Replay Domain).** Stream separation itself belongs to the save and replay domain. This document takes in only the rule that relationship judgments do not disturb the results of other streams.
**국가별 제도(D09 계열).** 혼인, 맹세, 지휘 관계의 성립과 종: **National Systems (D09 Series).** The national systems that determine how marriage, oaths, and command relationships are established and ended belong to the state and institutions domain. While a country's system is unknown, such a relationship cannot be established from recorded facts alone.

가까운 가족의 사망 기억은 **기억 소유자**를 기준으로 조건을 평가하며: The memory of a close family member's death evaluates its conditions based on the **memory owner**, and the owner and the deceased are separate. Its duration is declared as `5 + 125·R + 25·D + 25·PR + 25·PF + 25·PW + 195·PP` years. `R` is 1 if the memory owner, or any of the owner's close family or spouse, is a ruler, and 0 otherwise. `D` is 1 if the memory owner's highest held title tier (`highest_held_title_tier`) is duke or above. The range is not changed by the deceased's title tier. `PR` is 1 if there is any rival relationship between the memory owner and the player, and it is not a condition exclusive to nemesis. `PF` is the player being a friend. `PW` is 1 if, among the wards connected to the memory owner by `any_relation type=ward`, at least one is the player. `PP` is the condition that the memory owner or a parent is the player. Each Boolean term is added only once even when multiple persons qualify. It is not of the form "base memory 10 years," nor a separate preservation for a deceased owner, nor a +1000 years preservation for a player character. The memory retention period is not opinion decay. For example, if the memory owner is a count and the deceased close family member is a ruling duke, then when all other player conditions are false, `R=1, D=0`, so it is `5+125=130` years, not `155`. Conversely, if the memory owner is a duke, `D=1` even when the deceased is not a ruler or is below duke rank.
관계 기여는 소유자→대상 방향으로 친구 +60, 가장 친한 친구 +120: Relationship contributions, in the owner→target direction, are friend +60, best friend +120, rival -60, nemesis -120, mentor +20, and student +30. The reciprocal correspondence of friend and rival, and of mentor and student, does not mean the opposite-direction opinions are equal. There is no corresponding declaration for grudges. This declaration alone does not mean every relationship is permanent.

The notice event itself has no numeric opinion effect, but exposure is separate, and a surviving non-self exposer receives an owner→exposer opinion effect of -30 for 20 years. 승리 충성 확률 35%→10%와 Command 단계별 +1%포인트(N-D: The victory loyalty probability change from 35% to 10% and the +1 percentage point per Command level (N-D07-09), and the halved frequency of political actions and sermons by player-faction politicians with a ruler relationship above 0 (N-D07-10), are local conditions of each notice. Reduced notifications are not effect deduplication, and a previous ruler keeping their own followers is not the successor inheriting relationships. The engine's summation, rounding, randomness, decay timing, and update cycle have not been confirmed.
아래 여섯 항은 플레이가 달라지는 질문이다. 답을 이 문서에서 고르지 않: The six items below are questions that change how the game plays. This document does not choose the answers. Each item has a question, the currently confirmed boundary, consumer use, ideal outcome, current gap, reason it is open, and verification (QA) tracks.
12.1 관계·평가의 증감·감쇠·지속 (T68-D07-EVALUATION: 12.1 Relationship and Evaluation Gain/Loss, Decay, and Duration (T68-D07-EVALUATION-DECAY/relation-evaluation)
**질문.** 어떤 일을 누가 책임지는가(직접 본 일과 보고로 안 일을: **Question.** Who is responsible for an event (to which character's trust or memory should things they saw directly and things they learned through reports be attributed)? Which events raise or lower trust, loyalty, mood, and memory? How does memory fade? How long must loyalty stay below 25 before a path to rebellion or defection opens? Which actions count as risky actions?
**현재 확정 경계.** 방향성 `T`, 구간 `25/−25/−50`,: **Currently confirmed boundary.** Only the following are approved: directionality `T`, the thresholds `25/−25/−50`, loyalty `0..100` (ruler 100), updates at the time of observation, separate records, and the ban on transitions for tribes without gain or loss.
**대안 갈래.** (a) 귀속 — 직접 목격=행위자 직접 귀속 / 보고: **Alternative tracks.** (a) Attribution — direct witness = direct attribution to the actor / report = reflects report timing and report path / the attributed party in chained reports. (b) Gain/loss — fixed table by event type / evidence weighting (witnessed versus reported) / asymmetry by value range. (c) Decay — expires after a fixed period / monotonic decay function / reset at update time. (d) Loyalty duration — gate of N consecutive days below / path opens when first falling below, followed by recovery conditions. This document chooses none of the tracks.
**소비자 활용.** 플레이어는 사건을 알게 된 인물이 누구에게 왜 반응: **Consumer use.** The player reads who a character who learned of an event reacts to and why, and whether that reaction is recorded in trust, loyalty, or memory, then decides the next interview or contract action. The player should be able to tell whether recovery, reconciliation, or change over time is possible, and under what conditions. Gain/loss amounts or recovery periods that are not yet decided are distinguished as unknown values.
**이상적 결과.** 같은 사건을 알고 반응한 인물의 정보 취득 시점과: **Ideal outcome.** For a character who learned of and reacted to the same event, the time they acquired the information and the target of their reaction are visible, and direct harm, public reputation, trust and loyalty, and memory persistence are distinguished. Recoverable effects can be understood through defined recovery conditions and end points, and undecided change amounts and durations are not shown as if they were confirmed results.
**현재 공백.** 증감량, 감쇠 곡선, 지속 기간, 위험 행동 문턱의: **Current gap.** There are no values for gain/loss amounts, decay curves, durations, or the risky-action threshold. The corresponding values in external references (CK3 `+25/0.05`, pre-replacement Norland loyalty) are only comparison baselines.
**미결 사유.** 사건별 변화량과 지속 기간은 아직 결정되지 않았기 때: **Reason open.** Per-event change amounts and durations have not yet been decided. Setting the existing thresholds does not by itself determine new change amounts.
**QA.** 같은 시작 상태·관측 시점·선택 기록으로 같은 사건을 알게: **QA.** Compare the before and after records of characters who learned of the same event, using the same starting state, observation time, and choice record. If the change amount is undecided, distinguish the fact that the event was learned from the undecided numeric result, and do not compute the undecided value as 0. Even if the same `ResultId` arrives again, the second reaction is not applied, and the trust and memory of an observer who does not yet know of the event are not changed by it. When trust is exactly `25/−25/−50`, the fixed classification conditions are maintained. Loyalty `0/100` are the two ends of the approved range and the ruler's own loyalty is `100`; exactly `25` is not `below 25`. Even when loyalty is `below 25`, rebellion or defection is not immediately confirmed while the duration is undecided. In comparing recovery and expiry alternatives, check that the event history remains and only the end conditions of the effects defined in each alternative differ.
**질문.** 명령 평가에서 지휘권, 관측된 입력, 준수와 성과, 결과: **Question.** In command evaluation, how should command authority, observed input, compliance and performance, and the result identifier be connected? Utility coefficients and casualty formulas are not the answer to this question.
**현재 확정 경계.** 수신 기록 일곱 필드, 세 갈래 선택, 준수·성: **Currently confirmed boundary.** Only the following are approved: the seven fields of the receipt record, the three-way choice, the separation of compliance and performance, attribution to the commander, idempotency of the result identifier, and the distinction between execution failure and disobedience.
**대안.** 명령마다 준수·성과·불능 사유를 즉시 함께 표시하거나, 전: **Alternatives.** Either display compliance, performance, and the reason for inability together immediately for each command, or group and display the same command history after battle. The former lets the player read the basis for judgment right away, and the latter reduces the information burden during play. The display timing does not newly create the time of acquiring knowledge of an event or any numeric judgment.
**소비자 활용·이상·공백·사유·QA.** 플레이어는 실패 원인과 독자: **Consumer use, ideal, gap, reason, and QA.** The player distinguishes the cause of failure from the result of independent action, and the ideal outcome is that inability is not mistaken for discipline. The gap is the rule that combines the nine evaluation inputs into a single judgment, and its presentation (what the main body looks at). The reason it is open is that interface policy is an owner decision. QA requires a classification cross-check of cases of impossibility, defiance, and partial execution, and a case of idempotency when the result identifier is resent. The battle-calculation part of this sub-decision (individual judgment and loss allocation) is on hold pending the Basic source text (Chapter 13).
12.3 인물 가치 축의 관계·평가 사용 (T68-PF-01/cast-v: 12.3 Use of Character Value Axes in Relationships and Evaluation (T68-PF-01/cast-values)
**Question.** Should a character's value axes be used in relationships and evaluation?
**Currently confirmed boundary.** None — this is only a proposal and has not been approved.
**대안.** 가치 축을 설명·대사에만 쓰거나, 사건의 책임 판단 입력에: **Alternatives.** Use the value axes only in descriptions and dialogue, or also as input to judging responsibility for events. The former shows differences between characters without numeric effect, and the latter produces differences in evaluating the same fact. Neither has been chosen.
**소비자 활용.** 플레이어는 같은 사건을 서로 다른 인물이 다르게 설: **Consumer use.** The player can read why different characters explain or take responsibility for the same event differently. The **ideal outcome** is that, if the value axes are adopted, differences in dialogue and judgment show, but unapproved axes do not secretly change trust values. The **gap** is which axis to use as input for explaining or judging responsibility for which event. The **reason** is that both the values themselves and the way they are used are in proposal status. **QA** compares cases for the same observed fact in which `T` is the same under the `description and dialogue only differ` alternative, and the result differs under the `responsibility-judgment input` alternative only when it passes through an approved event rule.
12.4 조직 가치·정책의 충성·평가 사용 (T68-PF-02/organ: 12.4 Use of Organization Values and Policies in Loyalty and Evaluation (T68-PF-02/organization-values)
**Question.** Should an organization's values and policies be used in loyalty or evaluation?
**대안.** 조직 정책을 업무 자격·계약 조건에만 쓰거나, 별도 승인: **Alternatives.** Use organization policy only for job eligibility and contract terms, or, after separate approval, also as input to evaluating individual loyalty. The former separates rights from feelings, and the latter shows the link between institutions and individual reactions. The choice is undecided.
**소비자 활용.** 플레이어는 정책 위반과 개인 불신을 구분한다. **: **Consumer use.** The player distinguishes a policy violation from personal distrust. The **ideal outcome** is that the causes of legal eligibility and of emotional change are each visible. The **gap** is the rule linking organization policy and individual loyalty. The **reason** is that neither the organizational input nor the way of using it has been adopted. **QA** compares whether, when only a policy changes, rights and trust do not automatically change together.
**Question.** Should existing test numbers be used for mood, legitimacy, and score?
**대안.** 필요한 계수를 새 설계표로 제안하거나 원작의 판본별 값을: **Alternatives.** Propose the needed coefficients in a new design table, or present the source games' edition-specific values as comparison candidates. Both must explain per-event results, units, and side effects and obtain approval, and there is no route that uses test values as-is as confirmed values.
**현재 확정 경계.** 이미 승인된 분류 문턱 `25/−25/−50`과: **Currently confirmed boundary.** The already approved classification thresholds `25/−25/−50` and the loyalty range `0..100` are kept. What is unapproved are the per-event change amounts, decay rates, durations, and the new coefficients for mood, legitimacy, and score. Source-game comparison values and past test values are not Seoul coefficients.
**소비자 활용.** 플레이어는 같은 사건이 왜 어떤 상태를 바꾸었는지: **Consumer use.** The player should understand, through approved causes and units, why the same event changed a given state. The **ideal outcome** is that the approved thresholds and ranges are distinguished from the new event coefficients, and unapproved numbers do not determine play results. The **gap** is the coefficients for event change amounts, decay, and duration. The **reason it is open** is that these coefficients are owner decisions. **QA** cross-checks before/after and units for each candidate event coefficient while preserving the boundary values `25/−25/−50` and loyalty `0/25/100`, and confirms that source-game comparison values or past test values are not used in result calculation when they have not been selected. The sub-part on health, fatigue, and derived-value assumptions is on hold pending the Basic source text.
12.6 국가별 제도와 관계의 성립 (혼인·맹세·지휘): 12.6 National Institutions and the Formation of Relationships (Marriage, Oaths, Command)
**질문.** 어느 나라의 제도가 혼인, 맹세, 지휘 관계의 성립과 종료: **Question.** Whose institutions determine the formation and termination of marriage, oath, and command relationships?
**대안.** 단일 관할 제도의 성립 요건을 적용하거나, 다국가 당사자에: **Alternatives.** Apply the formation requirements of a single jurisdiction's institutions, or separate per-effect jurisdiction and re-ratification for multinational parties. After: Whether it falls within scope is judged, and separate treasury-access and spending authority is also checked. Signing-deputy qualification alone does not allow the deputy to dispose of the entire treasury personally. 1. 국가를 움직이는 사람과 플레이어의 결정: 1. The People Who Run the State and the Player's Decisions
플레이어는 하나의 몸인 한 사람으로 캠페인을 이어 간다. 다른 인물도 동: The player continues the campaign as a single person with one body. Other characters are NPCs who use the same action contract. Opening the state screen does not turn the player into another character or grant all of the state's powers. There is a single world time. Combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. These combat rules do not determine time adjustment for the campaign or for institutional procedures.
행위자는 지금 유효한 직위 보유자, 제도에 등록된 범위의 대행자, 후보,: Actors are the current valid officeholder, a proxy within the scope registered in the institution, a candidate, a supporter, and a ratification officer. A state is not the same entity as its head personally, and an institution's property is not the head's personal property. Through their own body and actual authority, the player requests institutional actions, claims eligibility as a candidate, requests support, and submits evidence. Being able to make a request is different from having that request approved.
국가 수장은 국가 제도에 따른 임명·수여 제안·외교·전쟁 승인·후계 절차: The head of state takes part in appointments, award proposals, diplomacy, war approval, and succession procedures under the state's institutions. A higher tier does not open up every action. Which institution a signature is made in, which unit is commanded, and which treasury can be used must each be checked. This distinction applies equally to the player and to NPCs.
그것만으로 얻지 못하는 것: What It Does Not Grant by Itself

어느 국가·조직의 구성원인지와 인정: Which state or organization one belongs to, and recognition

대상 권리와 의무, 보유자, 상위 계약, 인정: Target rights and obligations, holder, superior contract, recognition
현장의 즉시 사용·다른 직위 취득: Immediate on-site use, acquisition of another office
지금 현장에서 통제하는 사람과 점령·분쟁: Who controls the site right now, and occupation or dispute
합법 보유·주민 협조·기관 운영: Lawful possession, cooperation of residents, institutional operation
지정 부대와 유효한 지휘·위임 범위: Designated units and the valid scope of command or delegation
기관 소유 재산 처분·타 부대 편입: Disposing of institution-owned property, incorporating other units

신뢰, 친족, 혼인, 빚, 맹세와 사건 기억: Trust, kinship, marriage, debts, oaths, and memory of events
자동 선출·상속·빈자리 임명: Automatic election, inheritance, or appointment to a vacant seat
직위 티어는 국가 사이에서 비교하는 분류다. 같은 티어도 같은 직위가 아: Office tier is a classification used for comparison between states. The same tier is not the same office, and a higher tier does not automatically permit military command, hereditary succession, or diplomacy on behalf of the entire state. Actual authority comes from within the scope of that office and of separate contracts. A combat commander commands all squads that are included in both the command scope registered in the combat session and the list of assigned squads, but this does not remove the on-site squad leader's autonomous judgment and assessment of orders issued immediately. A state office and this combat command contract do not replace each other.
후보의 자격, 투표권, 기술 자격은 작위 주장과 다른 자료다. 배우자·친: A candidate's eligibility, voting rights, and technical qualifications are data separate from a claim to a title of nobility. A relationship record such as spouse, kin, or adopted child does not by itself confer every right or office. Personal trust or support may change with events, but that does not by itself alter an institution's fixed eligibility thresholds or classification criteria. Seoul has no approved values yet for its legitimacy threshold or election scores.
이름으로 사람을 검색할 수 있어야 한다. 이름이 같거나 개명한 경우에도: It must be possible to search for a person by name. Even when names are identical or a person has changed their name, identity is confirmed by the permanent ID. Records from past character registration are evidence of past identity issuance and do not replace the current state's roster of members, candidates, or heads.
3.1 유효한 직위로 행동할 때: 3.1 When Acting in a Valid Office
전: 인물, 직위, 기관, 행동 대상, 요청한 권한 근거를 구별한다. 보: Before: Distinguish the person, office, institution, target of the action, and the basis for the requested authority. Check whether the holder and the actual actor are the same, whether the office is valid, and whether the request is within the scope of jurisdiction, signature, and command. For actions that require a separate contract or actual on-site access, check that eligibility as well.
행동: 플레이어 또는 NPC가 서명·지휘·운영을 요청한다. 기록 담당자가: Action: A player or NPC requests a signature, command, or operation. Even if a record keeper carries out claim-construction work on the instruction of a qualified head, the record keeper does not thereby become a beneficiary of the target territory.
후: 적격한 행동은 자기 계약의 효과만 남긴다. 권한이 없으면 요청한 기: After: A qualified action leaves behind only the effects of its own contract. Without authority, the requested institutional effect is not established. The existence of a public office does not add ownership or command authority to other ledgers. If there is no country-specific institutional input, report "institution undecided" and do not apply arbitrary success or free handling.
3.2 살아 있는 사람이 직위를 잃을 때: 3.2 When a Living Person Loses an Office
전: 인물이 직위 하나를 보유하고, 개인 생활·이동·다른 직위 또는 별도: Before: A person holds one office and may also have a personal life, movement, other offices, or separate valid contracts.
Action: The grounds for losing that office are confirmed.
후: 상실한 직위에 의존하는 서명·지휘·운영만 중단된다. 개인 생활과 이: After: Only the signatures, commands, and operations that depend on the lost office are suspended. Personal life, movement, and actions under separate valid contracts continue to be judged by their own qualifications. The actions of a living person are not locked wholesale. That vacancy alone does not cause inheritance, transfer of rights, appointment of a proxy, or absorption of authority into another seat. The institution's treasury does not become personal property. If another contract expires under its own conditions, the authority under that contract also ends, but the vacancy itself does not expire a separate contract.
Before: The head's office, title, property, and contracts exist as separate items.
행동: 사망 근거가 확정된다. 사망한 사람은 새로운 개인 행동을 시작하지: Action: The grounds for death are confirmed. The deceased cannot begin new personal actions, and the office becomes vacant.
후: 기관과 국가는 수장의 죽음만으로 자동 소멸하지 않는다. 기관의 재산: After: The institution and the state do not automatically dissolve merely because the head has died. The institution's property is not converted into the head's personal estate. For each item, the succession institution lookup, candidate eligibility check, election, nomination, examination, or hereditary procedure, ratification, transfer of rights, handover and takeover, and dispute records proceed only when each has its own grounds. Defeated candidates are not deleted, and remaining claims are recorded according to the institution. If there is no eligible person or procedure, the matter remains a vacancy or succession dispute, and no anonymous head is created to treat it as a success.
몸의 계승, 국가·기관 수장 계승, 개별 작위·재산 계승은 별도 사건이다: Succession of the body, succession of the head of a state or institution, and succession of individual titles and property are separate events. A new body does not inherit the previous body's authority, skills, or friends. That said, the new body and the new head need not necessarily be different people. If the office's institution, candidate check, procedure, and ratification have independently chosen the same person, the same person may hold it. The fact that the body changed is not itself grounds for that selection or for inheritance. Even if the body changes because of permanent detention, the detained person is still alive, so inheritance upon death is not opened.
3.4 공석의 대행과 조직의 잔존: 3.4 Proxy for a Vacancy and the Survival of the Organization
Before: The office is vacant; check whether there is a proxy registered in the institution and a defined scope.
Action: The registered proxy requests an action within the scope.
후: 등록된 범위만 행사할 수 있다. 대행이 수장 선출이나 직위의 영구: After: Only the registered scope may be exercised. A proxy does not substitute for electing a head or for permanently transferring the office. A simple delegation contract is also not an automatic proxy appointment. Proxy authority is not granted to unregistered persons or to requests outside the scope.

수장 계승과 별도인 몸 선택: Body selection, separate from succession to the leader
기관 소유와 개인 소유·실제 지출: Institutional ownership versus personal ownership and actual expenditure
전투 세션 등록 지휘 범위와 배속 목록의 교집합인 모든 분대 지휘, 즉시: Command of every squad in the intersection of the combat session's registered command scope and the attached roster; immediate orders versus squad leaders' autonomous judgment; reinforcements only after they actually arrive during the battle
외교·명분·전쟁·공성·포로·점령·조직 잔존과 해산: Diplomacy, casus belli, war, siege, prisoners, occupation, and organizational survival and dissolution
유효한 명분과 목표 한정 종결, 통제와 인정의 구분, 조직 생명주기: Valid casus belli and objective-limited termination, the distinction between control and recognition, and the organizational life cycle
사용자 정의 협상과 합의·정산의 근거; D16 전쟁과 D10 권리 처리에: Basis for user-defined negotiation, agreement, and settlement; linked to D16 war and D10 rights handling
세계 시계·사건 순서·저장: World clock, event order, and saving

이 표는 설계상 책임 구분이며 실행 코드나 운영 보관자를 임명한 기록이: This table divides design responsibilities; it is not a record appointing execution code or an operational custodian.
8. 두 원작에서 확인한 구조와 비교 한계: 8. Structures Confirmed in the Two Source Games and Limits of Comparison
보존된 1.20.0.3 / build 25652598 자료에서 봉건선거는: In the preserved 1.20.0.3 / build 25652598 materials, feudal elections handle the elector set, candidate filter, vote weight, and candidate score separately. This can be used for comparisons that distinguish one person's candidate eligibility from their votes. The overall tally and final tie resolution are not confirmed, and quorum and ties are investigated but unresolved. Do not read an unknown rule as ‘none’ or as 0.
관료 임명에는 정부 접근·후보 티어·점수 순서와 직위 이전 처리의 문맥이: Bureaucratic appointments involve government access, candidate tiers, score order, and the context of handling office transfers, and the restrictions on holding a council seat together with other offices are conditional. They cannot be carried over as a concurrent-office ban applying to all of Seoul. In handling finance-related vacancies, there are commands that, under conditions such as having no successor councillor, add treasury funds to a superior and destroy the title. Explicit deduction from the previous treasury and final preservation of assets are not proven. Therefore, do not say that ‘the treasury is transferred completely,’ or that it equals the continued existence of a Seoul institutional treasury.
섭정은 기존 군주와 권력을 공유하는 문맥이며 유효성과 실제 능력 조건이: A regency is a context in which power is shared with an existing monarch, and its validity and actual capability conditions differ. It is not the same as Seoul's acting role, which fills in for an empty office. In tests, the annotations and the actual operands differ, so the actual values and units must be distinguished. Legitimacy uses classification thresholds multiplied by coefficients according to tier and era, but raw rounding and initialization are not proven. This material does not adopt any Seoul legitimacy formula or threshold value. General character generation or test-tube generation is likewise not evidence for ‘generating an unknown leader for every election vacancy.’
공식 위키와 공식 패치의 보존 문서에서는 왕 전용 행동, 영주 후보 자격: In the preserved documents of the official wiki and official patches, king-only actions, lord candidate eligibility, politician selection, and specific relationship updates on accession and on a suzerain's death each have different handling. The general king eligibility table does not fully explain candidate priority, ties, or the default successor. Concurrent holding of politician and successor roles is also directional and conditional, so it must not be turned into a universal permission or ban on holding multiple offices.
정치 관련 문턱은 main 50–53의 20 이후 beta 55 / ma: The politics-related threshold was 20 in main 50–53, then restored to 40 in beta 55 / main 54–56, and Actions revision 1318 also records 40. Do not use the historical 20 as a current invariant. The knowledge-based politician selection of beta 43 was changed to persuasion-based selection in main 46–48. The strict ‘greater than 6’ persuasion requirement does not include being equal to 6, but candidate ties and the actual selection order are unresolved. These values are not Seoul eligibility values.
귀족 소진·종주 사망·기존 영주의 폐허 재정착은 각각 자기 문맥의 문서: Noble exhaustion, a suzerain's death, and an existing lord's resettlement of ruins are each documented facts within their own contexts. They do not prove a general rule that a new leader is generated for every vacancy. The treasury modifications concerning confiscated funds and the King's Ring likewise do not fully prove the treasury custodian, spending authority, or survival during a vacancy. The capacity for free-lord titles is not the geometry of Seoul's territory or the identity of an institutional office. Voting, quorum, tests, scope of acting authority, legitimacy figures, and the order of sequential processing remain within the limits of the preserved materials even in the source games.
두 원작의 구조는 서울의 제도를 비교하는 근거다. 보존 문서에서 확인한: The structures of the two source games serve as a basis for comparing Seoul's institutions. They are limited to what was confirmed in the preserved documents and are not observations of the game running. Some materials lack a confirmed correspondence between document version and historical build, so actual behavior in that build cannot be established.
아래는 채택 전 제안이다. 어느 대안도 숫자·인준자·기간을 승인한 것으로: The following are proposals before adoption. Do not treat any alternative as approving numbers, ratifiers, or durations.
국가별 후보·선출·정족수·동점·인준: Candidacy, election, quorum, ties, and ratification by state
제도 담당자가 적격자를 근거 있는 수장으로 확정: The institutional officer confirms an eligible person as a leader with a documented basis
시작 방식 이름만 있고 선출 상세가 미정: Only the name of the starting method exists, and election details are undecided
선거형은 등록된 유권 명부와 인준으로 확정 또는 회의 합의로 확정; 동수: For the elective type, confirm by a registered electoral roll and ratification, or confirm by council agreement; for a tie, confirm after a revote or arbitration by the ratifying body
동수·후보 소진·누락 표에서 근거 없는 수장이 생기지 않는가?: Is it ensured that no leader without a basis arises from ties, candidate exhaustion, or missing votes?
계보와 공직 자격을 따로 검사: Check lineage and eligibility for public office separately
혼인·양자·적격 자녀 순서·예외가 국가별 미정: Marriage, adoption, order of eligible children, and exceptions are undecided by state
적격 계보 순서를 따르되 인준 또는 가문 지명 후 독립 인준: Follow the order of eligible lineage, but require ratification, or independent ratification after a house nomination
새 몸과 수장이 같아도 독립 근거가 있는가? 관계 표기만으로 상속되지 않: Even if the new body and the leader are the same, is there an independent basis? Is nothing inherited by a relationship notation alone?
복수 기구의 역할을 일관되게 연결: Connect the roles of multiple bodies consistently
도제 계보와 평의회 연결·이원 공석 순서 미정: Connection between the apprentice lineage and the council, and the order for dual vacancies, are undecided
도제 계보로 후보를 제한하고 평의회 선출 또는 계보 추천과 평의회 인준;: Restrict candidates by apprentice lineage, then use council election or lineage recommendation plus council ratification; for dual authority, use independent acting roles or joint ratification
한 자리 공석이 다른 자리 권한을 자동 흡수하지 않는가?: Does a vacancy in one seat avoid automatically absorbing the authority of another seat?
공석 업무와 기존 수장 보조를 구별: Distinguish vacancy duties from assisting the existing leader
등록 주체·범위 변경·해제·기간 미정: Registering party, scope changes, revocation, and duration are undecided
사전 등록 범위만 유지 또는 별도 적법한 기관 결정으로 범위를 변경: Maintain only the pre-registered scope, or change the scope by a separate, lawful institutional decision
등록 없는 인물과 범위 밖 요청을 막는가?: Does it block unregistered persons and out-of-scope requests?
정당한 계승·권리 회복의 근거; 보유자 사망 시 적격 자녀에게 미관철 주: Basis for lawful succession and restoration of rights; when the holder dies, it becomes an unenforced claim passed to eligible children
적격 자녀, 국가별 인준·혼인·계승 예외: Eligible children, and each state's confirmation, marriage, and succession exceptions
별도 상속하지 않음; 해당 주장 전쟁의 백지 강화로 관철된 주장으로 바뀜: Not inherited separately; a white peace in the war over that claim turns it into an enforced claim
주장 소멸·자격 상실·명분별 전쟁 무효 조건: Conditions for claim extinction, loss of eligibility, and voiding a war by casus belli
작위 보유권은 해당 작위의 계승 제도를 따른다. 공직 후보 자격·선거권·: Title-holding rights follow that title's succession system. Eligibility for public office, voting rights, and technical qualifications are not the same kind of thing as a title claim. Improving or worsening personal relationships changes the grounds for support or acceptance; it does not mean the boundaries of a fixed comparison category, such as a rank tier, have shifted. High trust also cannot substitute for physical impossibility or lack of authority.
혼인은 국가별 정치·재산·계승 제도와 당사자 동의·인준을 따른다. 혼인: Marriage follows each state's political, property, and succession systems, as well as the consent and confirmation of the parties. Establishing a marriage alone does not grant new claims or territory, nor does it share all of the spouse's claims. Using a spouse's existing claim, children inheriting a claim, and fabricating a claim separate from succession rights are different paths. When a death, imprisonment, or loss of office occurs, check for each alliance, property, confirmation, and heir effect whether it is maintained, terminated, or must be re-confirmed.
3. 행동 전·행동·행동 후와 실패: 3. Before, During, and After an Action, and Failure
행동 전에는 대상 존재와 판본, 생존·구금 등 수행 가능성, 권한, 실제: Before an action, check in order: the target's existence and version, feasibility (such as whether the actor is alive and not imprisoned), authority, the actual location and communication route, resources and exclusive reservations, and the other party's will and institutional procedures. The player is shown the satisfied conditions and the blocked conditions, distinguished by what the current body's knowledge, records, and access to reports and qualifications can confirm. Hidden facts are not leaked through the stated reason; they are explained as a lack of confirmed grounds. Unknown prices or state systems are not filled in as success conditions.
주장 구성은 근거 수집·작성 → 주장 구성 → 효력 인정 또는 거절로 나: Claim fabrication is divided into gathering and drafting evidence → composing the claim → recognition of its effect or rejection. Fabrication takes time, and only a structure that checks duration, cost, and risk of detection has been approved. Seoul's numbers and success determinations are undecided. Completing a fabrication is neither possession nor a transfer of holding rights. If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the remaining work is checked again. Even if it is canceled by a world event or the person in charge dies, materials already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed; only the remaining reservations are released according to the contract.
수여는 초안 → 권한·대상 검사 → 수령자 동의 → 필요한 인준·비준 →: A grant proceeds through draft → authority and target check → recipient consent → required confirmation or ratification → rights ledger change → operational takeover. One must join the state before receiving a grant, and a head may grant only titles lower than their own. The limit of two directly held duke-tier titles is an existing confirmed value. No new title is created where no actual title ID, domain, or rank exists. The holder is not changed before the required confirmation. If on-site takeover is blocked after confirmation, the result remains as rights held but not recovered, or takeover incomplete.
성립한 수여는 수여자의 목록에서 권리를 빼고 수령자에게 같은 작위 ID를: An established grant removes the right from the grantor's list and registers the same title ID to the recipient. Delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only specified operations, signing, or command. Appointment grants public office authority. Buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit command do not transfer automatically unless their inclusion is explicitly stated. Revocation requires contract clauses, evidence of violation, and a confirmation procedure. Unlawful seizure is not a normal grant but a change of control and a rights dispute.
본체 교체, 국가·기관 수장 교체, 개별 작위·재산 계승은 별도 사건이다: Switching the current body, replacing the head of a state or institution, and succession to individual titles and property are separate events. A lawful procedure reselecting the same living person is also not inheritance upon death. Even if the body changes because of permanent imprisonment, the imprisoned person remains alive. The previous body's rights, authority, skills, and friends are not copied to the new body. The death of a proxy does not extinguish the original holder's rights. A vacancy is not an automatic dissolution of a state or institution.
4. 명분, 전쟁 점수와 협상: 4. Casus Belli, War Score, and Negotiation
명분 보유는 선전포고 권한·병력·지휘권을 주지 않는다. 모든 전쟁은 개시: Holding a casus belli does not grant authority to declare war, troops, or command. Every war requires a validly registered casus belli at its start. The actor's authority, the opponent, the target title and domain, the beneficiary, eligibility, cost, objectives, and the effects of attacker victory, defender victory, white peace, surrender, and voiding are all fixed. Restoring a recognized right, supporting another eligible person's claim, and remedying a breach of an approved higher-level contract are bundles for registration review, not a finished list of casus belli. Personal debts, passage disputes, and water supply cutoffs are not automatically made into grounds for conquest.
타인의 주장을 지원하면 그 명분에 적힌 수혜자가 기준이다. 공격자에게 모: When supporting another person's claim, the beneficiary named in that casus belli is the standard. The attacker is not given all the territory. The new holder and higher-level contracts are checked. A war refers to the casus belli version at the time it began, and if the grounds change, the voiding conditions of that casus belli are explicitly checked. Occupation outside the objectives does not widen the scope of transfer. Effective control, legal confirmation, title rights, public office, and personal property are independent. The transfer of rights at termination does not mean residents' cooperation, restoration of facilities, or completed integration.
전쟁 점수 W는 -100~100이며 상대는 -W다. 군주 사이 전쟁의 전: War score W ranges from -100 to 100, and the opponent's is -W. In a war between monarchs, the combat score is capped at 50. Capturing the actual head of that war is +100; capturing the designated primary, second, and third heirs is +50, +25, and +10; and occupying the capital is +10. For a single war or event ID, the addition applies only once, and the same person or the same event is not counted twice. An election candidate is not arbitrarily designated as the primary heir. +30 makes a white peace request possible but is not automatic acceptance. Voluntary surrender follows the result defined by each casus belli.
점령 기여는 방어자의 보유 거점 범위·규모를 기준으로 한다. 명분 목표의: Occupation contribution is based on the scope and scale of the strongholds the defender holds. If full control of the casus belli's objectives persists, cumulative contribution over time is gained, and if part of it is recovered, the conditions are checked again. Duration during which the attacker fails to secure the objectives contributes to the defending side. The denominator, partial occupation, duration, rate of increase, and peace acceptance modifiers are undecided. A tactical victory alone does not automatically dissolve an organization that holds no territory.
W=100이면 상대의 -100 강제 수락을 기록하고 명분별 승리·패배 효: If W=100, the opponent's forced acceptance of -100 is recorded, and the war is immediately terminated and settled with the victory and defeat effects of the casus belli. No additional captures, occupations, or property demands are accumulated during the response delay. If the casus belli is already void, the voiding conditions are checked first. +100 is not authority to forcibly acquire territory, assets, or persons outside the objectives.
협상안은 전쟁·제안 판본, 서명 권한, 대상·수혜자, 항목 목록, 이행: A negotiation proposal has the war and proposal versions, signing authority, the target and beneficiary, a list of items, and the timing, deadline, and breach effects of performance. Items distinguish promises such as rights transfers, asset payments and returns, prisoner release and repatriation, passage, water supply, rations, escorts, confirmations, higher-level contracts, and ceasefires. Trading in persons, forced marriage, and general assignment without consent are not allowed. Each item's ID, quantity, scope, authority to dispose, valuation inputs, price version, and feasibility are checked, and the same ledger asset is not demanded twice. The negotiation price score and the war score are separate records, and negotiation neither consumes nor manipulates the combat score.
플레이어는 중간 협상에서 명분 안의 요구를 줄이거나 상호 합의한 대체 지: In an interim negotiation, the player may reduce the demands within the casus belli or propose mutually agreed substitute payments or obligations. Assets, persons, and territory the opponent cannot dispose of, and third parties' rights, cannot be included. Forced cession outside the objectives is not allowed, and a voluntary separate transaction is not disguised as a forced effect. The evaluation structure is the sum of the demanded items' prices minus the sum of the offered items' prices, and acceptance considers not only the score but also control, supply, succession, prisoners, obligations, relationships, memory, and feasibility. A proposal is not automatically accepted merely because its price is at or below the score. Unregistered items appear as 'valuation pending' and block signing and settlement of a finalized proposal.
협상 중에도 시간과 전투는 계속된다. 수락 전 ±100에 도달하면 강제: Time and combat continue during negotiation. If ±100 is reached before acceptance, forced termination by casus belli takes precedence and the unaccepted proposal is discarded. For acceptance, 100, and death at the same boundary, only one termination is determined by the confirmed event order and versions. Termination proceeds through input lock → recheck of casus belli and beneficiary → rights transfer → occupation retention or return → prisoner handling → reparations, ceasefire, and higher-level contracts → cancellation and recheck of orders in progress → event record. Deliveries, repatriations, and follow-up obligations after signing are not copied at the moment before completion.
5. 플레이어가 읽는 정보와 영역 소유: 5. Information the Player Reads and Domain Ownership
권리·명분 화면은 현재 본체 인물의 지식, 기록·보고 접근권과 자격으로: The rights and casus belli screens display only information that the current body's knowledge, access to records and reports, and qualifications can confirm. Within that scope, the rights screen distinguishes a person's searchable name and ID; the right's type, target, grounds, effect, confirmation, and version; and the current legal holder versus the on-site possessor. Under the same access conditions, the casus belli screen distinguishes the attacker and beneficiary, the target domain, and each termination effect and voiding condition. The internal ledgers of rights, control, and world facts are maintained separately from what the character knows, and viewing a screen does not reveal hidden world facts. Unconfirmed information is shown as unknown or as lacking confirmed grounds, and even a rejection reason does not leak hidden facts. When the body changes, the display of reports and records is rechecked against the new character's knowledge, qualifications, and access. If simultaneous changes conflict on the same ledger version, they are resolved by a deterministic acceptance order and other settlements are reviewed again. Resending the same event does not create a new right. A rules version mismatch or corrupted save is an explicit error, and there is no automatic renumbering, migration, or silent mixing of rules.
D10은 권리 종류·주장 상태·명분의 대상과 수혜자 경계를 다룬다. 국가: D10 covers the types of rights, claim states, and the boundaries of a casus belli's target and beneficiary. The state and government domain (D09) owns the confirming bodies and each state's qualifications, elections, and acting arrangements, and the grant domain (D11) owns grant, delegation, and revocation contracts. The house and relationship domain owns the establishment of marriage and relationships between the parties, and the succession domain owns death and body transitions. D15 (combat, command, squads, roster size) covers actual tactical combat, orders, squads, and capture results observed on site. D16 (diplomacy, war, sieges, prisoners) owns the campaign contracts for war, diplomacy, sieges, and prisoners, and checks whether an observed individual detention result corresponds to the institutional figure in that war, along with its campaign effects. D17 (negotiation, trade, peace, contracts) owns negotiation proposals, trades, peace, and performance contracts. The asset domain owns property attribution and delivery. This explanation of the connections does not approve any domain's undecided costs or systems.
**땅 없는 주장자.** 전에는 무소속·무관직인 가람이 주장을 갖고 있고: **The Landless Claimant.** Garam, previously unaffiliated and holding no office, holds a claim, and another person possesses the objective. Garam asks an authorized head for support. Without a valid registered casus belli, no war is created, and the claim and possession remain as they are. Because the records officer has no valid order, fabrication does not begin either. Accepting the request and registering are separate conditions.
**타인 지원 전쟁의 종결.** 전에는 공격자 나래가 수혜자 다온의 주장: **Termination of a War Supporting Another's Claim.** Previously, the attacker Narae is at war under a valid casus belli supporting the claim of the beneficiary Daon. Even if Narae occupies a stronghold outside the objectives and the score reaches +100, the casus belli and beneficiary are rechecked before settlement. If valid, only that version's target is processed with Daon as the standard, and higher-level contracts are checked. Narae does not acquire all the territory, and no institutional vault is transferred. If it is already void, the voiding effects apply. Even when rights are transferred, on-site takeover and restoration may remain.
같은 판본에서 같은 작위에 두 수여가 겹치면 결정론적 수락 순서로 하나만: If two grants of the same title overlap in the same version, only one is accepted, according to a deterministic acceptance order. Simultaneous transfers of rights are evaluated against the same ledger version. Resending the same event ID produces no second result. If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact intervenes between approval and execution, the remaining handovers are checked again.
적용 완료된 결과 식별자는 다시 적용하지 않는다. 규칙 판본 불일치와 손: A result ID that has already been applied is not applied again. A rule version mismatch or a corrupted save is an explicit error. Time and succession rules that differ between documents are not mixed, and new rules are not mixed in without an approved migration.
수여 허용 판정은 4장의 경로별 실제 검사만 따른다. 정책을 점수로 환산: Whether a grant is permitted is determined only by the actual per-route checks in Chapter 4. A formula that converts policies into scores has not been approved. What has been approved is the recording obligation below.
초안의 필수 입력(수여자, 수령자, 국가 가입 상태, 대상 작위와 판본,: Record the draft's required inputs (grantor, recipient, state membership status, target title and version, grant authority, superior contract, rights, obligations, and term, ratifying body, and delivery conditions for relics, documents, and keys).
권리 변경 시 수여자 보유 목록에서 제거하고 수령자에게 같은 작위 식별로: When rights change, record that the title was removed from the grantor's holdings and registered to the recipient under the same title ID. No copies are made.
하위 계약·세금/급수/통행·의례 의무는 서명자와 승계 정책과 함께 기록한: Record subordinate contracts and tax, water-supply, passage, and ritual obligations together with their signatories and succession policy.
포함 여부를 명시하지 않은 건물·기관 금고·공공 재고·부대 지휘는 이전하: Buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit commands whose inclusion is not explicitly stated are recorded as not transferred.
A delegation is stored together with its status (valid, suspended, expired, revoked), the event it is based on, and its scope.
작위 보유 원장과 실효 지배 원장을 분리해 기록하고, 미회복 영지·분쟁·: Record the title-holding ledger and the effective-control ledger separately, and display unrecovered domains, disputes, and occupants together.
Resending the same event ID does not produce a new result.
승인 뒤 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절이 끼어들면 남은 인수를 다시 검사한: If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact intervenes after approval, record the fact that the remaining handovers were checked again.
IDs are permanent, and revision conflicts and storage errors are stated explicitly.
**실패해도 보유자는 그대로다.**: **Even if it fails, the holder remains unchanged.**
필요한 인준이 없으면 보유자는 그대로다. 인준이 없었으므로 초안은 어떤: If the required ratification is missing, the holder remains unchanged. Because there was no ratification, the draft remains without having transferred any rights.
중앙 기록 문화의 권역에서 기록 인준이나 유물 열람이 빠지면 그 수여는: In a region with a central-record culture, if record ratification or relic inspection is missing, the grant is void. Even when it is void, no new title is created and the title is not passed to anyone else.
인준 전에 필요한 승인자가 죽으면, 받아들여진 문장은 그 죽음에 특별한: If a required approver dies before ratification, the accepted sentence gives that death no special consequence. Who approves in place of that vacancy has not been decided 【Undecided】.
A draft sent to a recipient who has not joined is rejected.
승인과 실행 사이에 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절이 생기면 남은 인수만 다시: If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, only the remaining handovers are checked again; materials already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released according to the contract.
Even if the person who received a delegation dies, the original holder's rights do not disappear.
위임을 거두지 않은 채 유물만 빼앗으면 배신의 쟁점이 열린다. 유물을 가: Seizing only the relic without revoking the delegation opens a betrayal issue. Possessing the relic alone does not revoke the delegation.
불법으로 빼앗는 것은 수여가 아니다. 현장 통제가 바뀌었다는 기록과 권리: Seizing something illegally is not a grant. It is recorded as a change in on-site control and as a rights dispute. A higher tier alone does not immediately eliminate another person's private property or position.
수여가 승인되어도 초안에 적히지 않은 건물·기관 금고·공공 재고·부대 지: Even if a grant is approved, buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit commands not listed in the draft remain where they were.
공석이 되었다고 위임이 생기지 않는다. 살아 있는 사람이 직위를 잃으면: A vacancy does not create a delegation. When a living person loses a position, only that position's signing, command, and operation stop; that person's private life, movement, and separately valid contracts remain under their own capacities.
공석만으로 상속, 이전, 대행 임명, 권한 흡수는 일어나지 않는다. 대행: A vacancy alone does not trigger inheritance, transfer, appointment of a deputy, or absorption of authority. A deputy is permitted only for persons and scopes already registered in that institution. If there is no registration, it remains a vacancy and a succession dispute, and no unnamed leader is created.
Even if a leader dies, the institution and the state do not disappear on that fact alone.
행동 화면은 `가능`, `선행조건 부족`, `권한 없음`, `응답 대기`: The action screen distinguishes `ganeung` (possible), `seonhaeng jogeon bujok` (prerequisites lacking), `gwonhan eopseum` (no authority), `eungdap daegi` (awaiting response), and `jedo mijeong` (institution undetermined), and displays the grounds. It does not leak hidden facts through the stated reason, and explains them as `hwagindoen geungeo bujok` (confirmed grounds lacking). A conferral in a country whose ratifying body has not been determined is shown as `jedo mijeong`.
봉신 계약에는 공개 신앙을 적고, 숨은 신앙은 비공개 원장에만 둔다. 공: A vassal contract states the public faith, and a hidden faith is kept only in the private ledger. The public contract screen does not read the private ledger.
점령·양도 사건은 현장 통제를 바꾸지만 주민 협력·운영·안정화·통합과 인: Occupation and cession events change on-site control, but resident cooperation, operation, stabilization, integration, and ratification are separate stages. A rights transfer at the end of a war does not imply that resident cooperation or facility restoration is complete. The screen displays both ledgers together (unrecovered domains, disputes, occupants).
조회가 수여 권한을 만들지 않는다. 작위 보유자의 `가능한 행동`은 자기: A lookup does not create conferral authority. A title holder's `ganeunghan haengdong` (possible actions) are only the contractual operation, income, and obligations of their own title, claims for restoring rights, and permitted sub-conferrals; immediate use of a facility they have not taken possession of, and arbitrary creation of equal or higher titles, are actions that require additional authority.
주장자·후계 후보는 증거 제출·계승 자격 주장·지지 요청·정해진 명분의: Claimants and succession candidates may only submit evidence, assert eligibility for succession, request support, and act as beneficiary candidates of a designated cause; they cannot use a claim as holding rights or on-site control. A claim to a title is different from holding the title.
D11은 수여·임명·위임·회수와 봉신 계약의 골격을 소유하고, 아래 표의: D11 owns the framework of grants, appointments, delegations, revocations, and vassal contracts, and each domain owns the substance of the items in the table below. D11 only reads those values and does not redefine them.
인물 식별자와 판본, 생존·의사 표현 능력: Character IDs and versions, survival and capacity to express intent
위임받은 지휘 범위 안의 명령 하달 절차: Procedure for issuing orders within a delegated command scope
원격 명령의 전달·수신·수락 규칙: Rules for transmitting, receiving, and accepting remote commands
유물·문서·열쇠의 실제 인도 경로, 도착 전 위임 만료 재검사: Actual delivery routes for relics, documents, and keys; rechecking delegation expiry before arrival
배신 쟁점·재비준 쟁점이 열렸을 때의 관계·평가 귀속: Attribution of relationships and evaluations when a betrayal issue or re-ratification issue is opened
관계 변화 함수·증감·감쇠: Relationship change functions, increments and decrements, and decay
가입 기록과 혼인 기록의 구분 사실: Facts distinguishing membership records from marriage records
혼인 성립·효과 규칙: Rules for establishing marriages and their effects
나라별 인준 절차·공석 대행 등록(입력 대기): Each state's ratification procedures and registration of vacancy deputies (awaiting input)
16국 제도의 실제 정의: Actual definitions of the institutions of the 16 states
작위 권리 인스턴스, 청구·명분의 구분: Title-right instances, and the distinction between claims and causes
청구의 상위 계약 조건, 명분 등록 수치·기한: Superior-contract conditions for claims, and registered values and deadlines for causes
사망 사실, 후계 지정의 존재: The fact of death and the existence of a succession designation
포함 여부가 명시된 재산의 이전, 인도 상태: Transfer of property whose inclusion is explicitly stated, and delivery status
소유권 승계·인도 절차의 상세 규칙: Detailed rules for ownership succession and delivery procedures
전쟁 종결의 권리 이전 목록: The list of rights transfers at the end of a war
정산 순서·점령 분모·포로 규칙: Settlement order, occupation denominators, and prisoner rules
계승 순서의 다음 사람이 누구인지, 나라마다 빈 직위를 누가 어떻게 채우: Who is next in the order of succession, how and by whom each country fills a vacant office, and how inheritance handles shares, residuals, and creditor priority have not yet been decided.
**플레이어(본체 인물).** 생존한 개막 인물 하나다. 몸이 죽거나 영: **Player (Primary Character).** One surviving opening character. If that body dies or is permanently detained, the designated heir or the next character in the order of succession becomes the new primary body. The player engages with the world only through one primary body's actions and the commands that are actually valid for that body.
**NPC 인물.** 플레이어와 같은 행동 조건을 따른다. 지정 후계,: **NPC Characters.** They follow the same action conditions as the player. Designated heirs, characters in the order of succession, and candidates for offices, titles, and property all fall under the same contract.
**후보와 탈락한 후보.** 각 항목의 제도가 자격을 검사한다. 뽑히지: **Candidates and Eliminated Candidates.** Each item's institution checks eligibility. A candidate who is not chosen keeps whatever claim that institution leaves them, and does not vanish by being eliminated.
**남은 분대와 임시 분대장.** 본체를 잃은 분대는 병졸 가운데 임시: **Remaining Squad and Acting Squad Leader.** A squad that has lost its primary body picks an acting squad leader from among its rank-and-file soldiers. The approved rule goes only as far as this: the acting squad leader issues the same kinds of orders as a full hero commander, with weaker effects. How much weaker is not yet decided, and the acting leader does not automatically receive a full hero's class or campaign role. The existence of an acting squad leader alone does not establish remote command by the new primary body.
**국가와 기관.** 수장이 죽어도 없어지지 않는다. 빈 직위의 선거·지: **States and Institutions.** They do not disappear when their head dies. The election, nomination, examination, hereditary, and confirmation procedures for a vacant office belong to the state's institutions.
**사건·권리·재산의 원장.** 사망·구금·유언 변경·직위 이전·소유권: **Ledger of Events, Rights, and Property.** Death, detention, will changes, office transfers, ownership transfers, delivery reservations, and receipt verifications are all records with an identifier and a version. Applying the same event twice does not duplicate property.
**후계 지정과 그 변경.** 인물에게 이미 주어진 제도적 수단으로 지정: **Designating an heir and changing the designation.** Set or change the designated heir through the institutional means the character already has. This document defines the outcome when a designation exists. A will change is a means of the same kind, and if a will change and a death occur at the same moment, the already-accepted event order and that institution's effective time are used.
**새 몸으로 계속하기.** 몸이 죽거나 영구 구금되면 새 몸이 정해지고: **Continuing with a new body.** When a body dies or is permanently detained, a new body is determined and the view moves to wherever that character actually is. The new primary character starts with the relationships and skills that were already their own. The previous primary body's rights, skills, friends, trust toward specific people, and unaccepted orders do not carry over through the body switch alone.
**남은 분대의 지휘를 이을지 확인하기.** 남은 분대가 임시 분대장을: **Checking whether to take over command of the remaining squad.** After the remaining squad picks an acting squad leader, check the actual command relationship between the new primary body and the squad, a valid command contract within the same faction, and a strategic communication channel. Then check the sender's authority and the target and order versions, and a remote order is established only if there is a record that the squad received and accepted it. A valid contract alone does not automatically permit a remote order, and if any of the relationship, contact, receipt, or acceptance is unconfirmed, the result of that order is undetermined.
**예약된 작업의 재검사를 받아들이기.** 승인된 일과 그 실행 사이에: **Accepting the re-check of scheduled work.** If a death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approved work and its execution, the scheduled work is checked again. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released under the contract.
**직위·재산의 항목별 절차에 참여하기.** 새 몸이 그 제도의 후보·유: **Taking part in the item-by-item procedures for offices and property.** The new body takes part in a procedure only if it actually holds candidate, voter, or beneficiary eligibility under that institution. Even if the new body is not eligible, the procedures for other eligible candidates or beneficiaries continue. Only when an item has no eligible person or procedure does it remain a vacancy, a dispute, or held inheritance, and any result whose required inputs are unconfirmed is undetermined.
**전쟁의 약속을 항목별로 다시 정하기.** 진행 중인 전쟁에서 수장이: **Resetting war commitments item by item.** If a leader dies during an ongoing war, the new person in charge decides for each personal commitment and each office commitment whether to maintain, re-ratify, or terminate it.
**몸의 전환.** 몸이 바뀌려면 지정 후계가 있거나, 이미 받아들여진: **Body switch.** For the body to change, there must be a designated heir or an already-accepted next person in the order of succession. Who is next in the order is for the family's institution to decide and has not yet been decided. If there is no heir at all, that character's path ends.
**직위·작위·재산.** 항목마다 자기 제도와 자격을 갖춘 후보가 있어야: **Offices, titles, and property.** An item passes on only if it has a candidate who meets its own institution's requirements. Having no heir for one item does not create an heir for another. If there is no eligible candidate or no procedure, the office remains vacant or in a succession dispute. A nameless leader is not invented to fill the empty seat.
**영구 구금.** 아무도 상속자로 만들지 않는다. 구금된 인물은 살아: **Permanent detention.** It makes no one an heir. A detained character is alive, and that state is not treated as death to open inheritance. A living captive keeps their own property. Interviews, letters, and negotiations permitted by the detention contract are possible, but free movement and fieldwork are not. Whether the office's signing, command, and operation are possible, and the character's other contracts, are each re-checked for feasibility, authority, and delivery conditions, and are not considered all frozen by detention alone. What counts as permanent detention has not yet been decided. The direction of returning to a released former primary body has been chosen to be allowed only with a separate, explicit, and authorized handover of identity and control, but the specific authority who would approve that handover has not yet been decided.
**신원.** 인물에게 신원을 발급하는 일은 이미 받아들여져 있다. 그: **Identity.** Issuing an identity to a character is already accepted. That issuance does not determine how many ages, skills, locations, or rights there are. Becoming a new body does not create such numbers anew.
죽음은 죽은 사람의 새로운 행동을 멈춘다. 살아 있는 사람이 직위를 잃으: Death stops the dead person's new actions. When a living person loses an office, only that office's signing, command, and operation stop, while the person's private life, movement, and separately valid contracts continue to be judged under their own qualifications. A vacancy alone does not trigger inheritance, transfer, appointment of a deputy, or absorption of authority. A deputy is permitted only as a person already registered in the institution and within an already registered scope. Even when an office is empty, the institution and the country do not disappear.
개인 재산의 수혜자는 그 나라의 제도, 유효한 유언, 또는 이미 성립한: The beneficiary of personal property is determined by reading the country's institutions, a valid will, or a marriage or joint-property contract that has already been established. If none of those three names a beneficiary, the property is held inheritance. It is neither made ownerless nor divided equally. An institution's property stays with the institution, and only the authority needed for management passes to the new office holder. Rights of use and leases are maintained, re-approved, or ended according to the clauses stating they can be succeeded. Debts and credits are judged by whether they belong to the person, the office, or the institution, and by their succession clauses, and debts are not passed unconditionally to every heir.
소유권이 바뀌는 것과 물건이 손에 들어오는 것은 다르다. 순서는 상속 목: A change of ownership is different from the item coming into one's hands. The order is to fix the inheritance list, mark disputes and collateral, transfer ownership, reserve the actual delivery, and verify receipt. Even if ownership is obtained, supplies in a warehouse occupied by the enemy do not move into the inventory. Personal equipment in transit cannot be used before it arrives. Even when inheritance is divided, the total quantity stays the same, and supplies that are reserved or held as collateral are marked separately.
생존자에게는 가족과 연인이라는 사실, 그리고 애도의 사건이 남는다. 신뢰: For survivors, the facts of being family or lovers remain, along with the event of mourning. High trust does not create command authority, property rights, consent, or right of passage that did not exist. Even if a relationship changes, existing contracts change only through their termination clauses and action events.
작위를 보유할 권리는 그 작위의 계승 제도를 따른다. 관철된 주장은 적격: The right to hold a title follows that title's succession institution. A pressed claim passes to an eligible child as a not-yet-pressed claim. A not-yet-pressed claim is not inherited in that way. A spouse does not share all claims merely by being a spouse. The qualification of a candidate for public office, the right to vote, and skill qualifications are not treated as the same as a title claim.
위임은 원래 보유자를 남겨 두고 적힌 운영과 서명과 지휘만 맡긴다. 위임: A delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only the stated operation, signing, and command. If the delegate dies, the original holder's rights do not disappear. A delegation is not an appointment that fills a vacant office.
이미 성립한 혼인의 동맹·재산·인준·후계 효과는 사망 때 효과마다 따로: The alliance, property, confirmation, and succession effects of an already established marriage are examined separately for each effect at death, and are maintained, ended, or re-confirmed. They are not all ended at once. A marriage record alone does not establish a marriage. For a case where a marriage is explicitly not established, there is no marriage effect to pass on, but for a case where the applicable institution is unknown and so whether it was established is undetermined, it is not converted into not established or no effect. In such a case, both establishment and effects remain undetermined.
이 영역이 읽고 쓰는 상태는 이것들이다. 본체 지정과 계승 순서 기록,: These are the states this domain reads and writes: primary body designation and succession order records; per-character relationships, skills, and trust; occupancy and history of offices and titles; for property items, the owner, beneficiary, basis of quantity, collateral, reservation, delivery location, and fulfillment status; squad command state; and event identifiers and ledger versions. A hero has only one state at a time among commander, attached, independent agent, and unavailable. A strategic squad that can move needs one full hero commander.
The already approved rules are these.
**세 갈래 분리.** 플레이어 본체 계승, 국가·기관 수장 계승, 개별: **Three-Way Separation.** Succession of the player's primary body, succession of the head of a state or institution, and succession of individual titles and property are handled as separate events. All of the dead primary body's authority, skills, and friends are not copied to the character who becomes the new primary body.
**본체 전환.** 본체 사망 또는 영구 구금 시 지정 후계, 없으면 계: **Body Switch.** When the primary body dies or is permanently detained, the designated heir becomes the new primary body, or if there is none, the character in the order of succession does. If there is no heir, that character's path ends. The viewpoint moves to the new primary body's actual location, and the remaining squad elects a temporary rank-and-file squad leader. The previous primary body's rights, skills, relationships, and unaccepted orders are not transferred by the switch alone. For a remote order to the remaining unit, the actual command relationship between the new primary body and the squad, the same-faction command contract, the communication channel, and the receipt and acceptance records are all checked.
**공석 절차의 순서.** 사망·공석 근거 확정 → 사망한 인물의 개인: **Order of the Vacancy Procedure.** Confirm the basis of death or vacancy → halt the dead character's new personal actions, or, for a living character who loses an office, halt only that office's signing, command, and operation authority → snapshot the lists of offices, titles, property, and contracts → look up the succession institution for each item → check candidate eligibility → run procedures such as election, nomination, examination, or heredity → confirmation → transfer of rights item by item → delivery and takeover → record disputes.
**재산 전이의 순서.** 상속 목록 확정 → 분쟁·담보 표시 → 소유권: **Order of Property Transfer.** Fix the inheritance list → mark disputes and collateral → transfer ownership → reserve the actual delivery → verify receipt. Re-applying the same death event does not duplicate property.
**구금 규칙.** 영구 구금으로 본체가 바뀌어도 구금된 인물은 살아 있: **Detention Rule.** Even if the primary body changes because of permanent detention, the detained character is alive. This is not treated as death to open inheritance. A detained person keeps their own property. Actions and office authority during detention are re-checked against the detention contract and the actual conditions of performance, and are not frozen across the board. Only the direction has been chosen that returning to the previous primary body after release requires a separate, explicit handover of authority, and the specific authority is undetermined.
**주장 계승.** 관철된 주장은 적격 자녀에게 미관철 주장으로 이어지고: **Claim Succession.** A pressed claim passes to an eligible child as an unpressed claim, and an unpressed claim is not separately inherited. A spouse does not automatically share all claims.
이 문서는 아래의 이미 승인된 정책을 실제 플레이 판단에 쓸 수 있게 다: This document restates the already-approved policies below so they can be used in actual play decisions. Each item is attributed to the approved decision it comes from.
네 가지 초안의 구분: 수여는 작위 권리의 보유자를 바꾸고, 임명은 공직: The four kinds of draft: a Grant changes the holder of a title's rights; an Appointment confers public-office authority; a Delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only the stated operation, signing, and command; a Recall is a proposal that requires an existing contract's recall clause, evidence of breach, and ratification.

CK3의 확인 자료는 1.20.0.3, build 25652598의 보존: The verified sources for CK3 are the preserved scripts of 1.20.0.3, build 25652598, and a community wiki from a separate point in time. Title hierarchy and de jure parents, actual holders, terrain, and offices are different scopes. A claim changes as a character–title relationship and is not evidence of a tradable inventory item. Fabrication leads, after work progress, to events, payments, and the granting of unpressed claims, and differs from occupation. A white peace strengthens only the weak claims on the target list, while defeat or surrender handles the corresponding claim. Title and vassal transactions from victory are separate from changes in occupation control. Automatic death inheritance, list storage, native enumeration, rounding, and active paths still have verification limits.

The old path of requesting from a religious head is distinguished as a pressed claim, while Buy Claim is distinguished as payment in faith resources and an unpressed claim, and differs from the path of buying things with gold. Partial costs of supporting another house's claim are not read as the final war declaration cost. The powerful-vassal condition for creating an empire is 'at least half' under the default-disabled rule, not an unconditional majority-ratification law. We do not write that the confirmed title-tier symbol mapping is 'unrecovered,' but we also do not say that native automatic calculation has been confirmed. PAM requests, old requests, empire rules, and de jure changes are different paths. These figures, probabilities, and religious institutions are not transplanted into Seoul.
Norland는 World 1284, Lords 1314, Actions: Norland distinguishes the World 1284, Lords 1314, Actions 1318, and States 1262 wiki versions from individual beta/main developer announcements. Grant Title and recall are character roles, not Seoul's grants of territorial titles. Region, city, and town terrain are not grantable legal titles. Gold plundering, relationship changes, and vassalization from ordinary city attacks are separate transitions, so victory is not read as ownership. Peace treaty expiration is not claim expiration, and lowborn and lesser lord are not the lowest tier of territorial titles. The emperor condition counts the number of states; it is not a title tier.
Norland의 봉신 행동 제한·질적 조공 의존과 요구·거절·승리 순서는: Norland's vassal action restrictions, qualitative tribute dependence, and the order of demand, refusal, and victory are limited to their respective document versions.
