This is not a general protection that also prevents invasion or title recall. The timer start, refresh, native application, and correspondence to the actual build are unconfirmed. The Debt of Honor vassalization path in beta57 is separate evidence from a separate version. The pre-hire requirement in beta40 and the combined Hire and Grant Title command in beta54 are version changes. The inauguration occurring after a grant in main50–53 does not prove a transaction that requires legal ratification beforehand. Crown transfer and succession preservation are crown and role states, not a universal hierarchy of title rights. Tribute calculation, AI acceptance, hidden conditions, and the native application order are unconfirmed. Seoul's pre-grant ratification is based on Seoul's approval clause.

D11 수여·위임·회수·봉신 — 독자용 설계 문서: D11 Grants, Delegation, Recall, and Vassals — Design Document for Readers
기존 수여·봉신·작위 권리 규칙의 확정 범위를 설명한다. 아직 정하지 않: This document explains the confirmed scope of the existing rules on grants, vassals, and title rights. Institutions, contracts, quantities, and formulas not yet decided are left in Chapter 12.
Notation rules. Each paragraph of this document carries one of the following.
【승인】 — 이미 받아들여진 기존 범위 그대로다. 이 문서는 한 글자도: 【Approved】 — This is the existing scope exactly as already accepted. This document does not widen it by a single character.
【미결】 — 아무 근거도 없이 정해질 수 없는 항목이다. 12장에서 결정: 【Undecided】 — An item that cannot be decided without any basis. It is handled in Chapter 12 as a pending decision item.
11장의 Crusader Kings III(이하 CK3)와 Norland: The Crusader Kings III (hereafter CK3) and Norland records in Chapter 11 are **comparisons against installed scripts, documents, and announcements**, not observations of engine execution. Neither side's figures have been adopted as Seoul's coefficients, probabilities, or formulas.
수여의 수치 한도는 기존의 **직접 보유 공작급 작위 둘 제한**을 유지: For the numerical limit on grants, the existing **limit of two directly held duke-tier titles** is kept. Costs, durations, and probabilities not yet decided are not filled in with implicit values.
이 문서는 **작위와 공직 권한을 어떻게 나누고, 맡기고, 되돌리는가,: This document covers **how title and office authority is divided, entrusted, and taken back, and what contract establishes a vassal relationship**. A player continues the campaign through one main-body character, and other characters in the world are NPCs using the same action contract. Grants, appointments, delegations, and recalls can all be proposed only with the authority that main body actually holds, and one cannot switch screens to turn back time or duplicate the main body. World time is one.
**Preservation of delegation.** When a deputy dies, the original holder's right does not disappear. A vacancy does not take over that delegation.
**혼인 효과별 판정.** 사망·구금·관직 상실 때 동맹·재산·인준·후계: **Per-effect marriage adjudication.** On death, detention, or loss of office, the contracts for each effect (alliance, property, confirmation, succession) are checked separately and sorted into maintained, terminated, or needing reconfirmation; they are not all terminated at once. If the applicable institution is undetermined, then formation and effects are also undetermined, not "no effect."
**전쟁 재검사.** 진행 전쟁의 수장 사망은 먼저 등록된 명분의 유효·: **War recheck.** When the leader of an ongoing war dies, the validity of the previously registered casus belli, the legal object of the right, and the beneficiary and exercise eligibility are rechecked first, and then the new responsible party is confirmed. In a claim-backed war, the approver and the beneficiary are distinguished, and the victory right goes to the eligible beneficiary. Personal promises and office promises are adjudicated item by item for maintenance, reratification, or termination, and succession is not used to erase debts, truces, or damage records. The rule for choosing the actual war-ending type after this check has not yet been decided.
**시작 계승의 이름.** 열여섯 나라의 시작 계승에는 방식의 이름이 적: **Names of starting successions.** The starting successions of the sixteen states are recorded with the name of their method: election among the duty houses, election at a covenant council of water-contract house representatives, primogeniture among the track houses, guild council and apprentice lineage, hereditary commander, dual commander and garrison chief, house inheritance, election by a council of investor houses, pastor father-to-son succession with elder confirmation, priesthood election and mountain assembly acclamation, a master's nomination of a successor disciple, examination election, and direct election by union members. Who elects, how many must gather, and what happens in a tie are not contained in the name.
이 영역에 승인된 수는 없다. 분대 정원을 정하는 식, 임시 분대장의 지: There are no approved numbers for this domain. The formula for squad capacity, how weak an interim squad leader's command is, the duration or threshold of detention, the score that decides succession, and the time limit for succession are not set, and this document does not create them. Succession, election, and death figures from other games are not Seoul's numbers.
식별은 영구적이다. 같은 사망 사건을 다시 적용해도 권리나 재산이 늘어나: Identification is permanent. Reapplying the same death event does not increase rights or property, and returns the original receipt. If a will change and a death occur at the same time, the already accepted event order and the effective time of that institution are used. There is no new rule for which to consider first. Simultaneous right transfers are evaluated against the same ledger version, and conflicts are resolved with a deterministic acceptance order.
불러오기와 몸의 변경은 저장된 관계, 권리, 재산의 이력을 초기화하지 않: Loading and body changes do not reset the stored history of relationships, rights, or property. The history of titles and offices, right disputes, the fulfillment and breach of promises, captivity, injury, and death, marriage and kinship, educational progress, disclosed evidence, property and debts, truces and war outcomes, and witnessing, memory, and current trust all remain. Later actions reread those facts.
하나의 사망을 끝까지 따라가기: Following a single death to the end
Follow it in order: before death, at the moment of death, and after death.
**죽기 전.** 지정 후계가 있는 몸의 인물이 직위 하나, 특정 사람을: **Before death.** The person in the body, who has a designated successor, holds one office, one trust directed at a specific person, and one piece of personal property. The successor already has other relationships. There is no will to pass on the property, and no election result to fill that office.
**At the moment of death.** The body dies. The dead person's new actions stop.
지정 후계가 새 몸이 된다. 화면은 그 후계가 실제로 있는 곳이다. 후계: The designated successor becomes the new body. The screen is where that successor actually is. The successor keeps their own trust and does not receive the dead person's trust, skills, or friends.
직위는 목록에 남고 비게 된다. 대행자를 만들지 않는다. 나라는 그대로다: The office stays on the list and becomes vacant. No acting holder is created. The state remains as it is.
재산은 이후의 재산 상속을 위해 목록에 남는다. 수혜자를 말하는 유언도: The property stays on the list for later inheritance of property. Since there is neither a will naming a beneficiary nor an institutional outcome, it is neither handed over nor divided.
남은 분대는 병졸 가운데 임시 분대장을 뽑는다. 임시 분대장은 승인된 범: The remaining squad chooses an interim squad leader from among the rank-and-file soldiers. Within the approved scope, the interim leader can issue the same kinds of orders with weaker effects. For remote orders from the new main body, the actual command relationship, the same-faction command contract, the contact route, receipt, and acceptance are all verified, and if any one of them is not confirmed, the result of the order is undetermined.
이 죽음의 끝은 이렇다. 플레이어의 몸은 후계다. 직위는 비어 있다. 재: This is how this death ends. The player's body is the successor. The office is vacant. Inheritance of the property is still open. The dead person's personal trust has not been copied.
후계가 아무도 없으면 그 인물의 경로는 끝난다. 직위와 재산의 항목별 절: If there is no successor at all, that person's path ends. The item-by-item procedures for office and property still open in the same order. The path ending does not make the state vanish or the property get divided equally. In the case of permanent detention, only the body changes if there is a successor. Inheritance does not open. The detained person is alive and keeps their own property.
구금을 죽음으로 처리하는 결과는 허용되지 않는다. 구금된 사람과 그 재산: Outcomes that treat detention as death are not allowed. The detained person and their property remain as they are.
죽은 사람의 신뢰, 기술, 친구를 후계에게 복사하는 결과는 허용되지 않는: Outcomes that copy the dead person's trust, skills, and friends to the successor are not allowed. The successor remains with the relationships that were originally their own.
이름 없는 직위 보유자를 만드는 결과는 허용되지 않는다. 절차가 없거나: Outcomes that create a nameless office holder are not allowed. If there is no procedure or no eligible person, the office is vacant or disputed.
한 항목의 후계가 없다고 후계를 만들어 내지 않는다. 그 항목은 보류되거: The lack of a successor for one item does not lead to inventing a successor. That item is held pending or stays vacant, and the other items continue with their own procedures.
같은 사망을 다시 적용해도 권리나 재산이 늘어나지 않는다. 이미 쓴 물자: Reapplying the same death does not increase rights or property. Supplies already used and progress already completed are not reversed. Only the remaining resources are released under that contract.
승인된 일과 그 실행 사이에 사망, 해임, 점령, 연락 두절이 생기면 예: If death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between an approved task and its execution, the reserved work is rechecked. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are preserved, and for each remaining action the surviving actor, authority, location or contact route, resources, the counterpart's intent, and the institutional procedure are judged again. Cancellation or death alone does not reject all remaining actions wholesale or erase existing records.
개인 신뢰는 후계에게 복사되지 않는다. 신뢰는 관계 영역의 판단 입력이지: Personal trust is not copied to the successor. Trust is a judgment input in the relationship domain, not a source of authority. High trust does not create command, property rights, consent, or passage rights that did not exist.
권한은 계약과 실제 관계에서 온다. 새 본체의 원격 지휘는 유효 계약뿐: Authority comes from contracts and actual relationships. Remote command by the new main body requires confirming not only a valid contract but also the actual command relationship, the same faction, the contact route, and receipt and acceptance. Office authority is distinct from personal property, title rights, and other valid contracts, and a vacancy alone does not cause anything to happen automatically.
관측과 기억은 목격한 주체의 것이다. 목격과 기억과 지금의 신뢰는 사망: Observation and memory belong to the one who witnessed. Witnessing, memory, and current trust are stored even after death, and later actions reread those facts.
저장된 세계 이력은 새 본체에게 자동으로 알려지거나 공개되지 않는다. 후: Stored world history is not automatically made known or disclosed to the new main body. The reports and records the successor can see are checked separately against that body's actual knowledge and qualifications, public access rights, and delivery routes. The previous main body's private knowledge and access rights are not copied by the body switch alone, and hidden facts are not revealed as a reason for failure.
법적 소유와 물리 보관은 별개다. 소유권을 얻어도 점령된 창고의 물자는: Legal ownership and physical custody are separate. Even after gaining ownership, supplies in an occupied warehouse do not teleport into the inventory, and equipment in transit cannot be used before it arrives.
A name is not an identifier. People, events, and property are referred to by internal identifiers.
이 영역의 규칙은 이미 잠긴 결정을 바꾸지 않는다. 임명은 공직 권한을: The rules in this domain do not change decisions that are already locked. Appointment grants public office authority, conferral changes the holder of a title right, and delegation leaves the original holder in place. A war must have a registered legitimate casus belli.
**관계·기억·충성(D07).** 신뢰가 행동의 입력으로 쓰이는 방식과: **Relationships, Memory, and Loyalty (D07).** How trust is used as an input to actions, and how the survivors' mourning events are handled.
**Houses, Kinship, Marriage, and Adoption (D08).** Whether a marriage is established, and the institutions of houses. This document examines the effects of an already established marriage effect by effect, and keeps the formation and effects undetermined for cases where the applicable institution is unknown.
**국가·정부·기관·정통성(D09).** 선거, 지명, 시험, 세습, 인: **States, Government, Institutions, and Legitimacy (D09).** How each state conducts elections, nominations, examinations, hereditary succession, and confirmation, and who fills a vacant office. The names of the starting succession methods already exist in the setting, and the voters, the number needed to convene, and the tie handling within them are open inputs of that domain.
**작위·권리·명분·인준(D10).** 어떤 권리가 죽음과 함께 끝나거나: **Titles, Rights, Casus Belli, and Confirmation (D10).** Which rights end or transfer with death, and the institution of claims.
**수여·위임·회수·봉신(D11).** 위임 상태의 세부와 수여·회수 절: **Conferral, Delegation, Revocation, and Vassals (D11).** The details of delegation status and the procedures for conferral and revocation. This document maintains the boundary at which the original right is preserved when the person who received a delegation dies.
**자산·채무·상속·인도(D13).** 재산을 어떻게 나누고 유언과 지분: **Assets, Debts, Inheritance, and Transfer (D13).** How property is divided and how wills, shares, and collateral are handled. When there is no beneficiary, this document only holds the matter pending.
**전투·지휘·분대·정원(D15).** 분대 정원의 식과 임시 분대장 지: **Combat, Command, Squads, and Capacity (D15).** The formula for squad capacity and the magnitude of the interim squad leader's command effect.
**외교·전쟁·공성·포로(D16).** 등록 명분의 유효성, 법적 대상,: **Diplomacy, War, Siege, and Captives (D16).** How an ongoing war actually ends after the validity of the registered casus belli, the legal object, and the beneficiary and exercise eligibility are rechecked. The scope in which the victory right goes to the eligible beneficiary of a claim-backed war is approved, but the choice of ending type after a death is undetermined.
**시간·사건·저장(D18).** 세계 시계, 사건 순서, 저장 경계와: **Time, Events, and Saving (D18).** The world clock, event order, save boundaries, and versions.
아래 네 예제는 이 문서의 규칙을 상태 전이로 보여 준다. 인물과 항목은: The four examples below show the rules of this document as state transitions. The characters and items are rule-verification inputs, not executed tests, and contain no approved game numbers.
**예제 1 — 몸·직위·재산의 상속자가 서로 다를 때.** 죽은 인물에: **Example 1 — When the heirs to the body, office, and property differ.** The dead character has a designated successor, one office, and one piece of personal property. The registered will proposes a specific beneficiary, but that beneficiary's legal eligibility and the confirmation of the overall asset allocation do not yet exist. Transition: the new body becomes the designated successor, and the screen moves to the successor's actual location. The office enters its item-by-item procedure but stays vacant because there is no election result to fill it. The property awaits eligibility and confirmation while preserving the registered will's proposal and the existing collateral. After: the body, office, and property have reached different outcomes. The successor did not receive the dead person's rights, trust, skills, friends, or unaccepted orders, and neither the collateral nor the physical location disappeared.
**예제 2 — 후계가 없을 때.** 죽은 인물에게 지정 후계도 계승 순: **Example 2 — When there is no successor.** The dead character has neither a designated successor nor a next person in the succession order. Transition: that character's path ends. The item-by-item procedures for office and property open in the same order. After: that character's path has ended. This rule does not decide where a new body is obtained, the state does not vanish, and the property is not divided equally. The outcomes for the office and property depend on candidate eligibility and the procedures of the relevant institution or contract respectively. For example, if the office candidates and procedure and the property beneficiary and confirmation result are not given, the item-by-item outcomes are also undetermined. A nameless leader is not created.
D13은 **자산, 채무, 상속, 인도**를 다룬다. 한 사람이 죽거나,: D13 covers **assets, debts, inheritance, and delivery**. When a person dies, when supplies set out on a road, or when an asset is put up for an enforcement item, "what belongs to whom and where it is" splits apart. This document is written so that this split can be read using only rules that have already been accepted.
이 문서의 읽기 근거가 되는 승인된 정책 목록은 다음과 같다. 각 항목은: The list of approved policies that serve as the basis for reading this document follows. Each item is attributed to the approval decision it belongs to.
한 본체·동일 행동 계약·세계 시간 하나: 플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 관: One body, one shared action contract, one world time: the player takes part as a single-body character, and other characters follow the same action conditions (sp1.b3, sp1.b92; scope-map `singleplayer-one-body`).
자산 종류의 분리: 개인 물자·장비·화폐, 기관 창고·금고·설비, 공동: Separation of asset types: personal supplies, equipment, and currency; institutional warehouses, vaults, and facilities; joint property and shares; leases and use permits; debts, claims, and collateral; and records, keys, and relics are all distinct things (sp1.b61; scope-map `separate-status-and-authority`).
자산 상태의 아홉 축: 있는 장소, 수량 또는 개체, 소유자, 보관 책임: The nine axes of asset state: location, quantity or individual item, owner, custodian, usage right, reservation, collateral, in delivery, dispute. Logistics state and legal-rights state are kept separate, and cargo in wartime transit keeps the same asset ID and split origin (sp1.b62).
계승 사건의 분리: 본체 계승, 국가·기관 수장 계승, 작위 계승, 재산: Separation of succession events: body succession, state/institution head succession, title succession, and property succession are different events (sp1.b47; scope-map `succession-and-body-change`).

한 플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 캠페인을 이어 가고, 다른 모든 인물은 같: One player continues the campaign with one principal body character, and every other character is an NPC using the same action contract. This domain covers the rules that handle these three separated branches individually, item by item; the conditions under which a new body is determined; the temporary command of the remaining squad; the recheck of scheduled tasks at the moment of death, detention, or dismissal; and the preservation rule that loading and changing bodies do not reset the saved history.
**예제 3 — 구금되었으나 살아 있을 때.** 본체 인물이 영구 구금되: **Example 3 — Detained but alive.** The main body character is permanently detained and has a designated successor. Transition: only the main body switches to the successor, and inheritance does not open. The detained character cannot move freely or work in the field, and meetings, letters, and negotiations are possible only where the detention contract allows. Signing, command, and operation of the office, as well as separate personal contracts, are each re-checked under their own conditions. After: the detained character is alive and keeps their own property. The property inheritance procedure has not opened, but whether the office is actually vacant or merely unable to be exercised, and whether existing contracts continue, are separate determinations. Returning after release requires a separate, explicit transfer of authority, and the specific authority who would grant it has not yet been decided.
**예제 4 — 전쟁 중에 청구자가 죽을 때.** 진행 중인 주장 지원: **Example 4 — When the claimant dies during a war.** The claimant dies in an ongoing claim-backing war. Transition: first check whether the registered casus belli remains valid, whether a legal target remains, and whether the beneficiary has a valid claim, consent, affiliation or backing contract, and eligibility to exercise it. If the beneficiary is eligible, the victory right passes to that beneficiary and not to the attacker. Then, for the new responsible party, personal commitments and office commitments are sorted item by item into maintained, re-ratified, or terminated. After: succession does not erase debts, truces, or damage records. If the casus belli or the beneficiary is invalid under this input, it cannot be asserted that the war simply continues, and even if both are valid, the actual choice of ending type has not yet been decided.

A handover requires the confirming signature of the designated recipient. On a reservation conflict, the existing reservation is kept, the reason for the conflict and an explicit re-proposal are shown, and no automatic queue is created. Daily closing uses a common phase and does not halt movement. For independent blockades and arrivals at the same time, input receipt order applies; for causally linked inputs, the order of the accepted causes applies. A receipt completed by an eligible arrival is not deleted by a later blockade or failure retry. A failed handover is quarantined locally to block consumption, and for non-delivery the existing reservation is kept and the shortfall is recorded.

The player finds a teacher, arranges access rights and practice conditions, and carries out actual instruction. Discovering a record or naming a successor does not immediately unlock a skill. This document distinguishes confirmed action and preservation boundaries from policies not yet chosen. A teacher accepts or refuses a request based on their actual availability and authority, and does not accept automatically just because the player chose them. An institution exercises authority over the records and educational procedures it manages. A sender reports only what they actually know, within their own disclosure authority and delivery channels. Switching screens is neither duplicating the main body nor rewinding time. There is one world time, and there is no battle pause, speed control, or command queue. Skill-specific requirements and the other party's acceptance limit the choices that are actually possible. Naming an apprentice is a choice about eligibility as a candidate for a position, and does not substitute for completing skill proficiency. The approved identity rule is to distinguish persons by stable ID and to verify the ledger version and current state. 생성률·연령/후보 정책·ST/DX/IQ/HT/CP/기술 배정 미승인: Generation rate, age/candidate policy, and ST/DX/IQ/HT/CP/skill assignment are not approved
정책 A 역할 수락 때 기존 구성원 개인화 / B 기존 주민 기록 확인: Policy: A personalize existing members upon role acceptance / B personalize upon confirmation of existing resident records; Ability: A input based on individual training records / B input based on role templates and individual training evidence. Headcount does not increase, and affiliation or occupation alone does not grant equipment or skill
미정 상태는 실제 피해·가격·정원·관계 변화의 값이 아니다. 대안이 존재: An undecided state is not a value for actual damage, price, capacity, or relationship change. The existence of an alternative does not mean that behavior is executed under the current rules.
9. 다른 영역과 넘겨 주는 계약: 9. Contracts with and Handoffs to Other Domains
D15가 소유하는 것은 등록 범위의 부대 지휘, 분대장 하달·자율 선택·: What D15 owns is command of units within the registered scope, squad leader orders, autonomous choices and evaluation data, actual organization and prevention of duplicate reservations, participation by arrival in an ongoing battle, and the input direction of variable capacity. Results from other domains are not automatically generated here.
원격 전달·수신·수락, 권한 판본 / 전투 즉시 하달과 실제 실행 이력: Remote delivery, receipt, and acceptance; authority version / immediate in-battle orders and actual execution history
전투 신호가 원격 전달을 대체하지 않음: A battle signal does not replace remote delivery
실제 사람·장비·보급·예약·이동 완료 / 편성·소비·손실·도착 참가: Actual people, equipment, supplies, reservations, and movement completion / organization, consumption, losses, and arrival participation
소비 마감이 증원 마감이 아니며 취소는 소비 환급이 아님: A consumption deadline is not a reinforcement deadline, and cancellation is not a consumption refund
관측·보고·수신·준수·성과·발신자 / 지휘관 기억 자료: Observation, reports, receipt, compliance, performance, and sender / commander memory data
미정 신뢰 계수·징계가 자동 승인되지 않음: Undecided trust coefficients and disciplinary actions are not automatically approved
실제 사망·구금·부상·권리 승계 / 임시 지휘와 남은 명령 재검사: Actual death, detention, injury, and succession of rights / interim command and re-check of remaining orders
포획=사망, 화면 주체 변경=전장 권한 복사가 아님: Capture is not death, and a change of the on-screen subject is not a copy of battlefield authority
기술별 실제 교육 요구·진척·숙련 / 사람과 역할 예약: Actual per-skill education requirements, progress, and proficiency / reservation of people and roles
문서 접근·상속이 숙련 복사/즉시 해금이 아님; 교사 사망에도 완료 진척: Document access or inheritance is not a copy of proficiency or instant unlocking; completed progress is preserved even if the teacher dies
전투 결과와 포로/점령 근거 / 명분·고정 수혜자·목표 범위 재검사: Battle results and prisoner/occupation evidence / re-check of casus belli, fixed beneficiary, and objective scope
전술 승리·점령은 법적 권리나 정착지 인수 완료가 아님. 유효 명분을 지: Tactical victory or occupation is not a legal right or a completed takeover of a settlement. After continuously checking for a valid casus belli, D16 settles the objective-limited ±100 forced effect
실제 권한·등록 가격·항목별 조건·수락 시 재검사: Actual authority, registered prices, per-item conditions, and re-check upon acceptance
A custom negotiation at abs(war score)<100 and the V-sum structure are not automatic acceptance. Reservation, signing, rights settlement, and actual delivery are kept separate
단일 시간·판본·사건/결과 ID·목적별 난수 / 일관된 결과와 진행 상태: Single time, version, event/result IDs, and purpose-specific random numbers / consistent results and progress state
문서 완료가 런타임·이전 저장의 자동 변환 승인이 아님: Document completion is not approval for automatic conversion of runtimes or earlier saves
본체의 전투 지휘권은 등록 범위의 모든 배속 분대에 적용되며, 범위 밖: The main character's battle command authority applies to all attached squads within the registered scope, and units outside the scope are not controllable merely because they are visible. Squad leader orders are received immediately, but following, partially carrying out, or acting independently are separate choices, and compliance and performance are also separate records. Participation of an actually arrived unit in an ongoing battle and command of that unit are not the same event.
세계에 일어난 사실과 인물이 알게 된 정보는 구분된다. 취소·죽음·정원: Facts that occurred in the world and information a character has learned are distinguished. Even after cancellation, death, capacity reduction, or duplicate results, supplies already consumed, completed progress, personnel to be preserved, and the original sender's history do not disappear. While the policy alternatives in §8 and the Basic-dependent numbers remain undecided, no new combat formulas, capacities, or trust change amounts are fixed, and the original work's times, capacities, and probabilities are not used as Seoul's defaults.
전쟁은 유효한 명분이 정한 목표와 수혜자 안에서만 열리고, 전쟁 점수는: War opens only within the objective and beneficiary set by a valid casus belli, and the war score judges only that objective's termination conditions. Occupation, legal rights, effective control, facility restoration, prisoner status, and peace negotiation may be connected to one another, but they are not the same state. Casus belli lists, occupation ratios, siege formulas, prisoner prices, and negotiation acceptance formulas that are not yet approved are not filled in as if they were rules.
플레이어는 한 캠페인에서 하나의 본체 인물로 행동한다. 다른 모든 인물은: The player acts as a single main-character figure in one campaign. All other characters are NPCs who follow the same action contract as the player. Stable IDs distinguish the identity of characters, rights, wars, and events. Action eligibility re-checks the target's existence, the current ledger version, survival and detention status, and authority. The name-search method and the broad priorities of the historical registry are proposals owned by D01 and are not treated here as approved rules.
전쟁을 열려는 주체는 유효한 명분 인스턴스와 별도의 선전포고 권한을 모두: A party seeking to open a war must hold both a valid casus belli instance and a separate declaration-of-war authority. A casus belli instance fixes the target, war objective, eligible beneficiary, and the effects of attacker victory, defender victory, white peace, and nullification. Owning a rights instance alone does not grant declaration authority, troops, or command. The beneficiary may be the same person as the attacker, but if fixed as another eligible person, victory does not change it to the attacker.
전투에서 플레이어는 자신이 지휘하도록 배정된 모든 분대에 즉시 신호를 보: In battle, the player sends signals immediately to every squad assigned to be commanded. A squad leader may carry out a signal, carry out only part of it, or move differently by local judgment, and the result becomes subject to evaluation. There is no pause, speed control, or command queue. This battle command record is not itself a war score.
Decides whether to open a war with the currently valid casus belli and authority.
전쟁 목표와 현재 점수, 점령·권리·포로 원장을 구분해 다음 행동을 고른: Distinguishes the war objective and current score from the occupation, rights, and prisoner ledgers, and chooses the next action.
절대값 100 미만에서 항목별 강화안을 제시하거나, 받은 안을 거절하거나: Below an absolute value of 100, presents an itemized peace proposal, or rejects or counterproposes a received one. Drafting a proposal is not acceptance or settlement.
실제 이동 중인 부대를 전장으로 보낸다. 전투가 진행 중일 때 실제로 도: Sends units that are actually in transit to the battlefield. While a battle is ongoing, any unit that actually arrives can join as reinforcements, but arrival alone does not create command, siege participation, prisoner handling, or war score.
권한이 있는 직위권자는 기록·공증·계보 담당자에게 주장 구성을 명령할 수: An authorized officeholder can order record, notarization, and lineage officials to compose a claim. A rule allowing a non-officeholder main character to operate this directly has not been adopted.
행동 직전에는 현재 세계 사실을 다시 확인한다. 이름이나 과거 기록이 아: Immediately before an action, current world facts are checked again. The target is found by stable ID rather than by name or past records, and the following are checked in order: target existence and ledger version, the actor's survival and detention status, current authority, location, contact and actual arrival, resources and exclusive reservations, the counterpart's intent, and institutional procedures.
전쟁 개시는 유효한 등록 명분이 없으면 거절된다. 등록 검토 대상인 후보: Opening a war is rejected without a valid registered casus belli. The candidate bundle under registration review is restoration of a recognized right, support for the claim of another eligible person, and remedy for a violation of an approved higher-level contract. A personal debt, a passage dispute, or a sluice-gate stoppage does not by itself become a casus belli for territorial conquest. The specific list and costs of casus belli are still undecided. Individual entries whose issuer, target, beneficiary, objective, nullification conditions, four termination effects, and current registration status are not approved cannot be used.
이미 열린 전쟁에서도 강제 효과를 적용하기 직전에 명분이 계속 유효한지: Even in a war already opened, validity of the casus belli is checked again just before a forced effect is applied. If the basis has disappeared, no new right is created on the spot, and the war ends according to that casus belli's nullification effect. A nullified termination is not recorded as converted into a victory.
전쟁 점수 W는 한쪽 관점에서 -100부터 100까지이며 상대 관점은 -: The war score W ranges from -100 to 100 from one side's perspective, and the opposing perspective is -W. The score is reflected once, only when an accepted event actually occurred and the event's role matches. The same event ID and the same result ID in the same war are not applied again.
The currently approved score entries are as follows.
The battle contribution in a war between rulers is at most 50.
Actually capturing the opposing leader gives +100.
그 전쟁이 지정한 주 후계, 두 번째 후계, 세 번째 후계를 실제로 포획: Actually capturing the primary heir, second heir, and third heir designated by that war gives +50, +25, and +10 respectively.
5. 취소, 죽음, 종료 뒤에도 남는 것: 5. What Remains After Cancellation, Death, and Shutdown
세계 내 취소·사망·해임·점령·연락 단절이 승인과 실행 사이에 발생하면: If an in-world cancellation, death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the remaining execution, authority, and reservations are rechecked. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are not rolled back. Only the remaining unused resources are released under the relevant contract. Canceling an invalid order does not erase actions already carried out, losses already incurred, or witness and evaluation history.
본체 사망/영구 구금에 따른 화면 주체 변경, 부대의 임시 지휘, 항목별: Changing the screen's subject because the main body dies or is permanently detained, a unit's temporary command, item-by-item succession of rights, and the detention of a living character are separate events. If the new main body is far away, it exists there and is not duplicated onto the battlefield. Previous command authority is not copied automatically. Shutdown/loading differs from in-world death or withdrawal; it restores the work in progress in the current phase and the results already settled. Resending the same event does not duplicate people, equipment, damage, or progress. A version mismatch or corrupted save is an explicit error, and gaps are not filled with draft numbers or POC values.
6. 상태 전후로 읽는 장면: 6. Scenes Read Before and After a State
아래 숫자는 보존과 경계를 설명하는 가상 상태 입력이다. 전투 능력·가격: The numbers below are hypothetical state inputs used to explain preservation and boundaries. They are not game values for combat ability, price, capacity, or time intervals.
장면 A: 상위 지휘권과 독자 행동: Scene A: Higher Command Authority and Independent Action
행동 전, 본체 지휘관의 등록 범위에 청문·석교 두 분대가 배속되어 있고: Before the action, two squads, Cheongmun and Seokgyo, are attached within the registered range of the main-body commander, and each has its own separate squad leader. The allied Munru squad is outside the range. The main body can issue valid orders to both Cheongmun and Seokgyo, while Munru can only be observed. In another scene where the main body is a squad leader, it immediately receives a higher commander's order to defend the bridge, but it may choose to take a detour to carry out a rescue. After the action, compliance is recorded as independent action, and the result is recorded separately according to the actual rescue and defensive contribution. Observer Gap knows about the rescue, but Eul, who has not yet received the report, does not. Eul's trust is not updated automatically. No numbers for damage or trust changes are produced.
장면 B: 늦게 온 증원과 별도 지휘권: Scene B: Late Reinforcements and Separate Command Authority
행동 전, 전투는 진행 중이고 다솔 부대는 이동 중이다. 초기 명단에는: Before the action, the battle is in progress and Dasol's unit is on the move. It was not on the initial roster. If the confirmed sequence is that it actually arrived at world time 12 and the battle ended at 13, Dasol gains eligibility to take part in the ongoing battle. Without a registered attachment, the main body gains no authority for direct control. Conversely, in the independent input where the battle ends at 11 and arrival is at 12, it cannot join the finished battle, but the completed movement and the place of arrival remain. If the end and arrival occur at the same time and their order is not confirmed, participation is not decided arbitrarily. This scene does not create a 1-unit reinforcement deadline.
장면 C: 개인화·예약·소비 보존: Scene C: Preservation of Personalization, Reservation, and Consumption
행동 전 총인구는 500명, 집계 500명·개인 0명이다. 5명을 개인화: Before the action, the total population is 500, with 500 aggregate and 0 individual. Personalizing 5 gives 495 aggregate + 5 individual = 500. Assigning 3 of them to a unit gives 495 unassigned aggregate + 2 unassigned individual + 3 in the unit = 500. The 3 in the unit are not also added to facility labor at the same time. Of 10 prepared supplies, 4 are actually consumed and 6 are unused; after 2 stages of preparation progress are completed, the commander dies and the remaining work is canceled. After the action, the 4 consumption records and 2 completed progress stages are preserved, and the remaining 6 supplies are released under the contract. There is no full refund of all 10 and no rewinding progress to 0. Death is a separate population event, so the 500-person preservation of personalization itself must not be confused with the result of the death.
장면 D: 초과 인원과 같은 결과의 재수신: Scene D: Excess Personnel and Re-receiving the Same Result
행동 전 병졸 8명이 있는 부대의 정원이 외부에서 유효하게 6명으로 내려: Before the action, assume the capacity of a unit with 8 soldiers is validly lowered externally to 6. The excess 8−6=2 are not deleted, so after the action the existing soldiers number 8. This does not approve a formula that yields 6, nor a policy for reassigning the 2 excess. If result R, already applied once, is received again, the application count stays at 1. Even if the same attack is issued again through the individual and aggregate channels, the same damage is not added twice. If the damage distribution formula is undecided, the example is not closed by inventing new casualty numbers.
7. 두 원작의 확인된 내용과 서울에서의 사용: 7. Confirmed Content from the Two Source Games and Its Use in Seoul
CK3 커뮤니티 Warfare 문서 판본 36436의 전투 단계 설명은: The combat phase description in CK3 Community Warfare document version 36436 is 2 days. The installation declaration in the preserved CK3 1.20.0.3, build25652598, checksum8e45 is 3 days. These two sources are different authorities and are not merged into an execution result of the same version. Native execution of casualty distribution, rounding, individual identity linking, final capacity selection, and excess handling has not been confirmed, and the execution truth of the current build is not settled by this comparison alone. Neither time value is Seoul's combat cycle.
참고 가치가 있는 것은 개인 부상, 집계 사상자, 결투, 지휘관 성장,: What is worth referencing is the structure that reads individual injuries, aggregate casualties, duels, commander growth, and morale, attack, and defense separately. Aggregate toughness is not a DR subtracted from a single blow. A commander's result/terrain experience is not a per-order evaluation of feasibility, compliance, and outcome. Seoul uses its own approval contract that separates compliance from outcome, and does not substitute CK3's experience or relative weights. The reinforcement replenishment rate and actual arrival and participation on the battlefield are also different channels. Seoul's caps, arrival windows, and queues are not set from unresolved width, replenishment cycles, native RNG, or retreat-order handling.
Norland 커뮤니티 Warfare 판본 1319의 단검 10/가벼운: The Norland Community Warfare version 1319 example of dagger 10 / light armor 10 / heavy armor 30 and the preserved build25211575 values of sword cut 130, sword total 273, light armor total 430, and heavy armor total 1460 are different labels/authorities. No correspondence between the preserved build25211575 and the patch notes below has been confirmed. The heavy armor total is 60+400+1000=1460, and the old 1490 is not used. This total is not interpreted as an actual probability or scalar DR.
Patch38의 기술적 분대 20명 제한은 그 패치의 규칙이다. 서울의: Patch38's technical 20-person squad limit is that patch's own rule. It is not brought into Seoul's variable capacity. Patch36's 60-person Unholy Horde limit after capture is a modification for a specific faction and condition, not a universal capacity or a people-conservation formula. Patch54's victory loyalty of (10+Command)% differs from the order-compliance evaluation. Patch57 BETA's description of preventing flight/surrender for 10 minutes after entering combat is not Seoul's melee lock, withdrawal, or reinforcement restriction. Patch40 BETA's descriptions of gate/archer and tower destruction do not prove a gate-before-tower execution order. Warfare1319's death at pain>50 and States1262's 5-hour unconsciousness after exceeding a threshold conflict with each other, and neither is chosen as the current native truth. What is referenced is the distinction between the channels of individual state, morale, command, and capacity, not a wholesale transplant of the numbers.
이 자료의 문서·선언은 원작의 네이티브 실행 확인이나 서울의 규칙 채택을: The documents and declarations in these sources do not signify confirmation of native execution in the source games or adoption of rules by Seoul. Time, capacity, and probability are not used beyond the scope of application of each source.

The approved direction is as follows: sustained control of all of a casus belli's targets earns time-accumulated points; if the opponent recovers part of them, the accumulation conditions are rechecked; and the time the attacker fails to secure its targets counts toward the defending side. However, the denominator, partial ratios, and the periods, growth rates, and recovery function for Seoul time are undecided, so no numbers can be produced yet.
점수의 절대값이 정확히 100에 닿으면 응답을 기다리며 사건이나 요구를: When the absolute value of the score reaches exactly 100, the game does not wait for a response and does not stack further events or demands. After confirming that the casus belli is still valid, it forcibly settles only the targets and ending effects that the casus belli fixed. Territory outside the targets, every visible asset, and third parties' rights are not taken along with them. If the beneficiary was fixed as another eligible person, the effects accrue to that person.
전투 계산의 상황 보정·개인 판정·부대 집계라는 세 범위를 모두 설계하는: The approved direction is to design all three scopes of combat calculation: situational modifiers, individual resolution, and unit aggregation. The original individual baseline and the original individual redesign are to be compared, but functions, coefficients, upper and lower bounds, channels, damage distribution, and time conversion are undecided. Individual combat attack, defense, damage, and injury values, unit arrival, immediate order execution, and negotiation price V are not W. Values from historical sources, such as occupation coefficients, siege coefficients, and prisoner probabilities, are likewise not Seoul's approved score formula.
점령, 권리, 정착지는 별도 상태다: Occupation, Rights, and Settlements Are Separate States
거점을 점령하면 현장의 실효 지배가 바뀐다. 법적 권리와 작위 원장, 인: Occupying a stronghold changes effective control on the ground. Legal rights and the title ledger, confirmation, resident cooperation, settlement operations, stabilization, integration, and facility restoration do not change automatically. Even if rights are transferred when a war ends, the current controlling party and the settlement's restoration state remain separate. Constructing a claim is not occupation, and occupying is not confirmation of a claim.
절대값 100 미만에서는 권한 있는 당사자가 항목별 강화안을 작성할 수: Below an absolute value of 100, an authorized party can draft an itemized peace proposal. The structure of total demands minus total offers can be displayed as V, but a proposal is not accepted merely because V is at or below W. The registered version of each item's price, the actual authority to dispose, the beneficiary, the current ledger state, and feasibility of fulfillment must each be verified. An item with no price is not free but unvalued, and signing and settlement are locked.
제안, 수락, 서명, 권리 변경, 예약, 실제 인도는 별도 단계다. 서명: Proposal, acceptance, signing, rights change, reservation, and actual delivery are separate stages. Signing does not duplicate or teleport assets or prisoners. A person is not an object of sale, and prisoner items can cover only release, repatriation, interview, and voluntary assignment. The price table, the accept/reject/counteroffer function, reservation lifetime, delivery period, and violation effects remain unapproved items of D17.

Occupation work already finished and supplies already consumed are not rolled back, and only the remaining reservations are released under the relevant contract.

행동 후: R2는 영원히 이동 중으로 고정되지 않는다. 다음 판정 전에: After action: R2 is not fixed as permanently in transit. If it actually arrives before the next resolution and the battle is still ongoing, it joins then. If the battle has already ended, it does not join. Neither arrival is an automatic transfer of command or an addition to W.
예시 4: 가격 없는 강화 항목: Example 4: A Peace Item Without a Price

V is not arbitrarily filled in as 0, and the proposal is not automatically accepted by comparing it with W. The game waits for a new version with the price, authority, and actual repatriation feasibility in place.
실패와 취소 뒤에 남는 것: What Remains After Failure and Cancellation
Without a valid casus belli or the authority to start a war, no war is created.
명분이 무효면 강제 효과를 만들지 않는다. 종결 이유와 이미 발생한 세계: If the casus belli is invalid, no forced effect is created. The reason for ending and world facts that have already occurred remain.
The same event or result ID does not create duplicate scoring or duplicate settlement.
목표 밖 영토, 처분할 수 없는 자산, 제삼자 권리는 강제 이전되지 않는: Territory outside the targets, assets that cannot be disposed of, and third-party rights are not forcibly transferred.
전투가 끝난 뒤 도착한 부대는 그 전투에 참가하지 않는다. 특정 판정 마: A unit that arrives after a battle has ended does not take part in that battle. Arriving after a particular resolution cutoff does not permanently exclude it from all later resolutions.
Death, dismissal, world cancellation, or loss of authority triggers a recheck of the remaining work and reservations. Progress already completed and resources already consumed are not reversed.
수장의 죽음이나 영토 상실만으로 국가나 조직을 지우지 않는다. 조직 소멸: The death of a leader or the loss of territory alone does not erase a state or organization. The conditions for an organization's dissolution are a separate undecided matter.

Facts that actually exist in the world are also kept separate from facts a given person knows. Each person judges based on information they have actually observed or been reported, and hidden facts are not automatically known to everyone.

만료 조건과 재검사 범위 미승인: Expiry conditions and recheck scope not approved

서명, 권리, 예약, 물리 인도가 분리되고 완료분은 보존됨: Signing, rights, reservation, and physical delivery are separated, and completed portions are preserved

상태: 제안. 승인된 규칙, 선택된 정책, 미채택 대안과 미정 수치를 구: Status: Proposal. This separates approved rules, selected policies, rejected alternatives, and undecided numbers. It does not mean the feature is implemented. Re-evaluating a negotiation requires explicit authority, a new version, a state snapshot, or an actual invalidating event; a pending request alone does not erase an earlier acceptance.
이 문서는 전쟁 중 항목별 협상안이 언제 열리고, 누가 무엇을 제안할 수: This document explains when item-by-item negotiation proposals open during a war, who can propose what, and how signing diverges from actual delivery. It separates already approved rules from policies not yet chosen, and it does not carry figures from comparison games or markers meant for technical verification into Seoul's rules.
한 플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 캠페인에 참여한다. 다른 인물은 같은 행동: Each player takes part in a campaign as one main-body character. Other characters are NPCs who follow the same action conditions. On the negotiation screen, players and NPCs perform the same kinds of actions according to their current signing authority, disposal authority, knowledge, and actual ability to fulfill terms.
전쟁 점수의 절댓값이 100보다 작은 동안, 해당 전쟁의 서명 권한자는: While the absolute value of the war score is less than 100, the signing authority of that war may decide the following.
Draft and propose demands and offers item by item.
Accept, reject, or counter a received proposal.
명분이 허용하는 요구를 줄이거나, 상대가 실제로 이행할 수 있는 자발적: Reduce demands to what the casus belli allows, or offer a voluntary substitute payment or obligation that the other side can actually fulfill.
Sign a proposal whose registered prices, current authority, and ledgers all match.
협상안에는 전쟁 ID, 제안 판본, 양측 서명 권한, 수혜자, 요구와 제: A negotiation proposal contains the war ID, proposal version, both sides' signing authorities, the beneficiary, the item lists for demands and offers, the fulfillment timing, the deadline, and the breach effects. The presence of these fields does not mean the price figures, deadline lengths, or breach effects have already been approved.
전쟁 점수가 정확히 +100 또는 -100에 닿는 일은 플레이어가 확인하: A war score reaching exactly +100 or -100 is not a negotiation option the player confirms. If the casus belli is still valid at that moment, the system force-concludes the war within that casus belli's target scope.
중간 협상은 `|W| < 100`일 때 열린다. 여기서 `W`는 -100: Mid-war negotiation opens when `|W| < 100`. Here `W` is the war score, ranging from -100 to +100, and it appears to the opponent as `-W`. Drafting or sending a proposal does not consume or reduce W. Being below 100 does not by itself produce an acceptance either.
Each item must pass all of the following conditions to remain in a finalized proposal.
The item type and price version are registered.
요구자가 그 항목을 요구할 권한이 있고, 이행자가 대상 영토·권리·자산·: The demander has the authority to demand the item, and the fulfiller has the authority to actually dispose of or carry out the target territory, right, asset, or obligation.
강제 요구라면 현재 유효한 명분의 목표 범위 안에 있다. 목표 밖 내용은: If it is a forced demand, it lies within the target scope of the currently valid casus belli. Content outside the target may be a separate deal the other side freely agrees to, but it cannot be disguised as a coercive effect of the casus belli.
The same ledger asset is not redundantly reserved or demanded in more than one item.
수혜자가 고정되어 있는 권리나 계약이라면 공격자라는 이유로 수혜자를 바꾸: If a right or contract has a fixed beneficiary, the beneficiary is not changed simply because one party is the attacker.
서명 직전에 전쟁, 명분, 권한, 소유·채권·구금 원장과 실제 이행 가능: Immediately before signing, the war, casus belli, authority, ownership, claim, and custody ledgers, and the actual ability to fulfill, are checked again.
협상 항목에는 영지와 권리의 이전, 자산의 지급·반환, 포로의 석방·송환: Negotiation items may include transfers of fiefs and rights, payment or return of assets, release or repatriation of prisoners, and promises such as passage, water supply, rations, escort, ratification, higher-level contracts, and ceasefires. Characters are subjects of release, repatriation, interview, and voluntary assignment, not goods to be traded. Forced marriage and non-consensual assignment do not exist in this structure. A synthetic being recognized as a person is likewise not a transferable asset.
A name may be used to find a subject, while a stable ID establishes the actual identity. Even if a name changes or there are namesakes, the IDs of proposals, rights, and delivery targets do not change. A past approval roster is a record of past identification, not an authority that overwrites the current world's ownership, survival, custody, position, location, or authority. This surface rule is the current proposal owned by D01 and does not imply D17's prices or acceptance approval.
Even when several numbers appear together on the negotiation screen, they are distinct records.
`W` is the war score. It is not a price, currency, or acceptance probability.
`V`는 같은 전쟁과 같은 제안 판본의 상태 스냅샷에서 `요구 항목 가격: `V` is a value composed, from a state snapshot of the same war and the same proposal version, as `sum of demanded item prices - sum of offered item prices`.
항목 가격은 등록된 가격 판본의 기록이다. 가격 판본이 없는 항목은 무료: An item price is a record from a registered price version. An item without a price version is not free but **pending valuation**.
수락 판단은 W, 목표 통제, 보급, 계승, 핵심 포로, 현재 의무, 관: The acceptance judgment may read W, target control, supply, succession, key prisoners, current obligations, relationships, memory, authority, and ability to fulfill. The function and coefficients for combining these inputs have not yet been approved.
따라서 `V <= W`는 자동 수락 조건이 아니다. V의 합 구조는 비교: Therefore `V <= W` is not an automatic acceptance condition. The sum structure of V only produces comparable records; it does not replace the other side's consent or signing authority. A finalized proposal containing even one unregistered item is blocked from signing and settlement, but this does not remove the eligibility to keep negotiating the other registered items in a new version.
이미 승인된 전쟁 점수 수치는 실제 역할과 사건이 일치할 때만 W에 기록: Already approved war score figures are recorded in W only when the actual role and the event match. A battle contribution between lords is at most 50, capturing the opposing head is +100, the actual primary heir is +50, the second heir is +25, the third heir is +10, and actually occupying the capital is +10. The same character and event are not counted twice. +30 is the point at which a white-peace request can be made, not an automatic acceptance. These numbers are not item prices, acceptance modifiers, or reparation amounts. The denominator for occupation contribution, partial occupation, the duration of target control, and the rate of increase have not been decided.
4. 서명, 정산, 예약과 실제 인도: 4. Signing, Settlement, Reservation, and Actual Delivery
Proposal, reservation, signing, closing settlement, and actual delivery are separate stages.
**전:** `|W| < 100`이고 전쟁과 명분이 유효하다. 모든 항목: **Before:** `|W| < 100`, and the war and casus belli are valid. Every item has a registered price version, there are no duplicate demands on the same asset, and both sides' signing and disposal authorities and the beneficiary match the current ledgers.
**행동:** 상대가 안을 수락한다. 시스템은 같은 제안 판본에서 전쟁,: **Action:** The other side accepts the proposal. The system rechecks the war, casus belli, signatories, beneficiary, ownership, claim and custody status, reservation conflicts, and ability to fulfill in the same proposal version.
**후:** 단일 종결 정산과 항목별 이행 계약이 생성된다. 권리의 확정: **After:** A single closing settlement and per-item fulfillment contracts are created. Confirmation of a right, reservation of an asset, signing, and actual physical delivery are distinct. At the moment of signing, goods in an enemy storehouse or prisoners are not copied into the beneficiary's list or teleported.
Reservation is the stage that prevents the same asset from being promised again in another contract. When each item is reserved, whether a reservation is exclusive from before signing, and in what order the remaining reservations are released upon cancellation have not yet been approved. Because of this undecided policy, the current document does not treat a reservation as an automatic transfer of ownership or an automatic delivery.
실제 인도는 위치, 보관 책임, 구금 상태, 통행 가능성, 수령 권한과: Actual delivery is a campaign action that rechecks location, custodial responsibility, custody status, passability, the recipient's authority, and the contract terms. Even if the contract's responsible party dies or loses authority, or the war or a world action is canceled, deliveries already completed, resources already consumed, and progress already made are not rolled back. Only the unfulfilled remainder and reservations are rechecked under current authority and the contract.
유효한 명분 전쟁이 정확히 +100 또는 -100에 닿으면 NPC의 응답: When a valid casus belli war reaches exactly +100 or -100, it concludes immediately, regardless of NPC response delays or the state of the negotiation screen. At +100 the casus belli's victory effects apply, and at -100 the surrender effects on the losing side apply. Open negotiation proposals are discarded, and territory, assets, and persons outside the casus belli's targets, objects the other side cannot dispose of, and the rights of third parties are not forcibly transferred.
수락, ±100 도달, 서명자 사망 또는 권한 변경이 같은 사건 경계에서: If acceptance, reaching ±100, a signatory's death, or a change of authority compete at the same event boundary, only one conclusion is produced, based on the confirmed event order and version. The same event ID or an already finished result ID is not applied again to create a second settlement. However, the final precedence among these events at the same instant has not yet been approved, so do not assume any particular event type always comes first.
명분 근거가 종결 전에 사라졌다면 D16이 명분의 지속 유효성을 먼저 검: If the grounds for the casus belli disappeared before the conclusion, D16 first checks the casus belli's continued validity. A territory's legal right, current effective control, settlement affiliation, and physical occupation are different states, and a single negotiation signature does not make them all the same value.
6. 실패했을 때 남는 것과 플레이어 정보: 6. What Remains on Failure, and Player Information
A failure shows its reasons and effects item by item.
미등록 가격은 `평가 미정`으로 표시하고 확정 안의 서명을 막는다. 0원: Unregistered prices are displayed as `Pyeongga mijeong` (valuation pending) and block signing of the finalized proposal. They are not displayed as 0 won or free.
처분 권한 없음, 명분 범위 밖, 고정 수혜자 불일치, 제삼자 권리, 중: Lack of disposal authority, being outside the casus belli's scope, a fixed-beneficiary mismatch, third-party rights, and duplicate reservations cause the item to be rejected. The target asset's current ownership and location remain unchanged.
전쟁이 먼저 ±100에 닿으면 열린 안은 폐기되고 명분 종결 하나만 남는: If the war reaches ±100 first, the open proposal is discarded and only the casus belli's conclusion remains.
서명 뒤 인도 실패는 서명과 권리 확정을 지우지 않고, 남은 인도 의무·: A delivery failure after signing does not erase the signing or the confirmation of rights; it leaves the remaining delivery obligations, the breach state, and the need for a recheck. The specific breach effects have not yet been approved.
제안 작성 중 세계 사실이 바뀌면 낡은 판본에 조용히 서명하지 않고 재검: If world facts change while a proposal is being drafted, the player is not silently made to sign an outdated version; the recheck result is shown instead.
같은 사건이나 결과의 재전송은 새로운 정산, 포로 석방, 자산 복제를 만: Resending the same event or result does not create a new settlement, a prisoner release, or an asset duplication.
플레이어는 현재 W, 제안 판본, 항목별 요구·제공 구분, 가격 등록 여: The player should be able to distinguish and view the current W, the proposal version, the demand/offer split per item, whether prices are registered, the beneficiary, signing and disposal authority, the casus belli scope, duplicate reservations, settlement status, and actual delivery status. Why the other side rejected or countered is shown within the range of information that character actually knows and has evaluated. The facts of the world and the facts each character knows are not the same, and hidden information does not become NPC knowledge merely because it exists in the UI.
명분 생성·유효성·W·±100 효과: Casus belli creation, validity, W, and ±100 effects
유효한 전쟁과 점수를 읽고 협상 개방·폐기·종결 경계를 적용한다: Reads the valid war and score, and applies the boundaries for opening, discarding, and concluding negotiations
소유·채권·가산·상속·가족 계약: Ownership, claims, additional assets, inheritance, and family contracts
현재 처분 권한과 수혜자를 읽는다. 가족·혼인별 지분과 분배 수치는 만들: Reads the current disposal authority and beneficiary. Does not create per-family or per-marriage shares or distribution figures
영토·권리·인준·실효 지배: Territory, rights, ratification, and effective control
협상 항목과 강제 범위를 구분한다. 권리 이전을 주민 편입이나 즉시 점유: Distinguishes negotiation items from the coercive scope. Does not turn a transfer of rights into incorporation of residents or immediate occupation
자산 위치·보관·예약·물리 인도: Asset location, custody, reservation, and physical delivery
A: 기관별 개별 수락·평가, B: 국가 공통 증빙 절차와 기관별 실습: A: Each institution accepts and evaluates separately; B: A shared national evidence procedure plus institution-specific practical review. After selection, author the responsibilities and authority; numbers and technical requirements are approved separately.
직업만 있는 인물·후계 지명·기관 비밀: Characters with only an occupation, succession designations, institutional secrets
정보 노후화·전달: GP-02 미승인; S3, S1.b75: Information aging and delivery: GP-02 not approved; S3, S1.b75
수신자가 보고를 해석; 실제 세계와 지식 구분: The recipient interprets the report; the actual world and knowledge are kept distinct
속도·노후화·탐사 확률 없음: No speed, aging, or exploration probability
A: 보고 시각을 그대로 보여 판단, B: 판본별 확인 필요 상태를 추가: A: Show the report time as is and let the player judge; B: Add a needs-confirmation state per version. After selection, specify what the state means; no arbitrary times or probabilities.
옛 위치 보고·반증·늦게 도착한 보고·원본 보존: Reports of old locations, refutations, late-arriving reports, preservation of originals
교육 실제 수행과 성취 보존은 확정되어도 기술별 수치와 정책은 이 표의: Although the actual performance of education and the preservation of achievements are confirmed, the per-skill numbers and policies remain undecided until the decisions in this table. Name, person, and record search is an unadopted proposal separate from stable-ID approval. Even if search is adopted, it does not mean a name match alone would establish the same person, access rights, or current status. Completing this document is not approval of the whole of D14, its numbers, its runtime, or the Basic source.
S0은 D14 결정 범위, S1은 싱글플레이 설계 SP-1.0.0의 표시: S0 is the scope of D14 decisions, S1 is the marked blocks of the single-player design SP-1.0.0, S2 is the per-skill actual education clauses, and S3 is the movement, information, and settlement clauses of campaign progression. C-CHILD, C-LANGUAGE, C-XP, C-CULTURE, and C-TEACH are the marked script mechanisms of CK3 1.20.0.3/build 25652598. N-01–N-12, N-22, and N-58 are Norland documents whose edition, release date, and beta or release version are marked above. The source work's documents and script descriptions are separate from Seoul's confirmed rules.
플레이어는 국가 자체가 아니라 한 인물의 몸으로 단일 캠페인을 이어 간다: The player continues a single campaign through the body of one character, not the state itself. NPCs also follow the same qualification, authority, and resource conditions for movement, labor, education, politics, and combat. Combat controls are Total War–style unit selection and unit orders. They are not action inputs that continuously control a hero's personal attacks and dodges. Individual resolution and unit aggregation are separate responsibilities that calculate the actual results of those orders.
본체가 전투 지휘관이면 그 전투에 등록된 지휘 범위 안의 **모든 배속: If the main body is a battle commander, they directly select **all attached squads** within the command range registered for that battle and direct their movement, stance, and attacks. The existence of a separate squad leader does not block higher command authority. If the main body is a squad leader, they receive a superior commander's orders within the battle as an immediate signal and choose among following, partially carrying out, or acting independently. Receiving an order is neither a control lock nor forced obedience. A superior main body's valid command authority and a subordinate NPC's execution judgment go through the same execution check. Autonomous judgment does not eliminate the superior's attachment range.
전장에는 일시정지, 감속·배속, 쌓아 두는 명령 큐가 없다. 하달의 현재: The battlefield has no pause, slow-down or speed-up, or queue for stacking orders. The current state and change history of an order remain, but the history is not executed as a queue of future actions. The battlefield screen is shown only for battles in which the main body actually participates. In other battles, the local commander commands automatically using pre-set objectives, stance, and authority, along with the information, abilities, and targets they actually observed. Automatic and manual command use the same execution and result-application contract, and the utility formula, tie-breaking, and re-evaluation interval of automatic command are undecided.

대상 존재·현재 판본, 수행 가능성, 등록 지휘 범위와 배속, 실제 현장: Target exists and is the current version, feasibility, registered command range and attachment, actual presence on site and delivery, resource and exclusive reservations, check of the other party's intent/procedure
유효 명령의 수신·실행·변경 원인이 남음: The receipt, execution, and cause of change of a valid order are recorded
적, 비배속 독립군, 범위 밖 동맹은 보인다는 이유만으로 조작되지 않음: Enemies, unattached independent forces, and allies outside the range cannot be controlled merely because they are visible
유효 발신자·대상·전투 하달 관계: Valid sender, target, and in-battle order relationship
즉시 수신 후 분대장의 선택과 실제 실행을 구분: Distinguishes the squad leader's choice and actual execution after immediate receipt
근접 교전 중 새 명령은 그 교전이 끝날 때까지 거절. 거절을 수행이나: During melee engagement, a new order is rejected until that engagement ends. The rejection is not recorded as carrying out the order or as deliberate disobedience
유효 지휘권과 실제 연락 경로: Valid command authority and an actual communication channel
전달·수신·수락 뒤 예약/실행: Reservation/execution after delivery, receipt, and acceptance
전투 안 즉시 신호를 전략 연락이나 순간 이동으로 확대하지 않음: An in-battle immediate signal is not extended into strategic communication or teleportation
전투가 아직 진행 중이고 해당 부대가 실제로 도착: The battle is still in progress and the unit has actually arrived
도착 부대는 참가 가능, 현재 배속·권한은 별도 확인: The arriving unit may participate; its current attachment and authority are checked separately
출발지·계급·초기 명단·임의 시간창으로 참가 자격을 닫지 않음. 참가와: Eligibility to participate is not closed off by origin, rank, initial roster, or an arbitrary time window. Participation and the transfer of command authority are separate
사람의 수락, 장비·보급, 지휘관, 겹치지 않는 시간 예약: A person's acceptance, equipment and supplies, a commander, non-overlapping time reservations
기존 사람을 실제 편성에 배정: Assigns an existing person to the actual organization
명부/무기고 열람만으로 사람·장비·부대가 생기지 않음: Merely viewing a roster or armory does not create people, equipment, or units
유효 퇴로와 확인, 전투 전체에 적용되는 유효 명령: A valid line of retreat and confirmation, and a valid order applying to the entire battle
분대의 후방 이동은 전장 안 이동이며 참가 이탈·전투 종료가 아님: A squad's rearward movement is movement within the battlefield and is neither leaving participation nor the end of the battle
전투가 끝난 뒤 도착한 부대는 끝난 그 전투에 참가하지 못한다. 그러나: A unit that arrives after a battle has ended cannot participate in that ended battle. After execution, the order's purpose, time of receipt, feasibility, squad state, actual actions, contribution to objectives, losses, civilian harm, and any change or cancellation by a superior order are linked as evaluation data. **Compliance and performance are two separate records.** Contributing to an objective through independent action is not converted into order compliance. 4. 사람, 편성, 정원과 결과의 책임: 4. People, Organization, Capacity, and Responsibility for Results
집계 주민을 개인으로 적는 것은 기존 구성원에 신원을 연결하는 표현 변화: Writing an aggregate resident as an individual is a change of representation that links an identity to an existing member. It is not the creation of a new person. The same person is not counted twice as aggregate available labor and as individual labor, nor reserved overlappingly at the same time for facility, transport, treatment, or unit roles. Birth, death, migration, and capture are separate population/recruit events. A return neither creates a new person nor revives a dead person's reservations.
정원은 지휘관 개인 능력, 국가 수준, 정착지 수준에 따라 달라진다. 모: Capacity varies with the commander's personal ability, the state's level, and the settlement's level. There is no common cap for all units. The former maximum of 20 per rank-and-file squad is not the current cap. Heroes are separate from rank-and-file troops and are not counted in the rank-and-file number. If the commander is absent, the temporary rank-and-file squad leader rule is kept, but no numbers are created for its effects. Even if capacity shrinks, excess personnel already in a unit are preserved. The definitions of ability and level, the capacity formula, the reorganization location for excess personnel, and the policy for handling new replacements are undecided. Preserving excess personnel is not approval of a new cap or of a restriction on arrival eligibility.
전투 계산의 승인된 범위는 상황 보정, 개인 판정, 부대 집계와 하나의: The approved scope of combat calculation is situational modifiers, individual resolution, unit aggregation, and a single result ledger. The situation includes the basis of command, morale, fatigue, supply, terrain, formation, and scale; the individual includes ability, skills, weapons, armor, physical condition, and mood; and the aggregate includes organization, participating personnel, equipment, and actual actions. The channels of individual hit, defense, DR, damage, shock, injury, consciousness, and death are not mixed with the channels of aggregate ability, attrition, morale, and operational capacity. If the aggregate is a means of inflicting damage, it must first be determined to which person's action and target it is attributed. Each action and target has exactly one application responsibility; aggregate damage is not added after individual damage, and aggregate losses are not deducted twice from both the total and the individual. A ResultId is settled only once per campaign.

Approving the scope alone does not produce hit or loss numbers. Another game's toughness or defense weighting is not converted into individual DR. Combat, encounter, world event, and character random numbers are separated by purpose, and the same world and events must be reproducible from the same seed and choice record, but no new random number algorithm has been chosen.

1. 행위자와 플레이어가 결정하는 것: 1. Actors and What the Player Decides
한 플레이어는 한 본체 인물로 단일 캠페인을 이어 간다. 다른 모든 인물: One player continues a single campaign with one main-body character. All other characters are NPCs who use the same action contract as the player. A permanent ID identifies the same character, unit, right, and event regardless of name changes or namesakes, and edition conflicts are surfaced explicitly. The surface rule that gives the current world ledger priority over name searches and past approval rosters is a proposal owned by D01. D18 carries that proposal through consistently on the time and save screens but does not turn it into a new approval.
The player's actual decisions are as follows.
전투 지휘관인 본체는 등록된 지휘 범위의 **모든 배속 분대**를 선택하: The main body, as a battle commander, selects **all attached squads** within the registered command scope and issues valid orders such as movement, stance, and attack. Enemy forces, unattached independent forces, and allied forces outside the scope cannot be controlled merely because they are visible.
본체가 분대장이면 상위 지휘관의 하달을 즉시 시스템 신호로 받는다. 플레: If the main body is a squad leader, orders from a superior commander arrive immediately as a system signal. The player may choose to comply, partially carry out the order, or act independently. After actual execution, the commander character who issued the original order owns a per-order assessment of purpose, feasibility, contribution, losses, and civilian harm, and it remains as a memory about that main body. The sender, order ID, and result ID are preserved together. There is not yet a fixed trust penalty or promotion value.
전쟁 점수의 절댓값이 100 미만인 동안 양측은 개별 항목을 넣은 협상안: While the absolute value of the war score is below 100, both sides can propose, reject, counter-propose, and accept negotiation proposals containing individual items. Unregistered price items cannot be signed, and a proposal is not automatically accepted merely because `proposal value <= war score`.
저장 UI의 요청자 자격은 아직 정해지지 않았다. 다만 저장이 허용되는: The eligibility of the requester for the save UI is not yet determined. However, the points at which saving is permitted and the meaning of restoration are determined as follows.
전투는 실시간으로 흐른다. 일시정지, 속도 조절, 명령 큐는 없다. 이것: Battle flows in real time. There is no pause, speed control, or command queue. This does not mean there are no orders themselves. Current orders are delivered immediately, and a squad either carries them out from its current state or uses its own judgment.
세계 시간은 하나이며 캠페인 시작을 기산점으로 하는 정수 틱으로 기록한다: World time is single and recorded in integer ticks counted from the start of the campaign. A matured event produces the next simulation advance. Independent simultaneous proposals that satisfy their causal preconditions obtain a total order by admission approval order, and there is no hidden priority determined by event type alone. The exact symbolic time and remainder are preserved and are not rounded up arbitrarily.
같은 시각에 사망, 부대 도착, 협상 비준, 전쟁 점수 ±100 도달이: Which admission is approved first when death, unit arrival, negotiation ratification, and the war score reaching ±100 occur at the same moment has not yet been finalized. Until it is finalized, we do not write that any event type automatically takes precedence. This gap is not an option the player chooses but an open item in the event order contract.
난수는 목적·대상 엔티티·상태로 스트림을 분리하고 사건 키 주소로 추출한: Random numbers separate streams by purpose, target entity, and state, and are drawn by event-key address. The same address and the same payload point to the same existing result, and a different payload is not written over the same address. The seed, hash, and numeric drawing method have not yet been approved.
본체가 전투 지휘관이고 전투 세션의 등록 범위와 배속 목록에 들어 있는: Only squads for which the main body is the battle commander and which are in the battle session's registered scope and attachment list are controlled directly. A superior's order received by the main-body squad leader arrives immediately but is neither forced execution nor an input lock.
진행 중인 전투에 **실제로 도착한 어느 부대든** 증원으로 참가할 수: **Any unit that has actually arrived** at a battle in progress can join as reinforcements. Origin, rank, the initial organization table, and arbitrary time windows are not additional qualifications. A unit that has not yet arrived does not participate, and strategic movement is not turned into instant teleportation.
전: 전투는 진행 중이고 본체는 등록 범위의 배속 분대를 지휘한다. 후발: Before: The battle is in progress, and the main body commands the attached squads within the registered scope. One later-arriving unit is moving along its actual route.
행동: 지휘관은 배속 분대에 즉시 명령을 내린다. 분대장은 따르기·부분: Action: The commander issues an immediate order to an attached squad. The squad leader chooses one of comply, partially carry out, or act independently. The later-arriving unit actually arrives during the battle.
후: 실제 결과가 나온 뒤 준수 여부와 성과는 별도로 평가된다. 평가 결: After: Once the actual result is produced, compliance and performance are evaluated separately. The evaluation result is attributed to the original sending commander character, becomes the basis of that character's memory and later assignment and trust judgments, and is tied to the order ID and result ID. A subordinate squad leader's autonomous choice does not transfer ownership of the evaluation. The unit that arrived becomes a reinforcement participant. A unit that has not arrived or one outside the scope does not become a controllable squad.
불가능한 명령은 자의적 불복종과 구분한다. 지휘관 사망이나 권한 변경 뒤: An impossible order is distinguished from arbitrary disobedience. After a commander's death or a change of authority, existing orders are rechecked under the new authority while preserving the original sender and history. The display proposal is to show, within the information the current main body actually knows and its access qualifications, the commandable scope, the purpose and status of the received order, the confirmed execution result, and the time of the evidence, each distinguished. The fact that the world's actual result is preserved does not mean the entire result is disclosed immediately. The action UI distinguishes possible, prerequisites lacking, no authority, awaiting response, and institution undetermined, but explains reasons that rely on hidden facts as "insufficient confirmed evidence" so as not to leak them. Hidden evaluation coefficients and unapproved trust values are not displayed.
전쟁은 유효하게 등록된 명분 인스턴스가 있어야 열린다. 명분은 대상, 등: A war can be opened only if there is a validly registered casus belli instance. A casus belli has a target, a registered eligible beneficiary, an objective, victory, defeat, white peace, and nullification effects, and validity conditions. Holding a casus belli alone does not create authority to declare war or forces, and the eligible beneficiary is fixed to the casus belli when the war begins. The war score `W` ranges from -100 to +100, and the opponent's is `-W`.
Before: The casus belli is valid and `|W| < 100`.
행동: 양측은 요구와 제공을 함께 적은 협상안을 제안하고 평가한다. 영지: Action: Both sides propose and evaluate a negotiation proposal that lists demands and offers together. Items such as domains and rights, assets, release and repatriation of prisoners, passage, water supply, rations, escort, ratification, and truce can be used. Each item is checked for disposal authority, actual feasibility of fulfillment, casus belli scope, and the registered price edition.
후: 수락되면 권한과 원장을 다시 검사한 뒤 단일 종결 정산과 실제 인도: After: If accepted, authority and the ledger are rechecked, and this leads to a single termination settlement and actual delivery and fulfillment. If rejected, the war and time continue. Unregistered prices and third-party rights that cannot be disposed of are not signed.
전·사건·후: ±100 강제 종결: Before, Event, After: Forced Termination at ±100
전: 명분이 유효하고 점수가 목표 범위 안에서 정확히 +100 또는 -1: Before: The casus belli is valid, and the score reaches exactly +100 or -100 within the objective range.
사건: 먼저 개전 때 고정한 명분 판본과 수혜자를 읽고 근거 변화에 따른: Event: First, read the casus belli edition and beneficiary fixed when the war began, and recheck the casus belli's validity and that beneficiary's eligibility under any change in the grounds. If it is still valid, the war is forcibly terminated immediately with that casus belli's victory or defeat effect, without separate player confirmation. NPC response delay cannot postpone termination and does not become time to pile up additional capture, occupation, or property demands. Negotiation proposals that were not accepted are discarded.
후: 명분에 적힌 범위만 종결 정산으로 넘어간다. 목표 밖 영토·자산·인: After: Only the scope written in the casus belli passes to the termination settlement. Territory, assets, and persons outside the objective, targets the opponent cannot dispose of, and third-party rights are not transferred by force. Asset delivery and follow-up obligations after signing or termination remain as actual campaign procedures and are not copied instantly.
명분 근거가 먼저 사라졌다면 ±100 종결 효과보다 명분별 무효 규칙을: If the grounds for the casus belli disappeared first, the per-casus-belli nullification rule is checked before the ±100 termination effect, and no rights or transfers without grounds are created. Not every war is terminated automatically merely because a leader dies. The specific prices, quantities, and fulfillment timing of items within the objective have not yet been approved.
