《서울:전국》은 외부 규칙표의 작동 차용 없이 자체 인물 체계를 설계한다: *Seoul: Nationwide* designs its own character system without operationally borrowing from external rule tables. The owner's decision of 2026-10-12 sets the eight competencies (Leadership, Strategy, Negotiation, Administration, Insight, Learning, Skill, and Stamina) at a base integer of 0–20, a final integer of 0–100, and a separate action proficiency of 0–99.9. A base competency of 10 means an expert in that field, and no effect can push the final value above 100. The single-Skill 0–12 resolution profile of 2026-10-08 is preserved as a past design and is not automatically applied to the new character system. The new resolution formula, effect composition, and growth formula are undecided.
2026-10-08 프로필은 행위측과 저항측의 공정한 d10으로 마진=(: The 2026-10-08 profile used a fair d10 for each of the acting side and the resisting side to calculate margin = (rA − rB) + (aA − aB) + c. Positive, zero, and negative results were classified as success, deadlock, and resisting-side success. The distributions of 45·10·45 for equal conditions and 64·8·28 for a 2-point Skill advantage were confirmed by full enumeration at the time. This verification is limited to the old profile and does not prove the resolution formula or probabilities of the new eight-competency and proficiency system.
과거 프로필 seoul-opposed-d10-0-12-c4-v1의 기량: The Skill 0–12 and the modifier −4 to +4 of the past profile seoul-opposed-d10-0-12-c4-v1 are records of that edition. They are neither converted to the new base competency 0–20, final 0–100, and proficiency 0–99.9, nor simply expanded in range. Resolution does not automatically generate facts of consent, ownership, arrival, treatment, or death; authority and actual fulfillment follow separate contracts.
기존 1,022명의 인물 수치 54,467개는 변경 없이 봉인했다. 능력: The 54,467 character figures of the existing 1,022 characters have been sealed without change. Ability scores, skills, CP, and auxiliary figures are preserved read-only as historical setting values and are not automatically converted into the new Skill. Both historical editions (parent pin ce173686, working copy 5f34d92d) are maintained, and issuance, screens, and APIs require an explicit edition selection. There is no automatic latest selection.
특성은 수행·행동 선택·스트레스·관계에 영향을 주고 사건과 행동으로 획득: Traits affect performance, action choices, stress, and relationships, and are acquired through events and actions. Core dispositions do not change easily, but some traits and states change through experience. The trait list and numerical effects will be designed separately, and the past nine logic and eight perspective categories are not automatically adopted. Authority is not granted by ability scores. Icons are produced in Seoul's own grammar, and traits for which there is no observation authority are not displayed.
과거 보존 원장·판본 선택·대항 d10·열여덟 영역 시트는 당시 스프레드: The past preserved ledger, edition selection, opposed d10, and eighteen-domain sheets are records verified by spreadsheet recalculation at the time. The existing modules in TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg are also contracts of that edition and do not mean the new system has been implemented.
개별 인물의 8역량·숙련·특성 배정, 생리·피해·성장·효과 산식과 국가별: The assignment of eight competencies, proficiencies, and traits to individual characters, the formulas for physiology, damage, growth, and effects, and the national systems are subject to separate authoring. The degree of damage and functional state of both arms, both legs, head, and torso are distinguished from disease progression. This document records the confirmed scope and unresolved rules, not issuance to all characters or completed implementation.
서울:전국 싱글플레이 상세 기획서: Seoul: Nationwide Single-Player Detailed Design Document
판본: SP-1.0.0 · 2026-10-03 · 정본 기준 GDD ma: Edition: SP-1.0.0 · 2026-10-03 · Canonical baseline GDD main eae8951b
이 기획서는 한 플레이어가 한 본체 인물을 통해 이어 가는 캠페인을 정의: This design document defines a campaign that one player continues through one main-body character. Other characters in the world are NPCs that use the same action contract. Here, a game session is a single campaign continued through saving and loading. Network connections, hosts, occupancy between players, and synchronization are not included in the design scope.
기존 GDD의 확정 규칙은 유지한다. 소유자 지시에 따라 상태·행동·계승: The confirmed rules of the existing GDD are maintained. Following the owner's instructions, the mechanisms of state, action, succession, transmission, relationships, saving, combat orders, justification, and original reinforcement are defined as contracts of this edition. Separate figures, empty national data, and calculation coefficients are undecided. Calculation functions, new costs, and new durations are not invented as numbers. If there is no input in the system ledger, the relevant action is marked "System Undecided" and is not given arbitrary success or free processing.
1. 플레이의 중심과 공통 실행 계약: 1. The Center of Play and the Common Execution Contract
플레이어의 목적은 본체의 생존·생활·관계·기술·권리를 유지하고 확대하는: The player's goal is to maintain and expand the main-body character's survival, livelihood, relationships, skills, and rights. Becoming a ruler is not the only path of progression. Workers, agents, officers on duty, commanders, fief holders, and institutional heads all act on the basis of their own qualifications and contracts. Livelihood achievements become evidence of contract fulfillment, and that evidence affects cooperation, appointment, support, and confirmation. Successfully completing a repair does not automatically grant a post.
1.1 상태를 하나의 신분 칸에 합치지 않는다: 1.1 Status Is Not Merged into a Single Rank Slot
영구 ID, 생존, 의식·부상, 구금, 의사 표현 능력: Permanent ID, survival, consciousness/injury, detention, ability to express intent
행동을 스스로 수행할 수 있는가: Can the character perform actions on their own
실제 소재지, 이동 경로·태세·진척: Actual whereabouts, movement route, posture, progress
현장 접근, 면담, 작업, 전투 참가: On-site access, interviews, work, combat participation
국가·조직 가입, 인정 주체와 판본: Joining a state or organization, recognizing party and edition
가입 대상 권리와 의무: Rights and duties of the joined party
기관·직함·티어, 임기/계승 방식, 관할, 서명 권한: Institution, title, tier, term/succession method, jurisdiction, signing authority
어떤 기관 행위를 승인할 수 있는가: Which institutional acts can be approved
작위 ID, 보유자, 대상 영역, 상위 계약, 인정 상태: Peerage ID, holder, target domain, superior contract, recognition status
어떤 권리와 의무를 가졌는가: What rights and duties the character holds
현재 현장에서 집행 가능한가: Can it currently be enforced on site
대상 부대·지휘 간선·위임 범위·만료: Target unit, command trunk line, scope of delegation, expiration
누구에게 어느 명령을 내릴 수 있는가: Which orders can be given to whom
실제 일을 할 수 있는가: Can the character actually do the work
소유·보관·사용·담보·임대·금고 권한: Ownership, custody, use, collateral, lease, and vault authority
재산을 소비·양도·인도할 수 있는가: Can the character spend, transfer, or deliver the property
방향성 신뢰, 친족, 혼인, 빚, 맹세, 사건 기억: Directional trust, kinship, marriage, debt, oaths, event memories
수락·거절·지지·보복의 근거: Basis for acceptance, refusal, support, retaliation
직위 티어는 비교 분류다. 티어 1이라도 나라별로 대통령·군주·역장·사령: Post tier is a comparative classification. Even at Tier 1, the post differs by country, such as president, monarch, station master, commander, or chairman. Peerage and post, and occupation and command authority, are separate. Holding public office does not turn an institutional vault into personal property or give command over all troops.
공통 상태: 제안 → 자격 검사 → 전달/접수 → 상대 수락 또는 기관: Common states: Proposal → Qualification check → Delivery/Receipt → Counterparty acceptance or institutional approval → Resource and schedule reservation → Execution → Result application → Receipt. The branch states are refusal, hold, cancellation, suspension, and expiration.
입력은 행위자, 대상, 행동 종류, 권한 근거, 대상 원장 판본, 장소/: The inputs are the actor, target, action type, basis of authority, target ledger edition, location/contact route, conditions, resources, and cause event ID. The check order is target existence and edition → feasibility such as survival/detention → authority → actual location/delivery → resources and exclusive reservations → counterparty intent/institutional procedure. High trust does not make a physically impossible action succeed.
승인과 실행 사이에 사망·해임·점령·연락 두절이 발생하면 예약된 작업을: If death, dismissal, occupation, or loss of contact occurs between approval and execution, the reserved work is checked again. Supplies already consumed and progress already completed are not reversed, and only the remaining resources are released according to the contract. Resending the same event ID does not create a new result. Simultaneous transfers of rights are evaluated on the same ledger edition, and conflicts are resolved by a deterministic acceptance order.
행동 UI는 ‘가능’, ‘선행조건 부족’, ‘권한 없음’, ‘응답 대기’: The action UI distinguishes "Possible," "Prerequisites Lacking," "No Authority," "Awaiting Response," and "System Undecided" and displays the basis. It does not leak hidden facts through the reason display and instead explains with "Insufficient confirmed basis."
2. 인물·작위 상태별 실제 행동: 2. Actual Actions by Character and Peerage State
구로 노동조합 서기 · 시흥시 영주: Guro Labor Union Clerk · Lord of Siheung
금천 경비대장 · 군포시 영주: Geumcheon Guard Captain · Lord of Gunpo
공병 작업반장 · 의왕시 영주: Engineer Work Crew Foreman · Lord of Uiwang
금천 공방의무원 · 화성시 영주: Geumcheon Workshop Medic · Lord of Hwaseong
제작규격 전령 · 공주시 영주: Production Standards Courier · Lord of Gongju
남서 외곽선로 탐사원 · 보령시 영주: Southwest Outer Line Scout · Lord of Boryeong
저장은 수락 사건과 결과 적용이 모두 끝난 일관된 시뮬레이션 경계에서 만: A save is made at a consistent simulation boundary where both event acceptance and outcome application are complete. Wars in progress, current orders, training, cargo, handovers, succession procedures, and reservations are saved together with their current stages. Applied outcome IDs, permanent IDs, editions, and world facts are preserved together. The world record and the facts each character knows are stored separately, and knowledge gained through reports keeps its source and verification time. After a restore, the information actually shown to the player is re-read from the current vessel's knowledge and access eligibility. The fact that stored knowledge exists does not automatically reveal records or institutional secrets to which the new vessel has no access.
전: 저장 경계가 완결되어 있고 저장의 규칙 판본이 현재 규칙과 호환되며: Before: The save boundary is complete, the save's rules edition is compatible with the current rules, and the data is not corrupted.
후: 저장 당시 완료된 결과는 완료된 채로, 진행 중 절차는 그 단계에서: After: Outcomes completed at save time stay completed, in-progress procedures resume at their stages, and consumed resources and completed progress are restored as consumed and completed. The same outcome ID is not applied again, and no vessel or asset is duplicated.
세계 행동이 취소되거나 담당자가 사망해도 이미 소비한 물자와 완료한 진척: Even if a world action is canceled or the person in charge dies, materials already consumed and progress already completed are not rolled back. Only the remaining reservations and resources are released or rechecked according to that action's contract. Quitting and loading are not in-world death or departure events.
Before: The rules edition differs or the save is corrupted.
후: 복원을 명시적으로 거절하고 판본 불일치 또는 손상 이유를 보여 준다: After: The restore is explicitly refused, and the reason for the edition mismatch or corruption is shown. There is no silent repair, unapproved migration, or replacement with a new campaign. The GP-14 policy chosen by the owner goes as far as collecting errors without changing the actual world state and not creating a partial load, migration, or replacement campaign. The upper limit on the number of errors has not yet been decided.
문서 형식 판본과 게임 규칙 판본은 서로 다른 값이다. 이전 저장을 새: The document format edition and the game rules edition are different values. Mixing an older save with new rules requires a separately approved succession contract.
Cargo whose actual arrival is verified at or before the consumption cutoff time is included in that cutoff. If it arrives at the same time, the arrival is verified first, and then reservation, production, and consumption are processed. Cargo that arrives after the cutoff is not retroactively included in a cutoff that has already passed. Its arrival status afterward and its eligibility for the next consumption are decided by D06's movement and cargo contract, and a verification marker used for a failed cutoff alone does not determine permanent in-transit status or automatic use at the next cutoff.
공유 일간 단계와 같은 시각의 독립적인 봉쇄·도착 제안의 입력 접수 순서: The input acceptance order for independent blockade and arrival proposals at the same time as the shared daily phase is a policy chosen by the owner. Arrival is not always placed ahead of blockade, nor is the order switched to alphabetical by event name. When cargo is split, the parent cargo is removed from active stock and preserved as history, and lineage continues through two child cargoes. Recipient confirmation signatures, conflict explanations and re-proposal guidance for reservation contention, local quarantine of cargo that fails handover, and keeping reservations for undelivered cargo have also been chosen. For these seven policies, cargo eligibility, storage, and handover handling follow the contracts of D05, D06, and D13, while D18 preserves event order and save state. The specific tick length and the causal order of simultaneous events outside the scope above remain undecided.
분대 선택·명령·자율 판단·평가: Squad selection, orders, autonomous judgment, and evaluation
시간과 결과 ID를 보존하고 즉시 하달·무큐 계약을 이어 준다: Preserves time and outcome IDs and carries over the immediate-issue, no-queue contract
D18은 시각을 순서화하고 D06은 실제 이동·도착을 검증한다. D15·: D18 orders the times, and D06 verifies actual movement and arrival. D15 and D16 own the entry and participation boundaries of battles in progress
명분 생성·유효성·권리: Casus belli creation, validity, and rights
유효 명분과 판본을 읽고 ±100 종결 시점을 적용한다: Reads the valid casus belli and its edition and applies the ±100 termination point
사건 순서와 저장을 제공하며 가격·권한·실제 인도는 각 도메인이 판정한다: Provides event order and saving, while each domain decides price, authority, and actual handover
도착과 마감 순서를 제공한다. 수량·보관·소비 장부는 소유하지 않는다: Provides arrival and cutoff order. Does not own the quantity, storage, or consumption ledgers
사망 사건과 그 결과를 저장하지만 사망 규칙을 만들지 않는다: Saves death events and their outcomes but does not create death rules
이름·영구 ID·현재 인물 상태: Names, permanent IDs, and current character state
검색 가능한 이름과 안정 ID를 보존한다. 과거 등록부를 현재 상태 권위: Preserves searchable names and stable IDs. Past registries are not used as the authority on current state
예시 A — 즉시 명령과 자율 행동: Example A — Immediate Order and Autonomous Action
전투 세션에 등록된 본체 지휘관의 지휘 범위 안 배속 목록에 세 분대가: The vessel commander registered in the battle session has three squads in the attachment list within their command range. The vessel issues a retreat posture to all three squads. The signal arrives immediately. Two squads comply, and one squad leader chooses partial execution in order to rescue an isolated civilian. The battle does not stop and no queue is created. After the actual outcome, the originating commander character separately evaluates compliance and the rescue result, and keeps them as the basis for their own memory and for later attachment and trust decisions. The number of squads and the amount of trust change are not approved values in this example.
예시 B — 실제 도착한 증원: Example B — Reinforcements That Actually Arrive
전투가 진행되는 동안 후발 부대가 실제 경로를 따라 전장에 도착한다. 최: While the battle is in progress, a later-arriving unit reaches the battlefield along an actual route. It is admitted as reinforcement and is not excluded for being absent from the initial roster or for having a low rank. Other units still in transit do not participate. The time taken to arrive and the entry position are separate data, and this document does not set the numbers.
예시 C — +100과 미수락 협상안: Example C — +100 and an Unaccepted Negotiation Proposal
유효 명분 전쟁에서 협상안이 오가는 동안 점수가 +100에 닿는다. 시스: In a valid casus belli war, the score reaches +100 while a negotiation proposal is being exchanged. The system first rechecks the casus belli edition and beneficiary fixed at the outbreak of war, together with the continuing casus belli basis and the beneficiary's eligibility to apply it. If it is still valid, the war is terminated with that casus belli's effect, without waiting for a response or requiring a confirmation button. If the basis disappeared first, the registered invalidation rules are applied and no beneficiary rights without a basis are created. The unaccepted proposal is discarded, and territory outside the objective is not transferred. The specific quantity and timing of handover within the objective are undecided.
예시 D — 마감 뒤 도착: Example D — Arrival After the Cutoff
화물이 일간 소비 마감 뒤에 실제 도착한다. 그 화물은 이미 지난 마감의: Cargo actually arrives after the daily consumption cutoff. That cargo is not retroactively included in the consumption of a cutoff that has already passed. Its subsequent arrival status and eligibility for the next consumption are decided separately by the D06 contract. This example does not determine automatic use at the next cutoff or a permanent in-transit state. The actual tick value of the daily phase is also undecided.
예시 E — 사망으로 중단된 작업의 보존: Example E — Preserving Work Interrupted by Death
교육 또는 제작의 담당자가 사망해 작업을 계속할 수 없게 된다. 시스템은: The person in charge of training or crafting dies, and the work can no longer continue. The system rechecks eligibility and the remaining reservations, but does not reverse the materials already consumed or the progress already completed. Only the remaining resources are released according to the contract. D12 owns the death outcome and succession.
표시 제안은 현재 본체의 실제 지식·접근 자격을 한계로 현재 시각, 알려: The display proposal shows the following, limited by the current vessel's actual knowledge and access eligibility: the current time, the acceptance or rejection of known events and the reasons, the sender, target, and confirmed execution status of received orders, the casus belli, score, and negotiation status of known wars, the save's edition compatibility and corruption cause, and confirmed cargo arrivals. Reports carry their source and verification time, and the world's current facts are not confused with the facts a character knows. Hidden reasons are shown as "insufficient confirmed basis," and undisclosed outcomes, institutional records, and other characters' knowledge are not exposed. The stable ID determines the target. The surface priority among name search, past rosters, and the current ledger follows the D01 proposal.
실패는 세계 상태를 임의로 초기화하지 않는다. 무효 명령, 비호환 저장,: Failure does not arbitrarily reset the world state. Invalid orders, incompatible saves, unregistered negotiation prices, and lack of disposal authority each reveal only reasons that can be disclosed to the current vessel and block only the relevant action. Outcomes, progress, and consumption that are already complete are neither canceled nor erased because of a death. Resending the same outcome ID does not create a new outcome.
다음 정책은 선택되었으나 구현 완료를 뜻하지 않는다: 정수 틱, 캠페인: The following policies have been chosen, but this does not mean implementation is complete: integer ticks, campaign epoch, total order of entry approval, advancing events at maturity, preserving remainders, separating random numbers by purpose, entity, and state, extracting event addresses, full snapshot of the reservation stage, atomic recording of state, outcome, and receipt, collecting incompatible-save errors, and shared daily cargo cutoff. For cargo, parent history with two-child splitting, recipient confirmation signatures, reservation contention explanation and re-proposal, input acceptance order for independent blockade and arrival at the same time, local quarantine on handover failure, and keeping reservations for undelivered cargo have also been chosen.
다음 항목은 아직 승인되지 않았다. 표의 대안은 플레이 규칙의 선택지이며: The following items have not yet been approved. The alternatives in the table are options for play rules and do not fix the current state.
사망·도착·비준·±100의 교차 인과(선택된 봉쇄·도착 순서 제외): Cross-causality of death, arrival, ratification, and ±100 (excluding the chosen blockade and arrival order)
A: 인과 의존 그래프 뒤 입장 서수, B: 도메인별 명시 우선순위: A: Entry ordinal after the causal dependency graph, B: Explicit priority per domain
같은 상태에서 하나의 재현 가능한 결과: One reproducible outcome from the same state
본체가 아는 명령·전쟁·화물 상태: Order, war, and cargo status known to the vessel
A: 출처·확인 시각을 붙인 접근 가능 정보만 표시, B: 같은 지식·접: A: Show only accessible information with source and verification time, B: Summary within the same knowledge and access limits, then open confirmed-basis details
숨은 사실을 누설하지 않는 판단: Judgment that does not leak hidden facts
화면 구성·상세 공개 수준 미결; 지식 저장은 공개 권한이 아님: Screen layout and level of detail disclosure undecided; stored knowledge is not disclosure authority

시민/조직 제도상 서비스, 노동·교육·복무 계약, 수여 청원: Services under civic/organizational institutions, labor/education/service contracts, petitions for grants

기관 소유 재산 처분, 민간 노동 강제, 타 부대 편입: Disposing of institution-owned property, forcing civilian labor, incorporating other units
국가 제도에 따른 임명·수여 제안·외교·전쟁 승인·후계 절차: Appointments, grant proposals, diplomacy, war approval, and succession procedures under state institutions
타국 인준권, 자기보다 높은 작위 수여, 계약 위반 없는 무조건 회수: Another state's ratification authority, granting titles higher than one's own, unconditional revocation without a contract violation
증거 제출, 계승 자격 주장, 지지 요청, 정해진 명분의 수혜 후보: Submitting evidence, asserting succession eligibility, requesting support, being a candidate beneficiary of a designated casus belli
주장을 보유권이나 현장 지배로 사용: Using a claim as ownership or on-site control
실제 통제 아래 경비·보급·협상; 점령 규칙의 집행: Guarding, supplying, and negotiating under actual control; enforcing occupation rules
점령만으로 합법 상속·기관 금고 소유·주민 협력 확보: Occupation alone does not secure legitimate inheritance, ownership of institutional vaults, or residents' cooperation
각 행동은 여러 상태 축을 교차 검사한다. 예컨대 영지를 가진 무지휘 인: Each action is checked across multiple status axes. For example, a landholder without command authority can make a "troop muster request" but cannot move another commander's unit by their own order. A records officer carries out claim-building work under a qualified head's order but does not personally gain anyone else's territory.
Daily Life: Apply for rations, buy water/food, request lodging/treatment, rest, attend appointments. Entitlement, actual supplies, and schedule are checked.
경제: 주문 제안, 노동 예약, 수리/건설 단계 승인, 호송 의뢰, 화물: Economy: Propose orders, reserve labor, approve repair/construction stages, commission escorts, deliver cargo, set up leases/collateral. The budget owner and the signer are distinguished.

정보: 정찰, 보고 수신, 기록 열람 요청, 소문 반증·폭로, 허가된 기: Intelligence: Scouting, receiving reports, requesting record access, refuting/exposing rumors, creating authorized records. Known facts are distinguished from the authority to disclose them.
3. 전쟁의 개시·진행·종결: 3. Starting, Conducting, and Ending a War
3.1 선전포고 전 명분 계약: 3.1 Casus Belli Contract Before Declaring War
전쟁 입력은 전쟁 ID, 승인자와 권한, 공격/방어 책임자, 명분 ID,: War inputs are the war ID, approver and authority, attack/defense leads, casus belli ID, target title/territory, beneficiary, demands, approval cost, objectives, and each ending effect. A "hostile relationship" alone does not open a declaration of war. A main character without office may make plans, give support, and propose beneficiaries, but cannot approve a state war. A person whose independent state has been established uses that state's head procedures.
명분 등록 대상 묶음: 인정된 권리 회복, 적격 타인 주장 지원, 승인된: Registered casus belli categories: restoring recognized rights, supporting an eligible third party's claim, and redress for breach of obligations under an approved superior contract. Whether each category is registered, its target scope, cost, truce, and reparations are pending confirmation. Personal debts, passage disputes, and floodgate water-supply cutoffs are not automatically converted into grounds for territorial conquest. An unregistered casus belli does not create a war.
준비 → 유효성 검증 → 선전포고 기록 → 진행 → 강화 요청/요구 관철: Preparation → validation → declaration record → in progress → peace request/demand fulfilled/surrender/casus belli void → ending effects applied → post-war contract. If preparation fails, no war is created. During the war, battle, occupation, and prisoner events reference the relevant war and objective, and each event changes the score only once.
기존 확정 점수는 공격/방어 -100~+100 반대 값이며 전투·점령·핵: The existing confirmed score is an attack/defense value of -100 to +100 in opposite directions, and it changes through battles, occupation, key prisoners, and objective control. Battle score between rulers is capped at 50, capturing the head gives +100, capturing the designated first/second/third successor gives +50/+25/+10, and occupying the capital gives +10. These are used only when they correspond to an actual institutional head, successor, or capital. Candidates in an electoral state are not arbitrarily designated "first successor" to award points. The duration of objective occupation and the rate of increase are undecided.
+30은 백지 강화 요청 자격이고 수락 보장이 아니다. +100은 명분에: +30 qualifies one to request a white peace, but acceptance is not guaranteed. +100 enforces the demands fixed in the casus belli, -100 is surrender by the losing side, and voluntary surrender is also possible. Separately from the score, if the grounds for the casus belli disappear, the void rules for that casus belli are checked. The death of a head alone does not automatically end every war.
동원 명부·무기고 열람은 부대 생성이 아니다. 인력 수락·장비·보급·지휘: Viewing the mobilization roster or armory is not unit creation. Actual formations are created only after personnel acceptance, equipment, supplies, commander, and reservation checks. Automatic battles are decided by the local commander based on objective, posture, observation, and authority, and use the same adjudication/result ledger as manual ones. Only battles the main character actually joined provide the field screen. Late joiners must satisfy the permitted reinforcement conditions, entry route, and actual arrival.
전투 승리는 전쟁 승리와 다르다. 거점 점령은 현장 통제를 바꾸되 시설: Winning a battle is not the same as winning the war. Occupying a stronghold changes on-site control, but facility recovery, residents' cooperation, and the transfer of legal rights are separate. Occupation outside the objectives does not widen the scope of demands. Withdrawal requires a valid retreat route and is recorded differently from a rout, an accepted surrender, or capture.
종결 입력 잠금 → 명분과 수혜자 재검사 → 권리 이전 목록 확정 → 점: Lock ending inputs → recheck casus belli and beneficiary → finalize the rights transfer list → occupation retain/return list → prisoner handling → reparations/truce/superior contract → cancel or recheck ongoing orders → event receipt. If two different wars try to transfer the same title at once, a ledger version conflict occurs and the second settlement is reviewed again. If a battle opens during a peace proposal, it is rechecked against the facts at the time of acceptance.
사례: A가 B의 주장 회복을 위해 싸워 승리하면 B가 대상 권리의 새: Example: If A fights to restore B's claim and wins, B becomes the new holder of the target right. A does not get all the occupied lands. The superior relationship between B and A is checked against the conditions stated in the casus belli, and actual floodgate control and operator cooperation remain separate matters.
입력: 수여자, 수령자, 국가 가입 상태, 대상 작위와 판본, 수여 권한: Inputs: grantor, recipient, state membership status, target title and version, grant authority, superior contract, rights·duties·term, ratifying body, and delivery conditions for relics/documents/keys. To receive a grant from an existing state, one must already belong to it. A head may only distribute titles lower than their own, and the existing worldbuilding limit of two directly held duke-rank titles is maintained. No arbitrary title is created where there is no actual title ID, territory, or rank.
상태: 초안 → 권한/대상 검사 → 수령자 동의 → 인준/비준 → 권리: States: draft → authority/target check → recipient consent → ratification/approval → rights ledger change → operational takeover → completed or disputed. The default policy is not to change the holder before the required ratification. If on-site takeover fails after approval, it remains as "rights held·not recovered/takeover incomplete." In regions with a central records culture, omitting record ratification or relic inspection is grounds for invalidity.
권리 변경 시 수여자의 보유 목록에서 대상 권리를 제거하고 수령자에게 같: When a right changes hands, the target right is removed from the grantor's holdings list and the same title ID is registered to the recipient. For subordinate contracts and tax/water-supply/passage and ritual duties, the signer and succession policy are recorded. Buildings, institutional vaults, public stockpiles, and unit command are not transferred automatically unless each one's inclusion is explicitly stated.
임명은 공직 권한을 준다. 수여는 작위 권리의 보유자를 바꾼다. 위임은: Appointment gives official authority. Grant changes the holder of a title right. Delegation leaves the original holder in place and entrusts only specified operations/signing/command. Delegation status is valid, suspended, expired, or revoked, and the basis event and scope are stored. If the proxy dies, the original holder's rights do not disappear.
회수 제안은 계약의 회수 조항·위반 증거·인준 절차를 요구한다. 위임을: A revocation proposal requires the contract's revocation clause, evidence of violation, and the ratification procedure. If a relic is reclaimed without withdrawing the delegation, a betrayal issue opens as under the existing rules. Others' personal property or positions are not immediately removed just because of a higher tier. Illegal seizure is not marked as a normal grant, and is recorded as a change in on-site control and a rights dispute.
검증 사례: 미가입 수령자 거절; 동일 작위를 두 사람에게 동시 수여 시: Validation cases: rejection of an unaffiliated recipient; version conflict when the same title is granted to two people simultaneously; original holder retained when ratification is refused; takeover incomplete when the grant succeeds but the keys are not delivered; distinguishing drafts from confirmed rights before and after the grantor's death.
플레이어 본체 계승, 국가/기관 수장 계승, 개별 작위·재산 계승을 별도: Player main-character succession, state/institution head succession, and succession to individual titles and property are handled as separate events. All of the dead main character's authority, skills, and friends are not copied to the person who becomes the new main character.
기존 확정: 본체 사망 또는 영구 구금 시 지정 후계, 없으면 계승 순서: Previously confirmed: when the main body dies or is permanently detained, the designated successor becomes the new main body; if there is none, the person next in the line of succession does. If there is no successor, that character's path ends. The viewpoint moves to the new main body's actual location, and the remaining squad elects a temporary private-rank squad leader. Check the contract scope to confirm that command of the remaining unit passes validly to the new main body.
영구 구금으로 본체가 바뀌어도 구금된 인물은 살아 있다. 이를 사망으로: Even when the main body changes because of permanent detention, the detained person is still alive. Do not treat this as death or open an inheritance. The specific criteria for judging permanent detention and whether re-manipulation is allowed are pending confirmation.
사망/공석 근거 확정 → 사망한 인물의 개인 신규 행동 중단 또는 살아: Confirm the basis for death/vacancy → suspend the deceased's new personal actions, or, if a living person loses a post, suspend only the signing, command, and operating authority of the vacated post → snapshot the lists of posts, titles, property, and contracts → look up each item's succession system → check candidate eligibility → run procedures such as election/nomination/examination/hereditary succession → ratification → transfer rights item by item → handover/takeover → record disputes. The personal life and movement of a living person, and actions under a separate valid contract, are judged by their own eligibility conditions and are not suspended merely because a post is vacant. Post authority is distinguished from personal property, title rights, and other valid contracts, and a vacancy alone does not trigger automatic inheritance, transfer, appointment of a proxy, or absorption of authority. The claims of candidates who were not chosen remain according to the system; a person is not deleted for having been eliminated.
수장 사망 뒤 직위가 공석이어도 기관과 국가는 자동 소멸하지 않는다. 대: Even if a post is vacant after a leader's death, the institution and the state do not automatically cease to exist. Only persons and scopes registered in the system are permitted to act as proxy. If there is no eligible person or procedure, it remains a vacancy/succession dispute, and no anonymous leader is automatically generated.
5.3 국가별 수장 절차의 근거와 남은 입력: 5.3 Basis of Each State's Leader Procedure and Remaining Inputs
유권 가문 명부, 후보 자격, 표/당직의 귀속, 공석 대행: Voting family rosters, candidate eligibility, attribution of votes/party posts, vacancy proxies
유효 계약·대표 자격·회의 성립·인준: Valid contracts, representative eligibility, quorum of meetings, ratification
적격 자녀 순서, 유언·양자 예외, 직위와 열쇠 인도: Order of eligible children, exceptions for wills and adoption, handover of posts and keys
후보 숙련·길드 지지·도제 계승의 적용 대상: Targets to which candidate skill, guild support, and apprenticeship succession apply
가족 자격과 군 지휘 인수·복속 등록의 구분: Distinction between family eligibility and military command takeover/subjugation registration
사령관·수비대장 이원: Dual structure of commander and garrison chief
어느 자리의 공석인지, 공동 권한·대행 규칙: Which seat is vacant, and the rules for joint authority and proxies
개인 지분/면허와 수장 직위, 임명·인준의 구분: Distinction between personal shares/licenses and the leader's post, and between appointment and ratification
지분 상속, 대표 선정, 의장 선출의 분리: Separation of share inheritance, representative selection, and chair election
목사직 부자 세습·장로 인준: Hereditary father-to-son pastorate, ratification by elders
사제단 선출·산중총회 추대: Election by the priesthood, acclamation by the mountain-wide assembly
선출/추대 자격·절차·제대/대장 인수: Eligibility and procedure for election/acclamation, takeover of the corps/commander post
시험 자격·결과·기록 열람권의 인수: Examination eligibility, results, and takeover of record-viewing rights
유권 조합원·후보 자격·파업 명부 권한: Voting union members, candidate eligibility, authority over the strike roster
정본 간 세부 표현 차이는 여기서 임의로 통일하지 않는다. 특히 길드의: Differences in detailed wording between canonical sources are not unified arbitrarily here. In particular, the link between the guild's apprenticeship lineage and council elections, and vacancies under the dual structure, are open questions to be confirmed.
작위 보유권은 해당 작위의 계승 제도를 따른다. 관철된 주장은 적격 자녀: Title-holding rights follow the succession system of that title. Enforced claims keep the existing path by which they pass to eligible children as unenforced claims, and unenforced claims are not separately inherited. A spouse does not automatically share all claims merely by being a spouse. Public-office candidacy, voting rights, and technical qualifications are not handled as the same data type as title claims.
진행 전쟁의 수장 사망은 새 책임자·수혜자·명분을 재검사한다. 개인 약속: When the leader of an ongoing war dies, the new responsible party, beneficiary, and casus belli are rechecked. Whether personal promises and post promises are maintained, re-ratified, or terminated is judged item by item. Succession must not be used to erase debts, ceasefires, or damage records.
6. 자산의 소유·전수·인도: 6. Ownership, Transfer, and Handover of Assets
개인 소유 물자·장비·화폐, 기관 소유 창고/금고/설비, 공동/지분 재산: Personally owned supplies, equipment, and currency; institution-owned warehouses/vaults/facilities; joint/share property; leases and usage permits; debts, claims, and collateral; and records, keys, and relics are all separate. A custodian is not an owner, and holding a key is not itself a legal right. Synthetic beings recognized as persons are excluded from the list of transferable assets.
자산 상태는 존재 장소·수량/개체·소유자·보관 책임자·사용권·예약·담보·: Asset state has location, quantity/unit, owner, custodian, usage rights, reservations, collateral, in-transit status, and disputes. Logistics state and legal-rights state are kept separate. Cargo in transit during war also keeps the same asset ID/split origin.
개인 재산은 해당 국가 제도·유효 유언·혼인/공동재산 계약을 검사해 수혜: Personal property determines its beneficiary by checking the state's system, any valid will, and marriage/joint-property contracts. Institutional property stays with the institution, and the new post holder takes over only the management authority they need. Usage rights and leases are maintained, re-approved, or terminated according to their succession clauses. Debts and claims are checked for whether they belong to the individual, the post, or the institution, and for succession clauses; debt is not unconditionally pushed onto every successor.
상속 목록 확정 → 분쟁/담보 표시 → 소유권 전이 → 실제 인도 예약: The order is: finalize the inheritance list → mark disputes/collateral → transfer ownership → reserve actual handover → verify receipt. Even after gaining ownership, supplies in an enemy-occupied warehouse do not teleport into the inventory. Divided inheritance preserves the total quantity, and supplies that are reserved or pledged as collateral are marked separately. An undetermined system means inheritance is put on hold; it is not replaced by an ownerless state or automatic equal distribution.
사례: 회장이 죽으면 개인 장비·개인 지분과 회사 창고를 나눈다. 자녀의: Example: when a chairman dies, personal equipment and personal shares are divided separately from the company warehouse. A child's inheritance of shares and the new chairman's authority to place warehouse orders are different events. Even if personal equipment in transit is inherited, it cannot be used before the cargo arrives.
영구 저장: 이전 소유자·수혜자·수량·근거·담보·예약·인도 장소·이행 상: Permanent storage: previous owner, beneficiary, quantity, basis, collateral, reservation, handover location, fulfillment status, cause ID. Reapplying the same death event must not duplicate property. If a will change and a death occur at the same time, use the recognized event order and the institutionally valid time.
7. 지식의 전수·교육·상실: 7. Transfer, Education, and Loss of Knowledge
지식 객체는 내용/판본·출처·진위/확인·기밀·소유/열람권을 가진다. 인물: A knowledge object has content/edition, source, authenticity/verification, confidentiality, and ownership/viewing rights. A person has the records they have encountered, understanding, practice progress, performed proficiency, and qualifications. Inheriting a document transfers ownership or viewing rights of the paper/medium; it is not a copy of proficiency. When a master dies, the disciple's existing proficiency remains, but the available teachers and verification routes for new education change.
교육 요청 → 교사/기관 수락 → 기술별 요구 검사 → 일정·도구·장소: Education request → teacher/institution acceptance → check each skill's requirements → reserve schedule, tools, and location → instruction/reading/practice → assessment → record progress/proficiency. For each skill, author whether teacher, records, tools, practice location, and learner conditions are required. The same items are not enforced across all skills.
교사 사망·도구 파손·구금·장소 상실이면 교육 중단/보류 사유를 기록하고: If a teacher dies, tools are damaged, someone is detained, or a location is lost, record the reason for suspending/holding the education and preserve the progress already gained. When transferring to another teacher, check the recognizable progress for that skill. If someone has read the records but cannot practice, only the record access/understanding state changes. Nominating an apprentice is a post-candidacy event and is separate from completing skill proficiency.
정보 전달은 발신자의 실제 지식·공개 권한과 수신 경로를 검사한다. 보고: Information transmission checks the sender's actual knowledge, disclosure authority, and the receiving route. When a report is delivered, the recipient gains knowledge with a source and a time of verification, not the entirety of the world's current facts. Forgery, exposure, and refutation leave competing evidence and events rather than erasing the original. When a secret is leaked, the exposed information and the person's responsibility are recorded separately.
검증 사례: 같은 문서 상속으로 숙련 중복 상승 금지; 교사 사망 뒤 학: Verification cases: no duplicate proficiency gains from inheriting the same document; learning progress is kept after a teacher's death; maintenance ability and manufacturing ability are separate; a successor without access rights does not automatically obtain institutional secrets; an old report does not guarantee the current location.
8. 인물 관계의 변화와 영구 영향: 8. Changes in Character Relationships and Permanent Effects
8.1 수치와 사실의 역할: 8.1 The Roles of Values and Facts
기존 확정 관계 수치는 방향성 신뢰 T[A,B]다. 별도 호감 수치를 추: The previously confirmed relationship value is directional trust T[A,B]. No separate affection value is added. The thresholds of T 25 or above for friend, -25 or below for enemy, and -50 or below for nemesis are kept. Family, marriage, romance, master/disciple, contracts, debts, oaths, and command are real relationship facts and are not the same as trust. Just because A trusts B does not mean B trusts A at the same value.
군주에 대한 충성은 별도 기존 상태 0~100이다. 일별 기분과 군주에: Loyalty to the ruler is a separate existing state from 0 to 100. It reads the daily mood and trust in the ruler, and the ruler themselves is at 100. If loyalty stays below 25, paths open for a successor's rebellion or the defection of other heroes, but the duration, amount of change, and risky-action thresholds are undecided. Do not interpret this as a rebellion that must occur every day.
함께 시간 보내기, 치료·구조, 계약 이행/위반, 선물·거래, 공개 지지: Spending time together, treatment and rescue, fulfilling/violating contracts, gifts and trades, public support and insults, exposure, detention and release, and marriage, adoption, and death are the sources of relationship events. For each event, record the actor, target, harm/benefit, witness/report, secrecy scope, and basis. Modifier amounts use confirmed rules; if undecided, no arbitrary numbers are inserted.
평가 주체가 관측·보고로 사건을 알게 된 시점에 자기 신뢰와 기억을 갱신: The evaluating party updates its own trust and memory at the point when it learns of the event through observation or report. A method in which hidden betrayals are known instantly from anywhere in the world is not used. Direct harm is distinguished from public reputation, and no fixed personality or betrayal probability is assigned to a state.
관계는 면담 수락, 위험 업무 수락, 후계 지지, 교사 수락, 증언, 보: Relationships are inputs for judging whether to accept an interview, accept risky work, support a successor, accept a teacher, testify, and whom to protect, conceal, defect from, or plot against. High trust does not create command authority, property rights, consent, or passage rights that do not exist. Even when a relationship changes, existing contracts change through termination clauses and action events. When a friend becomes an enemy, all trades and unit organizations do not automatically vanish at that moment.
사망 시 생존자의 가족/연인 관계와 애도 사건은 남는다. 후계에게 사망자: When someone dies, the survivors' family/romantic relationships and mourning events remain. The deceased's T[A,B] is not copied to the successor. The new main body starts with the personal relationships it already had, and the previous person's contracts, institutional obligations, and public history are each carried over by succession policy.
8.4 캠페인에 영구적으로 남는 것: 8.4 What Remains Permanently in the Campaign
작위/직위 이력, 권리 분쟁, 약속의 이행/위반, 포로·부상·사망, 혼인: Store title/post history, rights disputes, fulfillment/violation of promises, prisoners, injuries and deaths, marriage and kinship, education progress, disclosed evidence, property and debts, ceasefire and war outcomes, and witnessed events/memories along with current trust. Later actions reread these facts. Loading a save and changing the main body do not reset them.
방화기지 유치·배차장: Banghwa Base Stabling and Dispatch Chief
서부 수질검사망 운영관: Western Water Quality Testing Network Operator
연구기록·통신서고 감사관: Research Records and Communications Archive Auditor
태욱그룹 회장 전령 · 서초구 영주: Taeuk Group Chairman's Envoy · Lord of Seocho-gu
유치선 화물 구분·배차: Stabling Track Cargo Sorting and Dispatch
종자보존고 비상발전 운전장: Seed Vault Emergency Generator Operations Chief
수질 검사 공개 증인: Public Witness to Water Quality Testing
수질 검사 공개 입회: Public Attendance at Water Quality Testing
약품 피해 증거·명부 관리: Medicine Harm Evidence and Roster Management
양측 모두 절댓값 100 미만에서 중간 협상을 할 수 있다. 원천 전쟁: Either side may negotiate an interim settlement while the absolute value is below 100. The source war system's ordinary endings are demand fulfillment, white peace, surrender, and casus belli invalidation; a peace that sums scores item by item across territory, assets, and persons is not confirmed. Item-by-item negotiation is adopted as an Seoul:nationwide original extension with owner approval. The per-item numeric tables do not invent or fill in values absent from the source. Signing and settlement are locked for negotiated items whose price version is unregistered, but negotiation of validly registered items is permitted. Demands concerning persons are treated not as goods to be handed over but as the object of valid actions such as prisoner release/repatriation, an audience, or voluntary assignment.
18. 독자 강화의 항목별 평가 계약: 18. Item-by-Item Evaluation Contract for Original Peace
양측은 100 미만일 때 협상안에 요구와 제공을 함께 적는다. 협상안은: When the value is below 100, each side writes both its demands and its offers into the proposal. A proposal carries the war ID, proposal version, signing authority, target/beneficiary, item list, performance timing, deadline, and breach effect. Items are fiefdom/right transfers, asset payments/returns, prisoner release/repatriation, and diplomatic commitments such as passage/water supply/rationing/escort/recognition/superior contract/truce. The structure does not permit the sale of persons, forced marriage, or ordinary assignment without consent.
각 항목은 고유 ID, 종류, 수량/범위, 처분 권한, 평가 입력과 가격: Each item has a unique ID, type, quantity/scope, disposal authority, evaluation inputs and price version, score, casus-belli-permitted range, and feasibility. Fiefdoms read the evaluation unit of the registered title/territory; supplies read actual quantity and the registered economic unit; prisoners read their detention status and the political effect of release; diplomacy reads scope, duration, obligations, and actual routes. A single ledger asset may not be demanded redundantly across multiple items. War score and price score are separate records, and negotiation does not consume or manipulate combat score.
평가식의 구조는 V(안)=Σ요구항목가격-Σ제공항목가격이다. 가격은 동일: The structure of the evaluation formula is V(proposal) = Σ price of demanded items − Σ price of offered items. Prices are evaluated against a state snapshot of the same war/proposal version. Approval, rejection, or counteroffer is decided by an acceptance function that reads war score W, objective control, supply, succession, key prisoners, current obligations, relations, memory, and feasibility. It is not handled as automatic acceptance simply because V≤W. Price functions for every category and acceptance adjustment coefficients are subject to data design and do not invent or fill in values absent from the source. Unregistered items appear in the negotiation UI as 'Evaluation Pending' and block signing/settlement of a finalized proposal.
제안 → 양측 평가 → 거절/역제안/수락 → 원장과 권한 재검사 → 단일: The flow is: proposal → evaluation by both sides → rejection/counteroffer/acceptance → ledger and authority recheck → single closing settlement → handover/performance. Time and combat continue while proposals are exchanged. If ±100 is reached before acceptance, the forced casus belli ending takes effect first and any unaccepted proposal is discarded. For acceptance/100/death at the same boundary, the single ending is determined by the confirmed event order and version.
명분은 강제 요구의 최대 범위다. 중간 협상은 그 안의 요구를 줄이거나: The casus belli is the maximum scope of forced demands. An interim negotiation may reduce the demands within it or replace them with mutually agreed substitute payments/obligations, but it may not include territory, assets, or persons the other party cannot dispose of, nor third-party rights. Additional forced cession of fiefdoms outside the objective is not allowed. A separate voluntary transaction is not disguised as a casus belli enforcement effect. After signing, asset handover, prisoner repatriation, and follow-up obligations remain as campaign contracts and are not instantly copied before performance is complete.
19. 명분별 결과와 권리 승계의 상세 대응: 19. Detailed Handling of Outcomes by Casus Belli and Rights Succession
주장 지원 전쟁은 승인자와 수혜자를 분리한다. 수혜자의 동의·소속/지원: In a claim-backing war, the approver and the beneficiary are separated. The beneficiary's consent, affiliation/backing contract, claim validity, target title, and institutional eligibility to exercise are checked. The victory right transfers to the beneficiary, and the attacker does not hold it personally in their place. The superior relationship is rechecked against the actual rank of the title the beneficiary gains and any superior contract. A beneficiary who gains a title of equal or higher rank is not unconditionally bound as a lower vassal. Office tier is not used directly as title rank.
명분에 지정된 작위를 적격 수혜자에게 이전: Transfers the title designated in the casus belli to the eligible beneficiary
성공한 권리와 남은 주장 정리를 명분별로 기록: Records the successful right and the cleanup of remaining claims per casus belli
하위 계약·현장 운영·인도는 별도 검사: Subordinate contracts, on-site operations, and handover are checked separately
대상 보유권은 유지: Holding right to the target is retained
이 전쟁에 사용한 미관철 주장은 관철 상태로 변화: The unfulfilled claim used in this war changes to a fulfilled state
수혜자의 다른 모든 주장까지 변경하지 않음: Does not alter any of the beneficiary's other claims
방어측이 대상 보유권 유지: The defender retains the holding right to the target
이 명분에 사용된 주장을 제거: Removes the claim used in this casus belli
방어자가 공격자의 모든 영토를 자동 취득하지 않음: The defender does not automatically acquire all of the attacker's territory
명분별 반환/잔존 규칙 검사: Checks the return/remainder rules per casus belli
백지 강화와 다르므로 자동 주장 승격 없음: Differs from white peace, so there is no automatic claim promotion
취소 비용·포로·휴전은 명분 정책에 명시: Cancellation costs, prisoners, and truce are specified in the casus belli policy
개인 주장·상위 권리·복속 해소·기관 자산 회복은 서로 다른 명분 종류다: Personal claims, superior rights, subjugation release, and institutional asset recovery are different types of casus belli. The defeat reparations, person detention, and superior-contract effects of another casus belli are not copied into an ordinary claim war. Exceptions in which white peace or prisoner score differs for some casus belli are permitted only under registered policies and do not apply to all wars. Occupation is an actual change of control, and a normal enemy occupation does not automatically invalidate a rights-recovery war. Changes to the legal target, beneficiary, or eligibility to exercise are the inputs for the invalidation check.
기존 보유자의 작위를 상속하는 것과 보유자가 가지고 있던 관철 주장을 자: Inheriting an existing holder's title and children inheriting, as unfulfilled claims, the fulfilled claims the holder possessed are separate paths. Whether an eligible child gains a claim to a parent's title they did not actually receive, and which candidate retains it under partitioned inheritance, requires per-state institutions. If a party dies during a war, the attack leader, defense leader, and claim beneficiary are each rechecked, and if there are multiple candidates it is not replaced with an arbitrary first child. If there is no valid successor, the invalid/pending-succession handling per casus belli applies.
휴전은 종결 유형·명분·서명자/직위 귀속·시작/종료 시각·예외·위반 효과: A truce stores the ending type, casus belli, signatory/office attribution, start/end times, exceptions, and breach effect. It is not presumed that a change of leader automatically deletes a truce. Durations in Seoul world time and breach costs per institution are separate inputs. Acceptance evaluation includes not only war score and item value but also ongoing losses, feasibility of holding the objective, detention, relations, contracts, and supply; however, nonexistent routes, property, or authority are not passed through by score adjustment.
수문국 선출 군주: Elected Sovereign of the Floodgate State
양천 배급구역 대표: Representative of the Yangcheon Rationing District
신정기지 장갑보수열차장: Sinjeong Base Armored Repair Train Chief
영구 저장은 모든 감정이 영원히 고정된다는 뜻이 아니다. 회복·화해·애도: Permanent storage does not mean every emotion is fixed forever. For effects with recovery, reconciliation, mourning, change, or expiry periods, the rule and the end point are stored together. The forgetting/decay function is pending confirmation. The world record of hidden facts and the facts each character knows are stored separately.
사례: A가 B와 호송 계약을 위반하면 B가 알게 된 근거에 따라 신뢰·: Example: If A breaches a escort contract with B, trust, memory, and the contract breach are recorded according to the grounds B learned of. Even if A's successor C becomes the Principal, B's personal trust in C is separate. If an office-attached reparation obligation has been inherited, it remains with C's institution, and personal promises are handled according to the maintain/re-ratify/terminate policy.
9. 싱글플레이 시간·저장·본체 계승: 9. Single-Player Time, Saving, and Principal Succession
세계 시간은 하나다. 플레이어는 한 본체의 행동과 유효한 지휘 권한을 통: World time is singular. The player engages with the world through one Principal's actions and valid command authority. NPCs follow the same movement, labor, education, political, and combat conditions. Switching screens does not rewind time or duplicate the Principal to a remote location. As previously approved, combat has no pause, speed control, or command queue. This document does not add new campaign time controls.
저장 경계: 수락 사건과 결과 적용이 끝난 일관된 시뮬레이션 경계에서 스: Save boundary: A snapshot is made at a consistent simulation boundary where accepted events and result application are complete, and subsequent events are recorded after it. Quitting/loading is not an in-world death or departure event. Ongoing wars, orders, education, cargo, handovers, succession procedures, and reservations are restored from their current stage. An already applied ResultId is not applied again. A rules-version mismatch or corrupted save is an explicit error and is not silently replaced with a new campaign.
본체 계승은 화면 주체만 바꾸는 단계와 권리 전이를 별개로 수행한다. 사: Principal succession performs the step of changing only the screen subject and the transfer of rights as separate steps. Even if a new Principal is selected at the moment of death, incomplete inheritance procedures, disputes, and handovers remain. Reports/records that become inaccessible because the Principal changed are displayed in a restricted way according to the new character's knowledge and qualifications.
인물: 생존·부상·구금·실제 장소, 소속/직위/작위/지휘권, 일정·예약,: Character: survival, injury, detention, and actual location; affiliation/position/title/command authority; schedule and reservations; skills; property; directional relationships; currently available actions and reasons for unavailability.
작위: 보유·주장·실효 지배·인준의 네 영역, 상위 계약, 수여/계승 방: Title: the four domains of holding, claim, effective control, and ratification; superior contract; method of conferral/succession; income/obligations; assets being handed over; change history.
전쟁: 명분·목표·수혜자·종결 효과, 점수의 사건별 근거, 실제 참가/보: War: justification, objectives, beneficiaries, and termination effects; the event-by-event basis for the score; actual participation/supply/occupation; peace proposal status; prisoners; termination settlement.
계승: 사망/공석 근거, 본체 후보와 직위/작위별 후보의 차이, 자격·인: Succession: grounds for death/vacancy; differences between Principal candidates and candidates by position/title; qualifications, ratification procedure, and disputes; list of transmissions/handovers; contracts to maintain/re-ratify/terminate.
자산/지식: 누가 소유·보관·사용하는지, 예약/담보/접근 제한, 현재 인: Assets/Knowledge: who owns, stores, and uses them; reservations/collateral/access restrictions; current handover location; difference between records and mastery; education stage and reason for interruption.
관계: 인물 A→B와 B→A 구분, 공개 가능한 원인 사건, 계약 상태,: Relationships: distinction between character A→B and B→A; disclosable causal events; contract status; kinship/oath/command facts; recoverable effects and permanent history.
각 화면은 원장 사실을 읽는 표면이다. 버튼을 누르면 공통 행동 계약에: Each screen is a surface that reads ledger facts. Pressing a button sends a request to the common action contract, and unconfirmed actions are shown as pending. The report diagram does not replace this detailed design document.

14. SP-1.0.0 우선권과 기존 메커니즘 대체: 14. SP-1.0.0 Precedence and Replacement of Existing Mechanics
판본 ID는 SP-1.0.0, 적용 대상은 새 싱글플레이 기획과 이후 이: The version ID is SP-1.0.0, and it applies to the new single-player design and to campaigns created with this version thereafter. The document storage format schemaVersion 1 differs from the game rules version. The confirmed clauses of this version take precedence over existing designs in the same scope. The existing designs for shared world, maximum participants, host, disconnection, proxy play, and occupation/branching sessions are excluded from the execution premises of the current product design and preserved as history. It is not claimed that existing implementations and saves were automatically converted. An incompatible save is an explicit error, and new rules are not mixed in without an approved migration.
대체되는 범위: 캠페인/유저 여정/아키텍처/저장 문서의 멀티플레이 전제: Replaced scope: the multiplayer premise in the campaign/user journey/architecture/save documents → one Principal, NPCs, and a single-campaign save. Physical delivery delay in combat/monopoly on local command → direct orders from the Principal battle commander and immediate system relay to squad leaders. The presumption that unofficed characters hold no rights → every character may hold justification and rights instances. Waiting for a response/collecting additional damage at ±100 → forced termination per justification. Scope not replaced: actual strategic movement, on-site participation, no pausing in combat, the single result ledger, separation of facility operation from legal rights, and state-specific qualifications, consent, personality, and world facts. Design confirmation does not mean the implementation code is complete.
기획 변경은 SP-1.0.1처럼 수정 판본, 호환되지 않는 행동/권리 의: Design changes require a revised version such as SP-1.0.1, and incompatible changes in action/rights semantics require a separate new version and a succession contract. Different time or succession rules are not mixed across documents. A contract gap is a pending state and is not closed with draft figures or POC execution values.
15. 전투 지휘관과 분대장의 조작 계약: 15. Operation Contract for Battle Commanders and Squad Leaders
A battle commander has a command scope registered in the combat session and a list of assigned squads. If the Principal is a battle commander, they directly coordinate all battle-map squads in that scope through valid orders such as select, move, stance, and attack. Even if each unit/squad has a separate squad leader, this higher command authority is not blocked. Enemy forces, unassigned independent forces, and allied forces outside the command scope cannot be controlled merely because they are visible on the battle map. No authority arises over another Principal or another site. A squad's rearward movement is a movement order within the battlefield and is not a participant departure or termination result. An order to withdraw that ends the battle applies to the entire battle under existing rules, and a valid retreat route and confirmation procedure are checked. Order-execution restrictions such as melee engagement lock remain in place.
본체가 분대장이면 상위 지휘관의 명령은 전령·무전 이동이 아닌 즉시 시스: If the Principal is a squad leader, orders from the higher commander are delivered as an immediate system signal rather than by messenger or radio travel. Receipt records the world time, higher order ID, issuing commander, target squad, purpose, permitted scope, and version. This immediate delivery applies only to battle relay and does not make remote contact on the strategic map or character movement instantaneous.
A Principal squad leader may choose to follow the relayed order, carry it out in part, or act independently. Receiving an order does not lock input or force execution of the order. The link between the orders of a higher-commander Principal carrying out the owner's instructions and the judgments of subordinate NPCs uses the same execution check. No new combat order queue is created; only the current relay/execution status and update history are kept.
평가 입력: 명령의 목적·수신 시점·수행 가능성·분대 상태·본체의 실제: Evaluation inputs: the order's purpose, time of receipt, feasibility, squad status, the Principal's actual actions, contribution to the objective, losses, civilian harm, and changes/cancellations of the higher order. The evaluation result is attributed to the commander character and becomes the basis for memory of that Principal and for later assignment/trust decisions. The relationship-change function, figures, and promotion/disciplinary conditions are pending, and a fixed trust penalty is not automatically imposed for disobedience. For impossible orders and invalid relays after the commander's death, execution failure is distinguished from arbitrary disobedience. Even if independent action produced a good outcome, compliance and results are recorded separately.
하달 → 즉시 수신 → 따름/독자 선택 → 실제 실행 → 명령별 평가 →: Relay → immediate receipt → follow/independent choice → actual execution → per-order evaluation → reflection in the commander's memory/relationship. The same order evaluation is not applied twice under a result ID. When a commander is replaced, existing orders/evaluations preserve the original issuer and history and are rechecked under the new commander's authority.
16. 인물이 보유하는 명분·작위 권리: 16. Justifications and Title Rights Held by Characters
모든 인물은 명분과 작위 권리를 인스턴스 목록처럼 보유할 수 있다. 인물: Every character may hold justifications and title rights like a list of instances. Each has a character ID, right ID, type, target, grounds, issuance/succession event, effect, ratifying party, version, and inheritance/extinction conditions. The holding list is an interface to rights, not a rule that every right can be freely traded or duplicated like an object. Whether it can be transferred, used, or inherited follows the contract of the right's type. Title-holding rights, latent/enforced/unenforced claims, and war justifications are displayed as different types.
무관직·무소속 인물도 적격 근거가 있으면 보유할 수 있다. 명분 보유는: Characters without office or affiliation may also hold them if they have qualifying grounds. Holding a justification does not automatically grant authority to declare war, troops, or command. A character may ask an authorized head to support war for their own claim, and the beneficiary is fixed to the justification. If there is no valid justification instance when a war begins, creation is refused.
명분은 대상 영역·수혜자·전쟁 목표·공격 승리/방어 승리/백지 강화/무효: A justification specifies the target domain, beneficiary, war objectives, effects of attacker victory/defender victory/white peace/nullification, and validity conditions. An ongoing war references the justification version at its start and explicitly checks only for nullification when the grounds change. Even at a score of 100, territory, assets, or characters beyond the scope required by that version are not forcibly acquired.
전쟁 점수 W는 -100부터 100이며 상대는 -W다. W=100이면 상: The war score W ranges from -100 to 100, and the opponent's is -W. If W=100, the opponent's forced acceptance at -100 is recorded, and the victory/defeat effects defined in the justification proceed immediately to termination settlement. Additional captures, occupations, and property demands do not keep accumulating due to NPC response delays. Forced acceptance does not mean owning every target but accepting the termination effects per justification. If the justification is already invalid, the invalidity conditions are checked first, and rights without grounds are not created.

인물 3D 원형은 Tripo 이미지→3D 한 번으로 전신 메시를 만들고,: The 3D base model for a character is made by running Tripo image-to-3D once to produce a full-body mesh. Rigging is done not with Tripo auto-rigging but with Blender Auto-Rig Pro from the avatar-gen character-tool. Foot soldiers are also made in the same art style and with the same pipeline, to fit the world setting.
ART-ASSETS/avatar-gen에 보관한 남녀 바디 패키지를 기본: Use the male and female body packages stored in ART-ASSETS/avatar-gen as the default forms. Assemble the parts in Blender while preserving the face's identity and the locked areas of the body. Match skin tone, eyes, and costume materials so they read as a single character, and check them from multiple angles on the actual screen.
남자 헤어는 머리 표면에 머리색과 헤어라인을 칠하고 바깥으로 돌출되는 부: For male hair, paint the hair color and hairline onto the head surface, and make only the parts that protrude outward as a separate mesh. The construction method for female hair is decided according to each character's design.
의상은 검증된 텍스처가 연결된 모델을 사용한다. 참조 이미지에서 만든 T: For costumes, use a model with verified textures attached. When assembling Tripo parts made from reference images, check the body, the joints, the materials, and the external textures. Exchange files containing the editing source and textures are identified by the role and hash in the ART-ASSETS manifest.
The basic costume silhouette follows 1940s attire, the World War II era. In this world an eternal winter continues, and the more often a person goes up to the surface, the thicker the winter clothing they wear.

제품 목표는 실사풍 비례와 후지모토 타츠키(《체인소맨》 작가) 화풍을 결: The product goal is a character that combines realistic proportions with the art style of Tatsuki Fujimoto (author of 《Chainsaw Man》) (owner-confirmed 2026-09-28). Faces and equipment outlines are built so they can be identified on the strategic map and in the 3D free-command battle camera. The execution status of the production stages below is distinguished by per-asset receipts.
Characters are built with natural proportions. Do not use deformation, big eyes, or SD (super-deformed) proportions. Faces follow real bone structure; eyes are small and narrow, and the nose bridge, cheekbones, and jawline are kept realistic.
표정은 과장하지 않는다. 무표정과 피로가 기본이며 감정은 눈썹과 입꼬리의: Expressions are not exaggerated. A blank look and fatigue are the default, and emotion is shown through small changes in the eyebrows and the corners of the mouth. Characters are distinguished by one or two strong silhouette features, such as bangs that fall to the space between the eyebrows.
선은 가늘고 굵기가 조금씩 흔들린다. 명암은 넓은 평면 색 위에 거친 해: Lines are thin, and their thickness wavers slightly. Shading is applied with rough hatching or a hard single-step shadow over broad flat color; do not use soft gradients, gloss, rim light, or bloom. Colors are a limited, desaturated palette, with one accent color per scene.
3D에서는 1~2단계 셀 셰이딩, 굵기에 약한 흔들림이 있는 외곽선, 그: In 3D, this art style is carried over with 1–2 step cel shading, outlines with a slight wavering in thickness, and hatching textures on shadowed surfaces. PBR gloss is turned off. The shader configuration is finalized through actual render tests.
초상 카메라는 3/4 방향, 눈높이, 좁은 시야각을 쓰고 영화 스틸처럼: The portrait camera uses a 3/4 angle, eye level, and a narrow field of view, leaving margins like a film still. Decisive moments are shown as still-frame staging that splits a single action across several scenes.
《체인소맨》의 인물·악마·로고·장면을 베끼지 않는다. 생성 프롬프트에는: Do not copy the characters, devils, logos, or scenes of 《Chainsaw Man》. In generation prompts, do not write only the artist's name; describe the features above in sentences.
티어가 높은 인물일수록 얇은 옷을 입는다. 티어와 복장 두께는 반비례하고: The higher a character's tier, the thinner the clothing they wear. Tier and clothing thickness are inversely proportional, while surface exposure and clothing thickness are directly proportional. The factors that determine clothing thickness are how often one goes up to the surface and the degree of exposure to cold.
2D 아바타젠은 인물별 JSON에서 얼굴, 헤어, 바디, 복장과 액세서리: 2D Avatar Gen generates portrait and full-body images by combining face, hair, body, outfit, and accessories from per-character JSON. Slots describe shape, color, material, and attachment position independently of the character wearing them, and the selected face and body are kept even when the outfit is changed. For the body, body type, weight, bust size, and height are entered; for the face, eye color, eye shape, eyebrows, lip color, mouth shape, nose, and facial hair are each entered. Items without numeric values are left unspecified. Portraits commonly use a calm pose: a medium close-up at eye level that captures the whole head, both shoulders, and the upper chest, with the head and torso turned slightly to the right of the frame.
3D 아바타젠은 모델 조립·리깅·스키닝·애니메이션과 3D 렌더를 담당한다: 3D Avatar Gen handles model assembly, rigging, skinning, animation, and 3D rendering. It separates its execution entry point, settings, generation contract, and outputs from those of 2D Avatar Gen, and each technique is run and verified independently. 2D portrait and full-body PNGs are generated from the designated art-style reference and per-character JSON, and face identity, body type, outfit, props, and composition are checked against the original. The hashes of generation requests, references, and outputs are linked with per-image review verdicts, and runtime import of game assets is verified separately.
In Blender, check the front, side, and three-quarter views along with the wireframe and material views. In Unity, check character proportions, hair silhouette, and the readability of equipment and materials at the actual strategy and combat camera distances and angles. Selected visual evidence is kept linked to the asset manifest.
아트 에셋 제작·보관 공정: Art Asset Production and Storage Pipeline
이 문서는 캐릭터, 초상, 프롭, UI, 타이틀 아트의 제작부터 게임 반: This document covers characters, portraits, props, UI, and title art from production through import into the game. Each stage is recorded with the actual implementation status distinguished. The default character path is to assemble the approved avatar body and the parts produced in Blender.
리깅·스키닝에는 Blender의 Auto-Rig Pro를 쓰고 애니메이션: Rigging and skinning use Blender's Auto-Rig Pro, and animation is produced in Blender. character-tool supports rigging and export tasks. For each character, whether rigging and animation were run and the inspection results are recorded in the receipt.
2D 초상과 전신 생성은 TOOL/avatar-gen/portrait/2: 2D portraits and full-body generation use the common JSON emitter in TOOL/avatar-gen/portrait/2d. Distinguish character identity and swappable slots from the designated art-style reference, and pass the common camera/pose and per-character appearance conditions in the actual request. Check the resulting PNG's size, content, difference from the source, and hash, and link a per-image verdict. 3D renders record the source object and result hash in an independent Blender process, and the source mesh and Unity runtime import are each verified separately.
편집 가능한 .blend, 외부 텍스처가 있는 FBX, 승인된 텍스처·G: Editable .blend files, FBX files with external textures, approved textures and GLB files, and selected review images are kept in ART-ASSETS/<esetgun>/ (<asset group>). TOOL/ owns the production and verification code. Each asset group's manifest.json records stable roles, repository-relative paths, SHA-256 hashes of the source and result, input provenance and usage rights, and approval status. Binaries such as Blender, image, FBX, and GLB files are committed with Git LFS and pushed to the remote, and only then is the local working folder cleaned up.
후보와 임시 렌더는 프로젝트의 .omo/evidence/<작업명>/에 모: Candidates and temporary renders are gathered in the project's .omo/evidence/<jageopmyeong>/ (<task name>). Adopted editable sources, textures, and exchange files are uploaded to ART-ASSETS. Before deleting the working folder, enumerate all regular and ignored files, and check the manifest hashes against the files in the remote repository.
FBX와 외부 텍스처를 독립적으로 다시 가져와 재질 연결, 도구 버전,: Re-import the FBX and external textures independently, and check material linkage, tool version, real-world units, size, and pivot. The web GLB and Unity FBX use the same element IDs and names from avatar-contract.json, and the coordinate axes and handedness conversion are stated explicitly. Check the same element display states in Three.js and Unity.
에셋 작업을 시작할 때 종류, 사용 목적, 원본 출처, 사용 권리, 제작: When starting asset work, record the type, intended use, original source, usage rights, production tools, and required final format. The intent graph compiler currently operates on the existing path for each asset type. The fields and branch checks for Tripo, Auto-Rig Pro, and 3D portraits are target contracts, and implementation status is recorded separately.
캐릭터: 2D 아바타젠은 인물 JSON의 얼굴·바디·헤어·복장·액세서리: Characters: 2D Avatar Gen generates portrait and full-body PNGs from the face, body, hair, outfit, and accessory slots of the character JSON. 3D Avatar Gen runs as a separate model, rigging, and render process, and the two technologies keep their entry points, settings, generation contracts, and outputs separate.
프롭: 권리와 출처를 확인한 원본을 Blender에서 제작하거나 정리하고: Props: Build or clean up sources whose rights and origin have been verified in Blender, and export them in the format the game needs.
UI·타이틀·콘셉트: CLIProxy를 통한 2D 이미지 생성 결과와 편: UI, title, and concept: Keep the 2D image generation results made through CLIProxy along with editable source files, and separately review the deliverables that will be used in the game.
ART-ASSETS/avatar-gen의 매니페스트에 등록된 남녀 바디: Start from the male and female body packages registered in the manifest at ART-ASSETS/avatar-gen. For 3D parts such as hair and outfits, prepare reference images, create them in the Tripo web version, and assemble them with the body in Blender. Tripo work is done in the Aside browser. 2D image generation is also used for reference sheets for Tripo input and for UI and title art. The origin and usage rights of the generation model and input images are recorded per asset.
Blender 작업에서는 원본을 보존하고 새 결과를 만든다. 바디와 얼굴: In Blender work, preserve the original and create a new result. After checking body and face identity, boundaries, UVs, and texture connections, fit the parts and apply the project's own toon material. Audit both sides of the mesh first, plan only the places that need repair, and re-verify the applied result in a new Blender process. The current automatic repair scope is limited.
Unity 반입 후 전략 지도와 3D 자유 지휘 전투 카메라의 실제 화면: After importing into Unity, check whether shapes and materials read clearly in the actual screens of the strategic map and the 3D free-command battle camera. Inspect from multiple angles using pan, orbit, and zoom. Runtime-slot import of game assets goes through a separate provenance and import inspection.
Unity UI는 AssetDatabase가 가져온 텍스처와 임포터 설정: Unity UI uses textures imported by AssetDatabase and the importer settings. When compositing multiple transparent images, apply source-over alpha compositing to preserve the color and alpha of the lower layers.
